apps.name: Alt Tab Toolkit
apps.short_description:
Fast / Responsive Alt Tab replacement. 

Enjoy Customizable Themes, Layouts, Window Previews, Shader driven visuals and more.

Featuring Alt Tab layouts such as
Wheel, Tower 3D, Classic, List, and more.

Download Themes right from the in-app Steam Workshop, or Customize your own in the Theme Editor.

apps.name: Asobi: Remote Play
apps.short_description: An independent remote streaming client for your own PS4® or PS5® console, with controller support, adaptive streaming, and optional cloud-streaming compatibility.

apps.name: Before Peace
apps.short_description: A "skinny wiki" app that only shows what you need to learn how to play RPGs like D&D "at the table". Skip the prep-work of character creation and just be yourself. Start playing immediately, laying on mechanics as you learn them while exploring an alien world for new foods and pets.

apps.name: Blamcon ARC - Advanced Remote Console
apps.short_description: This utility is for setting up your Blamcon Light Gun. Customize key bindings, set your player config, even set your cursor smoothing algorithm. Blamcon ARC will get the most out of your light gun and nail those high scores!

apps.name: ChallaChat
apps.short_description: Capture and display any livestream chat in a customizable overlay! With multi-stream support (YouTube, Twitch, Kick), you can monitor all messages in one place with ultra-low latency. No cloud, all local.

apps.name: ComfyTrans: Realtime Screen Translator
apps.short_description: An offline screen-translation overlay that recognizes on-screen text in real time and shows the translation right where it appears. Everything runs on local, on-device AI, so your screen and personal data are never sent anywhere.

apps.name: Crossbench3D
apps.short_description: The definitive cross-platform 3D GPU benchmark — run, upload, and compare your results with millions of users worldwide.

apps.name: DesktopPiP
apps.short_description: DesktopPiP lets you capture regions of any window into interactive Picture-in-Picture windows. Save and restore layouts, interact through PiPs, and combine windows with Background Layers to build a beautiful customizable dashboard that fits the way you work.

apps.name: Doodlefolk
apps.short_description: Bring a little company to your Windows desktop. Meet procedural characters with distinct personalities, watch friendships and skills grow, and give your folk props and activities while you work or unwind. Customize their world with your own mods or ones from Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Driver Booster 4 for Steam
apps.short_description: Driver Booster 4 for STEAM, as a powerful & easy-to-use driver updater, provides 1-click solution to rapidly & securely update 400,000+ drivers including the outdated, missing and faulty ones. Moreover, game components and game-related drivers are supported for enhanced gaming experience.

apps.name: DSX
apps.short_description: DSX brings out the full potential of your PlayStation controllers on PC. Personalize input response, adaptive triggers, lighting, and haptics for unmatched precision and immersion. Whether you play competitively or casually, DSX helps you play at your best.

apps.name: EchoKey
apps.short_description: EchoKey is a lightweight soundboard that plays audio directly through your microphone. Trigger sounds instantly in Discord, TeamSpeak, in-game voice chats, and live streams using hotkeys, a mobile remote, an overlay, or Stream Deck.

apps.name: Edge3
apps.short_description: Edge3 is a pixel art editor featuring powerful palette management and animation tools.

apps.name: Gamepan
apps.short_description: The companion app for every game you play. Build each game its own workspace from 24 drag-and-drop modules: checklists, maps, trackers, timers, notes and more. Pin it as an overlay, share setups on the Steam Workshop, and keep it all on your PC. No accounts. No subscription.

apps.name: GenderShift
apps.short_description: Embody your avatar. GenderShift is a push-to-talk voice changer that rebuilds your words in a real, natural feminine voice (or masculine, your call), so you pass in VRChat, Discord, anywhere you talk online. Your own voice, shifted.

apps.name: Guardian Beast
apps.short_description: An interactive digital novel: an 11-chapter SF-fantasy with art, music, video and choices, including game-over branches. Read in Japanese, English, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with side-by-side translation and no extra fonts or OS language changes. Journey with Reis and his dragon.

apps.name: HeadTrack
apps.short_description: Use your phone as a head tracking device for games on your PC.

apps.name: Hyper Online: VTuber Avatar Studio
apps.short_description: Hyper is the ultimate app for vtubers & avatar creators. Use our VTubing tools to make content, stream, connect, and do more. Are you ready to start your VTuber journey?

apps.name: Leadwerks Game Engine 5
apps.short_description: Learn, Build, and Play with an all-new update that makes game development easier than ever. Dive into our video tutorials and learn everything you need to bring your ideas to life. Create with ease using our intuitive visual editor and Lua script. Publish your projects with a royalty-free license.

apps.name: LIV
apps.short_description: All-in-one VR software for creators. Record mixed reality, transform into your favorite avatar, see chat inside your headset, and more.

apps.name: Local Realm
apps.short_description: Local Realm is an offline-first worldbuilding tool for writers, game developers, and TTRPG creators. Build interconnected characters, locations, factions, timelines, maps, and lore in a flexible local database with no accounts, subscriptions, or cloud dependency required.

apps.name: MEs
apps.short_description: Take part in exploring the ever-expanding innerworlds of MEs — a personal knowledge collection for gathering the smallest sparks of ideas.

apps.name: Monster Adventure Studio
apps.short_description: Create your own creature-collector RPG—no coding required!

apps.name: Mor10 Photo Editor
apps.short_description: Mor10 Photo Editor is a simple, creative, and user-friendly photo editing application for Windows. Edit images, draw, adjust colors, remove backgrounds with AI, and bring your creative ideas to life — all in one convenient application!

apps.name: MyMoney
apps.short_description: MyMoney is a lightweight, simple accounting software with an easy interface and minimal functionality, including your most basic accounting needs, easy to record your living expenses.

apps.name: NitLink
apps.short_description: Play 30 fps console games at 60 fps on your PC monitor with experimental frame generation. NitLink is a low-latency capture card viewer with real HDR10 passthrough, picture-in-picture and native support for Elgato 4K Pro, 4K X and 4K S capture cards.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.short_description: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming

apps.name: OpenCAGE
apps.short_description: OpenCAGE is a community-created modding toolkit for Alien: Isolation which gives access to scripting, assets, configurations, and behaviour trees.

apps.name: OVR Overlay Translator
apps.short_description: Real-time VR translation. Via OCR, it converts foreign game and app text using machine, LLM, and offline engines, overlays results on the original, transcribes live voice into subtitles, and sends to VRChat Chatbox. 30 languages, multilingual UI, full controller support.

apps.name: PawPaint
apps.short_description: PawPaint is a modern 3D model painting software that has been crafted with you in mind, focused on being the best 3D painting software for VRChat avatar creators, 3d modelers and hobbyists. Featuring non-destructive layers, masks, modifiers, a bundled asset library, and game-ready export up to 4K.

apps.name: PixiEditor
apps.short_description: PixiEditor is a universal 2D editor with tools and features for all your 2D needs. It blurs the line between vector and raster graphics. Create animations, procedural graphics, draw pixel-art, edit photos, vectors and more!

apps.name: PopUp Tube
apps.short_description: Bring channel surfing back to your own video collection. Each show gets its own channel, ready to resume where you left off. Add PopUps—precisely timed commentary cards that bring context and a fresh perspective to what you’re watching.

apps.name: QPet
apps.short_description: One day, you found a lost little QPet. You feed her and play with her, and she soon makes herself at home on your screen. She works, plays, and dances to music—and even brings friends, turning your desktop into a lively, warm, and heartwarming little world.

apps.name: Sigilgraph
apps.short_description: A modular non-linear DAW and sandbox for sound designers and generative musicians. Connect synthesizers, sample tools, MIDI modifiers, and modulation sources on a visual canvas with virtual cables. Break free from the traditional linear timeline to construct evolving, self-playing soundscapes.

apps.name: Substance 3D Designer 2026
apps.short_description: Substance 3D Designer is the industry's reference 3D Material Creation app. More than 95% of AAA game projects currently in development use Substance 3D as well as the most prestigious visual effects and animation studios.

apps.name: Substance 3D Painter 2026
apps.short_description: Adobe Substance 3D Painter is the reference texturing app for 3D professionals and enthusiasts. From AAA Game Developers to Indies, from Feature Animation to Visual Effects studios, the industry uses Painter to bring their creations to life.

apps.name: VantGrid
apps.short_description: Open your Steam library, see what friends choose to share and get together over P2P voice. Games, your gaming week and earned titles in one Windows app. Buy once; friends can join through the free Friend Pass.

apps.name: Vealo - Clean Desktop
apps.short_description: Your new desktop in one click. Apply ready-made setups from the Workshop or build your own: wallpapers, widgets, effects, cursors and lighting in one app. Every detail can be changed to suit you. Start for free, save your favourite looks and share your own.

apps.name: vHand
apps.short_description: vHand is an app that realistically simulates your hand drawing motion, as well as, provides dynamic sketching sounds for ASMR lovers. vHand allows you to customize multiple hand presets which include pen, effects and colors. Use with your favorite streaming/capturing tool.

apps.name: Vibralizer
apps.short_description: Music visualizer for Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, SoundCloud, YouTube, Ableton, or a microphone — anything that plays sound! Hand-crafted Vibes that don't just react to the music; they show it in real-time. No AI-generated imagery. Built in Nashville by two people who love human-made music and art.

apps.name: vrOS
apps.short_description: vrOS puts your desktop windows on panels inside VR, with a laser pointer and a VR keyboard that work in the real window. Fix your playspace, assign and calibrate trackers, watch frame timing, and add VRChat OSC, OBS, Twitch and soundboard tools — all in one crash-resistant overlay.

apps.name: VTuber Forge
apps.short_description: Your avatar. Their chaos. Your show. Animate 2D PNGtubers and 3D VRM avatars with your webcam and mic. Let viewers throw items, change outfits and trigger effects on Twitch, YouTube and Kick. VTuber Forge brings avatar tools, chat interactions and stream controls together in one Windows app.

apps.name: VZX Player
apps.short_description: Actively developed 3D Music Visualizer - reacts in real time to the music you play, regardless of player. Free, no watermarks, no nag screens, no subscriptions. Optional DLC for more effects.

apps.name: Wallpaper Animator
apps.short_description: Use animated wallpapers on your desktop. Explore unlimited live wallpapers from the community, or create your own with included AI generations that refill daily.

apps.name: Widget2000s
apps.short_description: ★·.·.· Widget2000s is a 2000s-inspired audio-reactive widget creator & library. Reacts to your favorite music player's audio! Create your own easily and intuitively. Ultra-low resource usage, designed to stay out of your way. Share on Steam Workshop. Join the community and start creating! ·.·.·★

apps.name: Yinglet Creator
apps.short_description: A character creator that lets you design your very own collection of yinglets.

apps.name: 拾光 ShiGuang
apps.short_description: 100% local AI semantic search for images AND videos. Type "sunset by the sea" and find that picture instantly; deep video analysis takes you to the exact moment. Supports iPhone HEIC, camera RAW and 20+ video formats. All AI models built in, no internet — your library never leaves your PC.

Dark Age: Tokens of the Fallen Playtest
Holdfast: Nations At War - Testing Branch
House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Playtest
Isekai Reborn Girl Playtest
developers: Isekai Reborn Girl 製作委員会

apps.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Benchmark

Sid Meier's Civilization VII Firaxis Feature Workshop
Survive in Spaceshit - THE REVERSAL Playtest

10 Second Mixtape Demo
apps.short_description: Make mini music with other players! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

apps.name: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！ Demo
771: Smile and work Demo
apps.short_description: "771: Smile and Work Demo" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.

apps.name: 99天生存指南 Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

apps.name: A Place for Every Potion Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs, two puzzles competing for the same hands. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

apps.name: A Pond Hunt Demo
apps.short_description: Can you profit from draining ponds for fish? Hard to say! Start with muddy puddles, lease carp ponds, giant lakes, and turtle ponds. Build your empire and conquer the Dragon Pool for its treasure. What? Loch Ness? Drain it and find out!

apps.name: Absolum Demo
apps.short_description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

apps.name: Abyss Ring Demo
apps.short_description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.

apps.name: Adventurer’s Guild Manager Demo
apps.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

apps.name: AETHERIA Demo
apps.short_description: A high-speed aerial roguelite demo with full 360° 3D combat. Fly freely, fight enemy swarms, and combine automatic attacks, skills, and randomized upgrades. Explore the purple realm as the cat-eared character in this single-player demo.

apps.name: After Frame Demo
apps.short_description: Some things can only be seen through the camera. The longer you look, the more clearly they see you. Can you uncover the truth before something notices you? A first-person psychological horror game built around paranormal investigation and unseen anomalies.

apps.name: Aftermyth Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

apps.name: Agile Team Demo
apps.short_description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner.  Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

apps.name: AKARI: Lovely Moments with You Demo
apps.short_description: "Akari: Lovely Moments with You" is a healing desktop companion game where players experience precious moments with elder sister Akari from Yuki's perspective. By gathering "Inspiration" from pomodoro timer, you can unlock more outfits, accessories, desktop wallpapers, BGM, and more story about her.

apps.name: Alea Demo
apps.short_description: A PvP brawler where every hero is two fighters in one. Human to werewolf. Fire to ice. Shield to greatsword. Swap mid-fight to outplay a rival in a 1v1 duel, or team up for 2v2 and 3v3 clashes.

apps.name: All-Night Ascension Demo
apps.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler built around a three-layer Bagua board. Try two sects, combine methods, artifacts and materials, and test your build in asynchronous duels. Battles run automatically; once you gain a Domain, choose when to cast it. Expedition mode is not included.

apps.name: Alterium Shift Demo
apps.short_description: Join three heroes in training as they learn to master their individual strengths and harness the power of Alterium Essence. With their training nearly completed, Dolion, their teacher, prepares them for the most important mission they've faced yet.

apps.name: Am I Nima Demo
apps.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

apps.name: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.) Demo
apps.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

apps.name: Ambroise Niflette & the Gleaned Bell Demo
apps.short_description: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

apps.name: Angelfall Demo
apps.short_description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

apps.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit - Demo
apps.short_description: A mystery adventure featuring a public security duo and supernatural cases. Unravel the truth behind the otherworldly "Ghosturbance Cases"!

apps.name: Animas Demo
apps.short_description: Animas Prologue is a standalone chapter in the Animas story, allowing you to explore the Blanco family home for the first time and begin to uncover its dark secrets.

apps.name: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator Demo
Arborrosa Insidia Demo
apps.short_description: Intro of game, that will give you to dive into atmosphere and get acquainted with the plot. Enjoy ;)

apps.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Arcade Park Islands: explore parts of three themed islands, play arcade minigames, ride attractions, collect tickets and chat with friendly robot visitors. Get a first taste of the full first-person arcade park adventure!

apps.name: Arcane Abyss（アーケイン・アビス） Demo
apps.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

apps.name: Arcane Dash Demo
apps.short_description: The Arcane Dash demo gives you full access to Episode 1 - Glimmelion - in the spirit of the shareware model from the 80s and 90s, it's 1/4 of the game completely free with no time limits and no restrictions.

apps.name: ARCHETYPE BLUE Demo
apps.short_description: Meet more than 50 companions, build your own party of four, and take on dangerous missions. Your companions fight based on their abilities and positions, while you use cards to turn the tide. As missions unfold, become entangled in their stories and secrets.

apps.name: Archival Security Demo
apps.short_description: The first three shifts of ARCHIVAL SECURITY. Roughly 30 to 50 minutes. A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the slides, follow the six rules, and find out what the third one was protecting.

apps.name: Arctic Drive Demo
apps.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

apps.name: Ascendora Demo
apps.short_description: A first person horror game where you play as Harper, the child of an infamous scientist. You must explore his abandoned laboratory to find the answers you have been looking for. Unravel the secrets of your parents, but be aware, you might not be alone...

apps.name: ASEMA Demo
apps.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

apps.name: Aster Initiative Demo
apps.short_description: Play Day 1 of Aster Initiative: navigate a huge mid-90s internet and use a variety of programs on your work computer to take down the pharmaceutical company you work for without getting caught.

apps.name: ASTRIDER Demo
apps.short_description: Arcade air combat set in an alt-history Cold War gone hot in 1967, in a world where the strangest conspiracy theories turned out real. Fly three twelve-mission campaigns, one per faction, against targets on land, at sea, and in the air, with fully-voiced visual-novel scenes between sorties.

apps.name: Attack of the Astrals Demo
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

apps.name: Auto Ball Arena Demo
apps.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

apps.name: Aveos Demo
apps.short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

apps.name: AWAITING YOUR HORDERS Demo
apps.short_description: The best defense is offense. As long as you don't do anything stupid. Or do you? A serious and funny battle simulator where your smallest unit is an ARMY: click one soldier, 100,000 shout YAH! Up to 1,000,000 on screen climb into wobbly towers, get shelled, see stars, and charge again.

apps.name: B.L.U.E. Demo
apps.short_description: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is a sci-fi shipbuilding and combat simulator where you design customized spacecraft from modular components. Learn about and play B.L.U.E.'s shipbuilding and combat systems in this free demo.

apps.name: Backmarkers Demo
apps.short_description: Three race weekends with the worst team in the National League. Two cars, live pit-wall strategy, fuel and tire calls as the weather turns, and a garage full of parts nobody can quite vouch for. A slice of the full racing management sim.

apps.name: Backrooms Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: Backrooms Protocol Demo is a walk simulator designed to showcase the atmosphere and environments of the full game. It contains three different levels to explore, each featuring its own unique atmosphere.

apps.name: Band of Crusaders Demo
apps.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Demo showcases all key game mechanics, which will be further expanded upon in the game release.

apps.name: Bandidos em Brasilia Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of Bandidos em Brasília. This demo includes the story mode and the free modes! Try out a horror game featuring Brazil's most well-known politicians for free, and feel free to report any bugs or suggest improvements!

apps.name: Barbe-Yeux Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of chapter 1 from a comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore an island, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is "Gloubi".

apps.name: Barnburners Demo
apps.short_description: Free 5-on-5 arcade hockey with four playable clubs, couch and online games, fights, and a ten-game Seattle Franchise trial through the playoffs and draft. Aim your shots, throw the hits, and see how far you can take the Squall.

apps.name: Bashful Adoration Demo
apps.short_description: Bashful Adoration is a Kinetic 3D Platformer starring a cast of four competitive witches who are all in love with the same crush! Featuring Bombastic Combat, Expressive Movement Mechanics and a light-hearted Narrative with themes of love, rivalry and friendship.

apps.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed." Demo
apps.short_description: Demo demo demo demo demo [demo] demo | Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

apps.name: Basketball Dynasty Demo
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

apps.name: Battle Suit Aces Demo
apps.short_description: Battle Suit Aces is a charming card-battling RPG. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

apps.name: Beastieball Demo
apps.short_description: Coach a sports team of Beasties in this turn-based volleyball RPG! Your Beasties' relationships power up their teamwork!

apps.name: Beelionair Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy idle sim about bees and their hives. Plant a wild meadow, send your swarm out to forage, and watch the honey pour in. Grow your hives, breed new bee strains, research upgrades, and re-queen your colony across four biomes. Your hives keep filling up even while you're away.

apps.name: Beltrunner Demo
apps.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

apps.name: Benson Bones Demo
apps.short_description: You claw out of a grave with no memory, and a friendly dog named Benson finds you. Benson Bones is a top-down pixel art adventure RPG with timing-based combat, Souls-style checkpoints and a hand-built world of doors that open where they shouldn't.

apps.name: Bet Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

apps.name: Bibidi Bibidi! Demo
apps.short_description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardcore roguelike deckbuilder where you combine cards in your spellbook to cast unique and powerful spells. Crawl through twisting tunnels and fight maddening monsters to find the perfect build for your wizard. Every turn is a puzzle!

apps.name: Bills Must Be Paid Demo
apps.short_description: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

apps.name: Billy the Hero Demo
apps.short_description:
Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now.

A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

apps.name: Black Brew Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: An open world where alcohol is illegal. Produce and sell it, find customers, take over territories, grow your gang, and build a criminal empire — alone or with friends.

apps.name: Black Ledger: The Antique Mafia Demo
apps.short_description:
Run an antique shop during the day.

Lead a criminal organization at night.

Maintain a balance between profit, loyalty, and suspicion... Every choice has consequences.

apps.name: BlastMorph: Pinball Demo
apps.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it!  Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

apps.name: blockia Demo
apps.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo. Free demo with selected parts.

apps.name: BloodSpiller Demo
apps.short_description:
BloodSpiller is a retro-action platformer that blends classic visuals and game play with modern flair and attitude, 
Destroy Dracula and his minions using overwhelming fire power.
Paint the town red and you blast through dozens of monsters, bosses, to eventually fight the big man himself.

apps.name: Bloodthief Demo
apps.short_description: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

apps.name: Blue Book Demo
apps.short_description: Blue Book is a sci-fi detective quest with point'n'click elements, where there are no hints, there are false clues and only your conclusion. Analyze testimonies, find inconsistencies, follow the logic. Become an FBI agent and unravel a chain of mysterious disappearances in a quiet American town.

apps.name: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners Demo
apps.short_description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, then equip them with rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically at the edge of your desktop while you work or browse!

apps.name: Book Nook Demo
apps.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

apps.name: Bowerland Demo
apps.short_description: The Euchre roguelite. Call trump, win tricks, deal damage and decimate your foes as you take on the Bower King's evil henchmen in this single player 1v1 card battler.

apps.name: Break Shot Hero Demo
apps.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

apps.name: Breaking Armor Demo
apps.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

apps.name: Brothers Demo
apps.short_description: A cooperative medieval action game where you and your brother fight through dangerous environments, take on powerful enemies, and grow stronger together. Brothers serves as the foundation and showcase for a much larger co-op experience currently in development.

apps.name: BrouHaHa Demo
apps.short_description:
Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy
coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

apps.name: Bug Ball Demo
apps.short_description: Bug Ball is a wacky football (soccer) game where you play as little bugs.

apps.name: BULLACATOR Demo
apps.short_description:
A free demo of BULLACATOR. 
Try the first area of this coin pusher × roguelite × deckbuilder for free. 
Drop your shells, smash enemies with physics, and build a deck all your own.

apps.name: Bumper & Thumper Demo
apps.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

apps.name: Bunny Flags Demo
apps.short_description: Sarge is BACK. Tactical roguelite top-down shooter. Infiltrate bases, plant flags, choose your loadout, and hunt Racabat. High replayability. Free demo available.

apps.name: Bushcraft Survival Demo
apps.short_description: Alone. Hungry. Freezing. Test your grit in this unforgiving, Bushcraft Survival simulator set deep in the icy forests of Northern Canada. Collect resources, build shelters, fish, track, and trap in a brutal open world where every decision counts - and any mistake could be your last.

apps.name: Call The Exterminator Demo
apps.short_description: When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours. CTE is classic 90's 2.5D action. Suit up, Light up, its time to Call The Exterminator.

apps.name: CAPITALIUM 资本纪元 Demo
apps.short_description: Industrial Revolution sim of trade and politics: open factories, swallow rivals, lobby MPs. Rivals may grab supplies, cut you off, refuse your orders or quietly buy your shares. Or team up, raise prices and split the market. Win a royal charter, run rails to the frontier, found a town in your name.

apps.name: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park Demo
apps.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

apps.name: Carry On Together Demo
apps.short_description: Get your first taste of moving chaos in Carry On Together Demo! Play online co-op with up to 4 players, carry furniture together, drive the truck and try to complete the delivery without turning everything into a disaster.

apps.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story Demo
apps.short_description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

apps.name: Casino Tycoon Sin&Win Demo
apps.short_description: "Casino Tycoon: Sin & Win" Demo is an open-world experience where you can gear up, drive around, climb, and swim. In this demo version, only one island town map is available. Try your luck with lottery and slot machines to earn your first fortune — this coastal town is where your fortune begins.

apps.name: CastleOn Demo
apps.short_description: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

apps.name: Celtreos Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo!  1-2 players, game controller support.  Great music!  Tons of weapons, guards & special moves.  3-stage demo (more than 12 in full game), partly-random, with bosses.  Play in a window or in Full Screen.

apps.name: Chimpanik Demo
apps.short_description: Chimpanik is a chaotic PvP party game where your voice is your only weapon! Play as an armless monkey, scream into your microphone to unleash shockwaves, and battle up to 8 other players in randomly generated arenas. Anything can happen!

apps.name: Chrome Circuit Demo
apps.short_description: Neon twin-stick roguelite. Fight through three cyberpunk districts with an infinite-ammo sidearm and a five-slot arsenal of looted guns. Bait bosses into mistakes, beat the clock in timed encounters, sign cursed contracts. This demo is the full game — saving unlocks at launch.

apps.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

apps.name: City Party Demo
apps.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

apps.name: Clean 'Em Ocean Demo
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

apps.name: Cleaner Company Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo of Cleaner Company, a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean up the Flying Canteen, a space restaurant infested by friendly mutant chickens and unfriendly alien pests.

apps.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3 Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: play ValuCo #3's first five days for real. Throw crates onto empty shelves, chain register combos, wrangle cart trains, survive corporate's nightly "improvements." Your progress carries into the full game: six more stores, starting with one that never closes.

apps.name: Cloud Getaway Demo
apps.short_description: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!

apps.name: Colorways Demo
apps.short_description: Try to complete 7 free levels in the wave-based traffic mode in Colorways!

apps.name: Comic Shop Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Your dream comic shop starts here! Play the free demo of Comic Shop Tycoon. Stock shelves, discover collectible back issues, prepare for New Comic Book Day, set prices, serve customers, and grow your little comic shop into a thriving business!

apps.name: Comix Zero Demo
apps.short_description: Comix Zero is a unique COMIXVANIA set inside a living comic book. Explore its pages, jump between panels, break their borders, uncover secrets, and fight your way through a dark fantasy world. Turn the page — or die!

apps.name: County of Fortune Demo
apps.short_description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

apps.name: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
apps.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

apps.name: Cricket Club President Demo
apps.short_description: A cricket club management game where you are the president, not the coach. The demo is one full season: pick three sides every week from one squad, keep the captain and the committee onside, then face the AGM vote. The career you start here carries into the full game.

apps.name: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

apps.name: Cursed Words Demo
apps.short_description: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

apps.name: D.O.T. Defence Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to the frontlines of D.O.T defense! Build towers, muster armies, and conquer the map. Fight local matches in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all battles against bots and friends. Victory comes with the last HQ standing!

apps.name: Dark Age: Tokens of the Fallen Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player medieval dungeon-crawler RPG where you battle bandits, defeat powerful bosses, collect souls to upgrade your skills, and recover fallen tokens to unlock new dungeons and the road to the King’s fortress.

apps.name: Daughter of Dawn Demo
apps.short_description:
"A princess who lost everything flees with the Knight Commander!"
Become a father to protect the ruined kingdom's last princess. Guide a traumatized girl—caring, teaching, and learning when to let go. Your choices shape her destiny in this emotional raising sim RPG.

apps.name: Dead Spin Demo
apps.short_description: Gamble your way through a deadly casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Survive the campaign or challenge other players in PvP mode. Discover broken synergies and keep spinning for your freedom!

apps.name: DeadFront Demo
apps.short_description: DeadFront Demo is a 1-to-6 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

apps.name: Deadline Dinner Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

apps.name: Death Pool Club Demo
apps.short_description: Oh, a new face? Welcome to Death Pool Club. Every ball you sink takes a bite out of your rival's health. But we share the table, darling. Whatever you leave lying around is mine next turn ♠ The pockets are shady and the executives cheat openly. Beat them all, if you can.

apps.name: Debuilders Demo
apps.short_description: Grab a sledgehammer and dive into the chaos! Debuilders is a physics‑based cooperative comedy for 4 players, in which each worker has a funny flaw. Destroy walls, fix fuse boxes, follow the boss’s instructions, and try to finish the repairs without accidentally destroying your friends!

apps.name: Deck Drop Demo
apps.short_description:
Perfect your deck or watch it burn!

Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro.

Can you beat the Tipping Point?

apps.name: Deductopia Demo
apps.short_description: So you think you're a detective? Try your skills in the world of Deductopia! This demo features three zany and creative chapters about chaos in the classroom, mix-ups on the hiking trail, and confusion at the scout camp. Match everyone with the right names, pets, goals, and belongings to win!

apps.name: Deepstrata Demo
apps.short_description: Fly a small mining pod down through the rock. Fill the hold with ore, get back up before the fuel runs out, sell it, and buy a bigger drill. Build a base on the surface and hold it when the critters come at night. Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto, with a guardian machine asleep under each.

apps.name: DEGUL DEGUL 999 Demo
apps.short_description: Try 45 rolling logic puzzles from the 999 campaign: five from each of nine difficulty sections. Plan your route and landing faces, undo freely, and sample puzzles with a single cube, a long block, and two interacting blocks.

apps.name: Diatonic Demo
apps.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

apps.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar Demo
apps.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

apps.name: Don't Fool Me, Beauties! Demo
apps.short_description: "Get out!!!" Kicked out in the dead of winter, you land a job at a shady hotel. But work’s not the only challenge, there’s the CEO’s cold-hearted granddaughter, a lazy senior, a diva model, and your childhood friend who makes you do her laundry?! Which captivating woman will you win over?

apps.name: DOTS VS PIXELS Demo
apps.short_description: POINT CLOUDS HAVE INVADED YOUR FAVORITE PIXEL ART APP. Up to 1,000,000,000,000 dots flow like a fluid, hunt your core and chew through everything you paint. Your only power: the pencil. Draw walls, survive the siege, unlock broken builds. BUILD. RESIST. OVERFLOW.

apps.name: Dr. Oops! Demo
apps.short_description:
Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure!
Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

apps.name: Dragons Invasion Demo
apps.short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

apps.name: DreadHaven: The Last Colony Demo
apps.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, your towers unleash their power against ever-growing zombie hordes.

apps.name: Driving Test Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios.

apps.name: Drop Command Demo
apps.short_description: Classic '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build a Mech empire and conquer the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds. You are the battlefield commander leading from the cockpit.

apps.name: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles demo
apps.short_description: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles is a male-oriented xianxia romance adventure game. Explore the martial world, meet unique female cultivators, grow stronger through cultivation, unlock character stories and intimate interactions, and embark on a journey of dual cultivation.

apps.name: Dungeons & Dynasties Demo
apps.short_description: Football Manager meets D&D. Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.Lead an adventuring guild through a living realm where every fixture is a dungeon, every hero can die in it, and every season is written down.

apps.name: Eastwynne Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of the upcoming CRPG, Eastwynne. In this short side-story, a group of magical college students need to stop a bad situation from getting worse.

apps.name: Echoes of Nothing Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver your enemies, then retaliate with lasers and heavy artillery.

apps.name: Edenfall Demo
apps.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

apps.name: Egg Rush Demo
apps.short_description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling roguelite game. Collect a wealth of treasures and items to power yourself up, encounter all kinds of special events, and use their abilities wisely to overcome every challenge!

apps.name: Elta: Defy All Gods - Demo
apps.short_description: Master a blend of free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration in the Elta: Defy All Gods demo. Experience the beginning of the adrenaline-fueled action-platformer and become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

apps.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil Demo
apps.short_description: Atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring a fantasy world through magical portals. Explore the first location, collect rare equipment, and discover the world of Sunveil.

apps.name: Elven Watcher Demo
apps.short_description: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!

apps.name: Emptiness Sire Demo
apps.short_description: Three survivors in a world consumed by cosmic horror. Solve turn-based puzzles and face deadly enemies, because death is part of the journey, but you can undo its consequences.

apps.name: Endangered Demo
apps.short_description: Humanity wiped out your species. Now you're fighting back. Play as evolved animals in a brutal roguelike hack-and-slash inspired by Dynasty Warriors, Megabonk and Roboquest! Hunt down humans, adapt to a collapsing world, and collect nuclear launch codes to end the fight... permanently.

apps.name: Epoch Forge Demo
apps.short_description: The world broke a long time ago and kept going anyway. Mining, settlements, circuitry, gods and ships all run at once, in one world, and none of them wait for you. Talk to anyone — they answer in their own words, from a model running on your machine, about things that actually happened.

apps.name: Epsilon Hyperpunk Demo
apps.short_description: Enter a cyber world in this On-Rails space shooter. You are a lone K.I.L.L.E.R. facing an impossible mission in a decaying dystopian future. Your only edge? Running high-stakes combat simulations through a NEUROVISOR powered by a highly illegal, custom-built Operating System-- HyperpunkOS.

apps.name: Epsilon Zero Demo
apps.short_description: "Epsilon Zero" is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike shooter where every mission is an all-out assault. Use devastating weapon combinations, unlock powerful upgrades, adapt your tactics, and exterminate everything standing in your way.

apps.name: Escape the Exomoon Demo
apps.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

apps.name: Estella Demo
apps.short_description: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

apps.name: Eternal Blade Demo
apps.short_description: An open-world souls-like built around the parry. Switch weapons mid-parry to counter, build Almighty Power, and unleash supernatural abilities. Play as Emerald, a rebellious hero called by a prophecy, searching the Baransu Realm for the Almighty Gemstones to free her father from an eternal curse.

apps.name: EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR Demo
apps.short_description: Try EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR for 60 minutes of active gameplay. Build and run your own club, plan events, serve drinks, and explore a town full of odd characters and surprises. A chaotic sandbox simulator where you decide how to spend your first hour.

apps.name: Evil Cabin Demo
apps.short_description: Tocantins, Brazil, 1978. A storm chaser's car dies by an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere. The night is long, the woods are dense, and the radio keeps talking to him. First-person psychological horror.

apps.name: Expedition of the Guild Demo
apps.short_description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

apps.name: FAIL GAMES Demo
apps.short_description: Fail Games is a collection of extremely hard but simple minigames. Win each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail to buy effects and outfits. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

apps.name: Faith of Fate Demo
apps.short_description: Faith of Fate, a demo made by half million dreams for a half million testers. if you just have half Faith then you'll get just half Fate, good luck <3

apps.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

apps.name: Father, Son and Holy Guns Demo
Fathom Reach Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a raid. Dive the drowned deep, build your deck on the way down, and crack a fortified base at the bottom. Free demo, unlimited dives.

apps.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet Demo
apps.short_description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

apps.name: Fieldmade Demo
apps.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

apps.name: Fields of Aaru Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

apps.name: Football Academy Manager Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own football academy. Scout and discover young talents, evaluate their potential, manage their development through training, and negotiate transfers with clubs to grow your prestige and influence.

apps.name: Fragile Reflection Demo
apps.short_description: A young woman returns back to her home in a rural Japanese village - but something is very wrong. Find items, solve puzzles, fight monsters and traverse between dimensions. Help Kario Ito reveal hidden mysteries and stay alive in this retro-styled survival horror!

apps.name: FRAGLINE: Esports Manager Demo
apps.short_description: Build an esports org from a scrappy roster into a world champion. Scout raw talent, design your own set plays, and outcoach rivals who adapt to your tactics. Grind from open qualifiers to grand finals in a scene where every win and loss makes headlines.

apps.name: From Basement with Love Demo
apps.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

apps.name: Frontier Tavern Demo
apps.short_description: Run a tavern in the Old West in this first-person demo. Pour drinks, serve customers, restock supplies and hire your first employees. Unlock whisky, improve your tavern and learn to defend it. Keep playing after completing the demo's missions.

apps.name: Gamblers Table Demo
apps.short_description: Gamblers Table is an automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

apps.name: Geareo Demo
apps.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

apps.name: Gemfall Demo
apps.short_description:
The match 3 roguelike!

Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop.

Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

apps.name: Ghoul Fright Demo
apps.short_description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based action-packed FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves.¿Ready to Fright?

apps.name: Giggleland Demo
apps.short_description: Something is wrong with Terry's vegetable patch, the abandoned attraction in Giggleland Amusement Park. Uncover the truth Terry tried to bury deep in his farm... before it finds you. This game is not suitable for children.

apps.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard Demo
apps.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

apps.name: Global Parity Demo
apps.short_description: Try Global Parity for free: take charge of a nation in 1999 and steer it through its first years. Balance the budget, pass laws, survive elections and crises, and face AI neighbours who build, scheme and fight. Wishlist the full game!

apps.name: Glowstick Pirates: Harem Conquest Demo
apps.short_description:
Set sail in a pirate JRPG!
Rackham was cursed with a glowing cock by a mysterious pirate. To break it, he sets sail as a pirate alongside Anne. Take on pirate crews across the seas and conquer them all! Crush rival factions, recruit everyone you meet, and build a harem pirate crew of your very own!!

apps.name: Goreticulture Demo
apps.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

apps.name: Grandma Left Me A Building Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

apps.name: Grayscale Star灰度之星 Demo
apps.short_description: 穿越回00年代，一起成为“国民偶像组合”吧！这是一个十位少女介于十八岁缝隙中挣扎的故事。

apps.name: Greedy Getaways Demo
apps.short_description: Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh every excursion.

apps.name: Gridfire Demo
apps.short_description: Try Gridfire free. Queue into live Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch and VIP Escort matches, vote between rounds on what to play next — and if you are brave, switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

apps.name: Grimoire of Blanks Demo
apps.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks with words, build devastating combos, and play through the first act with 2 of the 4 classes. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Guns of Eschaton Demo
apps.short_description: A one-of-a-kind soulslike FPS set in an apocalyptic Western. Study who hunts you, count every bullet, fight through death again and again in a standalone adventure crafted just for the demo and offering a concentrated taste of the full game.

apps.name: Hauntbound Demo
apps.short_description: An online and local multiplayer horror party game for 2 to 8 players. Explore a haunted house that builds itself, search for relics, avoid deadly traps, and compete in chaotic minigames before the haunt begins.

apps.name: Hauntworks Demo
apps.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

apps.name: Healing For Dummies Demo
apps.short_description:
Keep your party alive while also dealing with all the boss mechanics on your own. 
Master your build, master bosses, become a better healer. Get blamed when your party dies.
In this short little demo you will face 6 bosses and your job is simple - keep everyone alive.

apps.name: Heart Idler Demo
apps.short_description: Heart Idler is a  clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate collection of hearts?

apps.name: Hearth Fable Demo
apps.short_description: Hearth Fable — Ink-wash Chinese city-building sim. Start from a blank scroll: build trades, raise mythical beasts, defend your town, and paint your own mountain-sea utopia.

apps.name: HEAVYDELIC Demo
apps.short_description: HEAVYDELIC is a 2D Slavic Synthpunk Platformer broadcasting on dead frequencies. Synthetic psychedelia, comic art, VHS tapes, analog ruins & robots resurrected from Slavic mythology. Every asset is manually drawn by Eniac. Signal lost. Game found.

apps.name: Heritage Flipper Demo
apps.short_description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

apps.name: Hidden Cat Outlaws Demo
apps.short_description: Become the sheriff and catch all the wanted cats! Explore 3 levels. Find over 70 cats. Find 9 secrets. Fight 3 bosses. Have fun and relax. MEOW!

apps.name: Home Paige Demo
apps.short_description: Home Paige is a momentum-based 3D platformer set inside a 90s Operating System. You play as Paige, a silly, optimistic girl from your computer! ⭐

apps.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Transform a messy home into a cozy, beautifully organized space. Clean, arrange, and decorate every room your way—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and experience the joy of a fresh home in this demo.

apps.name: Honey 2 Orbit Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced futanari action rpg. Challenging mob encounters, bosses, puzzles, romance arcs, collectables, mini games, hentai scenes & more!

apps.name: Hoptale Demo
apps.short_description: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.

apps.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

apps.name: Human.exe Demo
apps.short_description: An AI has isolated the mind of a philosophy professor to evaluate human morality. As the terminal operator, you access files, run programs, and take his consciousness through ethical dilemmas.

apps.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath Demo
apps.short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

apps.name: Hyperlane Highway Demo
apps.short_description:
A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed.
Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards.
Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.

apps.name: I Only Moved My Mouse Demo
apps.short_description: Forty weapons, one mouse. Whirl a flail, throw a chakram, slam a warhammer: each run deals you three, and every one cuts its own way. Socket two more, raise them to FORGED, and hold the crystal through thirteen themes.

apps.name: Ichorous Demo
apps.short_description: The blood-splattering roguelike where you shred through enemies infested with Ichor. Use the blood you spill to heal and grow stronger! As you collect ichor for the god of blood, known only as The Patron, he will grant you upgrades that not only help you but also your enemies!

apps.name: Imagine Sisyphus Happy Demo
apps.short_description: Sisyphus is Streaming! A story-rich mixture of Streamer Simulator, Incremental game and Minigames about life, spectacle, and making the grind worth living. Push the boulder. Do tricks. Unlock new struggles. Choose your boulder, and try to Imagine Sisyphus Happy!

apps.name: Imperium of the Stars Demo
apps.short_description: Build an empire, govern worlds, and command fleets in a single-player Gothic real-time 4X. Play as the Imperium for 50 in-game years with the Balanced Game Director. Your decisions shape a campaign of rival powers, unfolding events, and crises.

apps.name: Impious Demo
apps.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

apps.name: Imprinted Demo
apps.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

apps.name: Improvised Tactics Demo
apps.short_description: Improvised Tactics is a single-player RTS focused on individual soldiers in a battlefield environment. You can command units directly or take control of them to achieve your objectives. The game offers multiple modes to keep gameplay fresh.

apps.name: In Full Bloom Demo
apps.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

apps.name: Infinite Borders: Three Kingdoms Demo
apps.short_description: 《万民长歌：三国》是一款单机 · 历史 · 战争策略游戏。在无缝连续、真实还原的3D沙盘地图上，玩家可以自选视角、以自己的意志重演三国。来体验真实的三国策略——真实的沙盘，真实的二十四节气，真实的百姓，真实的战争！

apps.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental Demo
apps.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

apps.name: Inner City Unit Demo
apps.short_description: Inner City Unit is a first person immersive sim about the narcotics trade in the surveillance city-state of Annexia. As an agent of an intelligence outfit, assume the identity of Albert Buchanan - part-time writer, part-time narcotics dealer. Procure product, push it across the city, don't get made.

apps.name: Invisum Piscium 嫌魚 Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a familiar world that can never be fully understood.

apps.name: Iron Void : Silent Space Demo
apps.short_description: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 120 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 10 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

apps.name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! Demo
Jet Birds Demo
apps.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

apps.name: Jet Scalawag: The King  of Shooters Demo
apps.short_description: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! In this demo, Jet Scalawag must shoot down the enemy fighters of the alien armada and survive their onslaught. Later features will involve the defence of earth's military forces and space station.

apps.name: Jubaku Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

apps.name: Kaiju Defense Project Demo
apps.short_description: Kaiju Defense Project is a strategy game set in a distant world where humanity is fighting to survive against hordes of giant monsters: the Kaijus. Research, manage, and strategically build your defenses to keep humanity alive on this planet. How much time does humanity have left?

apps.name: Kitaria Fables 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Join new heroes Alice and Dusty as they take their first steps into the wilds of the Arkadera Peninsula in the Kitaria Fables 2 demo! Get to know the locals of Whitewall Town, help them with their requests, and explore the breezy coastal lowlands, either alone or with a friend!

apps.name: Kitchen of Gods Demo
apps.short_description: Greece is starving! Build and manage your god-run tavérna along the road before Hades lures your people into the Underworld with promises of a full belly.

apps.name: Kleopatra Zero Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: the first two chapters, both bosses included. A fast-paced mech wave-shooter where every enemy attack is drawn on the floor before it lands, and the cards you pick between waves turn one hit into a cascade that clears the screen. A standalone prequel to Kleopatra.

apps.name: Knuckle Paradise Demo
apps.short_description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate seagull. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

apps.name: KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown- Demo
apps.short_description:
An Item-Building 2D Bullet Hell Shooter Has Arrived!
The unique “ENEMY ATTACK SELECT” system can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
To overcome the disadvantages you face, you’ll need to make smart choices and build the best loadout possible from limited resources.

apps.name: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering Demo
apps.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

apps.name: Kung Fu Waifus Demo
apps.short_description: As the heir of the fallen heretical sect Nimbus Citadel, you ally with novice kung fu apprentice Shinran. Your goal: dominate the martial world with the erotic cultivation techniques inherited from your masters! Prepare to shake the martial realm with cunning schemes...and love.

apps.name: Last Buzz Demo
apps.short_description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

apps.name: Last Convoy Demo
apps.short_description: Speed or firepower? Survive or dominate? Build your armored convoy car by car in this survivors-like auto-shooter. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

apps.name: Last Draft Demo
apps.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

apps.name: Last Stream Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of Last Stream, a 1–4 player online co-op horror game. Go live inside Grandpa's house, solve the puzzles hidden in his memories and keep your chat watching. But every clue you bring back makes him angrier. Run. Hide. Keep recording.

apps.name: Lead the Charge Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: lead Huo Qubing or Zhang Liao across the Mobei Steppe and the Western Regions. Fight beside your army, pick upgrade cards, switch formations and sound the charge. The full game adds 3 more commanders and 6 more battlefields.

apps.name: Leafborn Demo
apps.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

apps.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Demo
apps.short_description: No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!

apps.name: Life Blood Demo
apps.short_description: You awaken on the Altar inside the Life Cathedral. Life Blood is a first-person, Kingsfield-like action adventure game with a focus on exploration. Travel the interconnected world with fast-paced, reaction-based combat and discover the secrets within the heart of the mountain.

apps.name: LIMINAL Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an endless seeded world without maps or waypoints as you scavenge strange orbs, arm yourself at a hidden shop, and cross thresholds into 47 impossible realms of surreal architecture, destructible environments, and hostile creatures.

apps.name: Liminal Depths Demo
apps.short_description: A pixel liminal horror game about surviving an endless maze, recovering who you are, and escaping before the Depths take you. Explore procedural halls, complete jobs from the safehouse computer, upgrade your gear, and face monsters that hunt by sound, sight, and movement, solo or local split-screen.

apps.name: LINE WARLORD Demo
apps.short_description: Real-time line defense, played in roguelite runs. Spend rations to send units to the front, pick relics between fights, and destroy the enemy base. Stacking relics, unit promotions, three commanders with their own ultimates.

apps.name: Literally A Flying Brick Demo
apps.short_description:
"Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game.
The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

apps.name: Little Drone TuTuTu Demo
apps.short_description: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.

apps.name: Little Elementals Demo
apps.short_description:
A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human!

The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental
secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison!

Who came to rescue them?
Can they escape and reach the human world?

Join the little elementals on their adventure!

apps.name: Loading Dock Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Play your first days on the loading dock for free. Sort incoming boxes into rolltainers by area, track down misplaced boxes with your PDA, and hire your first staff. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players, about 2 hours of play. Wishlist the full game to get notified at launch!

apps.name: Lode Builder Demo
apps.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

apps.name: Lofi Cozy Room Demo
apps.short_description: A transparent mini-room in a corner of your desktop and gentle Lo-Fi music to make your work time cozier. Try every feature of Lofi Cozy Room ahead of launch with the demo.

apps.name: Log Drop Demo
apps.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

apps.name: Londya Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own combat styles in a single-player action RPG. Level up to unlock new attacks and evolve your styles as enemies learn your fighting patterns. Protect Londya on the road to the Lond, and adapt before your own habits become your downfall.

apps.name: Long Way Gnome Demo
apps.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

apps.name: Loop Apartment: Visitor Demo
apps.short_description: You visit an old friend, but Room 305 is empty - and the hallway outside has changed. Explore a shifting apartment through a retro interface, gather clues, and face tabletop RPG–style dice checks. Each time you lose consciousness, the building reshapes itself. Your clues carry over to the next loop.

apps.name: Lost Camp Demo
apps.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

apps.name: Louloudi Asteri Demo
apps.short_description: Switch between two fighter aces in this 3D side-scrolling shooter! Roll your ship to rotate the screen, revealing gaps in enemy fire and terrain. Life regenerates over time, and the frontal shield blocks all fire. Lock on, use special weapons, and sidestep through 3D space to save the solar system!

apps.name: Lucky Coin Pusher Demo
