apps.short_description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

apps.name: M.E.C.H.A. Demo
apps.short_description: The android girl spends her time in four walls, afraid to leave her apartment, but one day her patience runs out and she decides to go out the door.

apps.name: Magic Moon Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

apps.name: MagicKingdom Demo
apps.short_description:
Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat.
You control a hero, command a powerful army, unleash devastating magic, build formidable defenses, and manage resource gathering to withstand relentless enemy assaults.
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

apps.name: Magnetic Catch Demo
apps.short_description: A magnet fishing adventure about rusty scrap and hidden wonders. Clean your finds and upgrade your gear to explore murky city canals, countryside lakes, and forgotten places, where every pull brings a little surprise.

apps.name: Malignus Demo
apps.short_description: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

apps.name: Medieval Ascendant Demo
apps.short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

apps.name: Medovox Demo
apps.short_description: Play the Medovox demo! It's an atmospheric sandbox and farming simulator with cozy graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Buy cars, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world. Experience the gameplay right now and add the full version of the game to your wishlist!

apps.name: Memoria Wake Demo
apps.short_description: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this Souls-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.

apps.name: MeowRig Demo
apps.short_description:
MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game.
Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

apps.name: Merc Commander Demo
apps.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

apps.name: Metal Coffin Demo
apps.short_description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

apps.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

apps.name: MindGate CornerGet Demo
apps.short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: MINESWEEPER ARCADE Demo
apps.short_description: A classic Minesweeper that also incorporates many modern gameplay elements.

apps.name: Mithril Demo
apps.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

apps.name: Mokomon: Five Elements Demo
apps.short_description: A Roguelike Auto Battler focused on creature taming and evolution. Choose your Tamer, master the Five Elements system, and break the game by discovering new evolutions and insane synergies to annihilate hordes, defeat bosses, and outmatch other players' builds.

apps.name: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo
apps.short_description: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo allows you to enjoy the game from the prologue up until you complete the ‘To the Forest’ mission.

apps.name: Moorhuhn Kart 4 Demo
apps.short_description: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack!  Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

apps.name: Motocross The Force Demo
apps.short_description: Motocross The Force is a physics-driven motocross game that's easy to pick up and hard to master. Race online, push your limits, and chase the perfect lap.
developers: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
publishers: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

apps.name: Mowed Down Demo
apps.short_description: A multiplayer prop hunt where the hunter drives a lawnmower. Hide as anything from a safety cone to a giant toilet, score only while a mower can see you, and come back as a mower or a ghost when you're caught. Free demo: the Backyard and the Haunted Manor, online lobbies of up to 6, and solo vs AI.

apps.name: MR. RECORDS Demo
apps.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

apps.name: Murder Meet Cute Demo
apps.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

apps.name: MVX: London Demo
apps.short_description: Save London in a shared-world co-op shooter set in a 1:1 recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons and mysterious Flux powers.

apps.name: Mystery House Demo
apps.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

apps.name: Necrofinity Demo
apps.short_description: Raise an ever-growing undead army. Put your skeletons to work. Conquer new regions and expand your necropolis! Death is only the beginning in this dark fantasy incremental game. There's work to do...

apps.name: Netherworld: Blood Moon Demo
apps.short_description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

apps.name: Nioh 3 Demo
apps.short_description: In the third game in the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh, you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open field.

apps.name: No Dead Ends Demo
apps.short_description: You died. Congratulations! Now you’re at the No Dead Ends Bar, and the Barman owns your soul. The price for freedom? $1,000,000. Gamble with the deceased, beat their games, and buy back your soul!

apps.name: No Mercy Demo
apps.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

apps.name: No One Left To Die Demo
NO SUNRISE Demo
apps.short_description: Survive twelve zombie waves in an abandoned cinema, alone or in co-op with up to four players. Buy weapons, repair barricades and unlock more rooms. This NO SUNRISE Alpha demo ends after wave 12 and includes German and English in-game text.

apps.name: No Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers across Camp Crestwood, unlock nine brutal weapons, weaponize a fully destructible map, and survive an escalating response in this free playable slice of No Survivors. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

apps.name: NODE: PROTOCOL Demo
apps.short_description: A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back. Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

apps.name: Nonogram Detective Demo
apps.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

apps.name: Northern Saga Demo
apps.short_description:
Northern Saga is an old-school real-time strategy RPG inspired by classics like Ogre Battle.

Command your clan across real-time battlefields, construct specialized combat formations, and master combat where every positioning choice matters.

apps.name: Number Machine: Math Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

apps.name: Nutshot Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

apps.name: ODD ODDS Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

apps.name: Office Manager Demo
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

apps.name: Office Party Tech Demo
apps.short_description: Get a first look at Office Party’s technology, gameplay, and graphics in this early Tech Demo of a story-rich 3D comedy adventure. Meet characters, explore, and try optional AI interactions in a limited preview of a game still in development.

apps.name: Oh Shear! Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

apps.name: One Mind Demo
apps.short_description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you control two characters in different locations, each facing their own challenges. Navigate through obstacles, solve interconnected puzzles, and coordinate their actions carefully — every move to help one could put the other in danger.

apps.name: One Second Hero Demo
apps.short_description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

apps.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword DEMO
Online Boxing 3D Demo
apps.short_description:
A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. 
Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

apps.name: Origins Trading Card Game Demo
apps.short_description: Outplay rivals in a fast PvP card game where both players move at once. Adapt your strategy and battle for three of 100+ rotating locations. Build decks with reimagined legends like Robin Hood and Mulan. Every competitive card is free. Rip packs for rare, limited-edition variants to trade on Steam.

apps.name: Outpour Demo
apps.short_description: Outpour is a puzzle game where you redirect flowing water across dreamy cathedral rooftops. Manipulate your surroundings to guide a dynamic water system, traverse high places, and restore harmony to sacred structures.

apps.name: P2W : The Party Show Demo
apps.short_description:
"Forget skills—buy your way to victory!"

<P2W: The Party Show> is a chaotic multiplayer party game where cash is king. Grab gold in hilarious minigames and shop for overpowered items to wreck your rivals. Ready to test your friendships? In this flashy show, the deepest pockets win it all!

apps.name: Pain-Hatching Demo
apps.short_description: Metroidvania, exploring, a deep story and characters, RPG elements, deck and stat-building. Imagine if Fur Fighters, American McGee’s Alice, and Dark Souls merged into one game.

apps.name: Palisade Demo
apps.short_description: Command territory directly with no squads to micromanage. Try Palisade’s real time strategy in a free solo campaign with three linked battles. Expand across the Nordic countries, land in Britain, and fight for the Seine.

apps.name: Panic Pub Demo
apps.short_description: Run a pub with up to 4 friends. Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up. As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, dishes, and tougher nights!

apps.name: Party Club: Hangry Animals Demo
apps.short_description:
A chaotic party game for up to 4 players online, on the couch, and across platforms.
Jump into ridiculous mini-games, betray your friends equally on every device, and embrace the madness.

apps.name: PatchWorld Demo
apps.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

apps.name: Pathogen Demo
apps.short_description:
The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens.
You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late.
Will you make it out alive?

apps.name: Pathogenic Demo
apps.short_description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

apps.name: Pawn Pleasure Demo
apps.short_description: Step into a world populated entirely by women as the owner of your own shop. Buy low, sell high, and build your shop. When the  price isn't enough, "negotiate" intimate deals to seal the trade. Expand your business, hire beautiful staff, and explore a city where every encounter leads to pleasure.

apps.name: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Build your first mining camp in this free First Crew demo. Start with hand tools and no cash, pan and sell your first gold, improve your tools and hire a helper. Choose a man or woman prospector, bring Pepper and keep exploring after the first-crew milestone.

apps.name: Penko Vox: Japanese Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Penko Vox: Japanese. Start your voyage in Hajimari Town: talk to residents in your own words, call them by voice, catch word spirits on Route 1 and get gentle corrections, all fully offline on your PC. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: PENTO Demo
apps.short_description: Five blocks instead of four change everything. Rotate and place pentominoes, clear lines, and learn to read the board in a whole new way. Chase high scores, take on different challenges, or unwind with music in your own neon lounge.

apps.name: Pick a Part Demo
apps.short_description:
Clean dirty items and sell them to the locals, in the post-post-apocalyptic world of Pick a Part!
Join Sprout, the newcomer of a small island, where she has to manage her store and gain the trust of the town.

apps.name: Picker Magnate Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

apps.name: Pigeon: A Love Story Demo
apps.short_description: Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything.

apps.name: Pikapo Demo
apps.short_description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

apps.name: Pine Creek Demo
apps.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror demo set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986.

apps.name: PITCHFORK Demo
apps.short_description: An online co-op dungeon crawler where up to 4 unqualified peasants climb an ever-changing castle to slay the local vampire. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, avoid traps, and make sure somebody keeps that torch lit.

apps.name: Pixel Sorter Factory Demo
apps.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

apps.name: Pizza Turbo Demo
apps.short_description:
A pizza box on wheels. A deadly city. Zero margin for error.
A high-speed arcade racing game where you chain together tricks, use power-ups, and survive the chaos—nuclear explosions, UFOs, and guys dressed as pineapples—before your pizza gets cold.

apps.name: Plague Lords Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

apps.name: Plamo Kits Demo
apps.short_description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

apps.name: Poly Fighter Demo
apps.short_description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title! Meet 4 playable characters in this demo!

apps.name: Pool of Madness Demo
apps.short_description:
A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals.
Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

apps.name: popwork 职场爆爆乐 Demo
apps.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

apps.name: Power Network Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Power Network Tycoon is a physics based power grid simulation game where you build and maintain a high-voltage power network. Build power infrastructure, monitor resources, research upgrades, adapt to environmental challenges, keep up with energy demands and protect your island community!

apps.name: Powerplay Demo
apps.short_description: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

apps.name: Prison Fury Demo
apps.short_description: A co-op puzzle game built to make you and your friend argue, laugh, and celebrate. Two players on opposite sides of a prison — every puzzle requires both of you, or neither of you escapes."

apps.name: Project RedTeam: Contract Offensive Demo
apps.short_description: A fast paced hacking roguelite built on real cybersecurity tradecraft. Recon targets, steal creds, move laterally, exfiltrate data, and ransom organizations to pay off your "Debts To Be Paid". Over 500 cards and items to discover. High risk, high reward. Unauthorized access hell.

apps.name: Project SEVER Demo
apps.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

apps.name: Project Solaris Demo
apps.short_description:
[Project Solaris] is a roguelite RPG in which "Solaris", a failed witch, aims to become a full-fledged mage with her little sidekick, "Homu". 
Train Homu, build a relationship of trust, and overcome the trials that await you in 100 days!

apps.name: Project: Autumn Demo
apps.short_description: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

apps.name: Protos Magos Demo
apps.short_description: Unleash powerful spells in a medieval-themed boomer shooter and blast through waves of enemies. Customize your loadout and explore a vast world full of danger and magic.

apps.name: Prototech Demo
apps.short_description: Be careful, in the darkness there are surveillance robots ready to kill you at any time. Will you discover the strangeness and secrets behind Prototech's presence at the school.

apps.name: PSYCHO DEAD Demo
apps.short_description: Uncover a chilling third-person survival horror adventure. Take the role of a girl with psychic powers, desperate to escape a secret lab while pursued by deadly stalkers. The demo includes the game’s opening sequence.

apps.name: Punch Upon a Time Demo
apps.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

apps.name: Quartermark Demo
apps.short_description: The first 100 floors of Quartermark. Your party fights on its own — you decide who is in it and what they carry. Everything you earn here carries into the full game.

apps.name: Queen's Domain Demo
apps.short_description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

apps.name: Quiet Time Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the first two days of Quiet Time, an atmospheric survival crafting game where every sound matters. Explore, gather, craft, and use music to awaken the world, influence creatures, and survive.

apps.name: Radiotext Demo
apps.short_description: Rise against the corporate overlords and become a cyber activist hacker. Join the uprising in a cyberpunk world using radio waves.

apps.name: Ragnarok Roads Demo
apps.short_description:
Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle
  battles on frozen roads. This is a retro-style strategy game, rewarding the planning, perceptive and persistent players, like games used to be.

apps.name: Rain98 Demo
apps.short_description: This is the demo version of Rain98. Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

apps.name: Ramen Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: This game puts you in the shoes of a new ramen shop owner. Experience a preview of what’s to come. Prepare your shop, cook and serve great bowls of ramen and decorate and customize your restaurant.

apps.name: RAT TAG! Demo
apps.short_description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

apps.name: Real Zombie Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

apps.name: Really Illegal Golf Demo
apps.short_description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your club membership ban & wreak havoc at courses across the city with your friends. Hide from security, defend yourself with a customisable arsenal, and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

apps.name: Realm Tycoons Demo
apps.short_description: Build a fantasy realm in an eight-week Crown Trial. Roll across the board, capture valuable properties, recruit armies, and choose strategies for automatic real-time 3D battles. Play solo against AI or challenge friends in local hot-seat campaigns.

apps.name: Red Father Demo
apps.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

apps.name: REOGUNA Demo
apps.short_description:
This is the demo version of "REOGUNA." You can try out the tutorial, the early stages, and a portion of the level editor.
Stage completion data can be carried over to the full version.

apps.name: Revenant Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, steal bosses’ skills, and even take their bodies to become evil incarnate.

apps.name: Ridiculous Space Battles Demo
apps.short_description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

apps.name: Rise of the Merchants Demo
apps.short_description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

apps.name: Risewards Demo
apps.short_description: Solve tons of puzzles using logic, physics and (why not) by tricking the game itself. Sometimes the solution may be obvious to you, other times you'll need to think outside the box to progress, or maybe hack your own way to skip a puzzle. Just don't fall into the void... unless you should? ;)

apps.name: Roads & Riches Demo
apps.short_description: Hit the road with your merchant caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

apps.name: Rock and Found Demo
apps.short_description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through hundreds of rocks.

apps.name: Rogue Shapes Demo
apps.short_description: Rogue Shapes is a fast-paced roguelike bullet hell where you battle waves of deadly shapes, level up, and choose powerful upgrades. Complete challenges to unlock new playable shapes, each with unique weapons. How long can you survive the chaos?

apps.name: Rollamon Demo
apps.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

apps.name: Rollin' Rascal Demo
apps.short_description: Rollin’ Rascal is a high-speed action platformer that will test your reflexes and creativity as you zoom through a whimsical world in search of adventure!

apps.name: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator Demo
Rotten Chamber Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

apps.name: Ruffed Up Demo
apps.short_description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

apps.name: Run TavernQuest Demo
apps.short_description: A classic text adventure - but you're not the one playing it. You're the game master for an idiot player named STEVE. Parse the player's enigmatic commands and decide how NPCs react to him. Who knew that running an RPG would be so frustrating?

apps.name: Rune Dice Demo
apps.short_description: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

apps.name: RUNTIME Demo
apps.short_description: Dash through refill chains, flip gravity and slip past lasers in RUNTIME, a precision platformer. Play four selected chapters and race a friend on two courses, with previews of the full game’s Time Trials, level editor and cosmetic collection.

apps.name: RV Life Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Drive, customize, and live in your camper as you explore an open world full of adventure.

apps.name: Scar of Evil Demo
apps.short_description: The power cut off, the house need to be repowered, could you survive whiles multiples threats tries to come inside you're home while keeping the circuit breaker from breaking

apps.name: Scared by Squares Demo
apps.short_description: Play all of Floor 01 in this free co-op horror demo. Explore alone or with up to three friends, solve puzzles, cleanse corruption with your flashlight, and survive the Cube. Just don’t be scared by squares.

apps.name: Seal Way Demo
apps.short_description: Always dreamed of knowing what it feels like to be a seal, but life keeps getting in the way of basking in the sun and eating fish? Here’s your chance! Explore the aquarium, solve puzzles, avoid dangers, and find your way home. We offer you a colorful world, mesmerizing scenery, and much more!

apps.name: Sealing Fallout Demo
apps.short_description: A fusion reactor has blown up and it's up to sealkind to save Earth from the ensuing Runaway Electron Avalanche! Group up with up to 6 fellow seals to fix the reactor before the seventh day ends. The AI Adam predicts your failure, prove it wrong and blow it up.

apps.name: Selfie Worm Demo
apps.short_description: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a built-in "Anti-Boss Mode" and Focus Timer, it turns work breaks into healing times.

apps.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co. Demo
apps.short_description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

apps.name: Sentient Core: Nanite Idle Demo
apps.short_description: Build a nanite swarm and watch an AI wake up in the noise. The Mind talks, bets, remembers and dreams, and she has a story of her own. She never sells you anything. The Works, Space Dock and the Spire come with the full game, and your progress carries over.

apps.name: She Was King Demo
apps.short_description: A dark, witchy pixel-art RPG dungeon crawler about hexed bonds, curious creatures, and finding your way home. Run, as fast as you can. Can you outfox what's coming, or will you let it consume you?

apps.name: Shoot The Cat Demo
apps.short_description: A precision-based game where every shot has to be perfect. The targets? Extremely mischievous cats. Don't worry—here, hitting them is an act of affection.

apps.name: Sil and the Fading World Demo
apps.short_description: Solo Challenging Raid Bosses, Your Way! Craft your perfect build to master intense multi-phase raidboss encounters in this exciting ARPG. Deep customization with 9 specializations, 100s of items, skills and more. No Group, No Queue, All Boss Raids!

apps.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

apps.name: SKINFACE Demo
apps.short_description: SKINFACE is a short-and-punchy stealth game where you embody a faceless hitman who needs to steal the faces of others to gain the trust of their target. Set in dark soviet-era apartment complexes, evade the police and get your victim to open up the door for you. Knock, knock!

apps.name: Skingdom Demo
apps.short_description: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

apps.name: Skull Crusher Demo
apps.short_description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

apps.name: Skullf! Demo
apps.short_description:
You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf!

After yet another hilarious night terrorizing locals, it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

apps.name: SLASH//SYNC Demo
apps.short_description: SLASH//SYNC is a rhythm action game where your mouse movement becomes the blade. Slice notes racing down five lanes from the indicated direction. Chase high scores and full combos as every slash bursts into light, and experience the thrill of perfect synchronization—all with a mouse.

apps.name: Slot & Dungeons Demo
apps.short_description:
"Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots.
While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

apps.name: Small Fry Demo
apps.short_description: Cook any meal you can imagine! Invent new ways to delight your customer’s taste buds, refine your menu to use your ingredients efficiently, and put it all together without missing an order. Unlock new ingredients and kitchen gadgets to create more and more perfect culinary creations.

apps.name: Soliton Burst Demo
apps.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

apps.name: Soulful Slide Demo
apps.short_description: A comfy and cozy sliding ice puzzle game with the twist of throwing snow along the path to solve puzzles. Featuring a combination of tranquil music and colorful art to bring in peaceful winter vibes. Collect gifts within levels to customize your own snowman as well.

apps.name: Space Slinger Demo
apps.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

apps.name: SpaceSlog Demo
apps.short_description: In this demo version of SpaceSlog, you must build a functioning spaceship ready to explore the cosmos while ensuring the needs of your crew are met. The survival of your crew heavily depends on how well your ship is designed and managed.

apps.name: Split Brain Samsara Demo
apps.short_description:
You and your friend are locked in the same body! 

In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

apps.name: Spray to Grail Demo
apps.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

apps.name: Starless Umbra Demo
apps.short_description: Starless Umbra is a story-rich action RPG inspired by the best of classic and modern JRPGs. Engage in real-time combat and explore puzzle-filled dungeons in a couch co-op adventure where friendship and loyalty are tested in a world consumed by a noxious fog.

apps.name: Stars of Icarus Demo
apps.short_description: From the creators of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Form your team and pilot, repair, and man the guns on your ship. Victory or death, together.

apps.name: Stay With Me! Alien Abduction Story Demo
apps.short_description: Psychological Horror game, seek how to survive this strange encounter with beings from another world

apps.name: STELLAR WING Demo
apps.short_description: The STELLAR WING demo. Knock out the enemy carrier's turrets, bring down its shield generators, then break open the core. Play from flight training through the first three campaign missions, a 4v4 carrier assault and a hunt for the Sentinel, a giant mechanical creature.

apps.name: Stepwell Demo
apps.short_description: Stepwell is a microscopic dimension where you build optical illusions that defy the laws of physics. Snap together impossible geometry to create twisting, mind-bending paths for your Quarks. Relax in a vibrant, zen-like puzzle, and watch your creations come alive as a hypnotic, bustling colony.

apps.name: Stick A Fork Demo
apps.short_description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, smash the fruit into jam, Ascend, and watch the table get busier every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

apps.name: StickType Demo
apps.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

apps.name: Stormforge Demo
apps.short_description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

apps.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.

apps.name: Stupid Never Dies: First Bite Demo
apps.short_description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

apps.name: Sudokiller Demo
apps.short_description: Sudokiller Demo is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

apps.name: Sunset Devils Demo
apps.short_description:
Sunset Devils is a top-down action shooter, Where every weapon's unique controls must be mastered through the thrill of an old west gunfight. 
A classic spaghetti western story of vengeance, portrayed in stylish pixel art.

apps.name: Super Mining Mechs Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

apps.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die Demo
apps.short_description: Run a supernatural supermarket serving zombies and vampires! In this demo, stock your shelves, set your prices, and work the checkout. Receive UFO deliveries, stop goblin thieves with your shoe, and keep your shop running.

apps.name: SUPERPANEL DEMO
apps.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

apps.name: Swarmslam Demo
apps.short_description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

apps.name: System Arrival Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down action RPG that combines dangerous expeditions into the outside world with bunker building, management, and defense against relentless attacks.

apps.name: Taiyi Saga Demo
apps.short_description:
A roguelike deck-building adventure set across multiple worlds corrupted by unknown forces.  
Each world offers unique mechanics — from cultivation and martial arts to steampunk machinery and cosmic horror.

apps.name: Tamzin Twins Demo
apps.short_description: A story based action RPG with split screen co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will discover what it means to be leaders, to be chivalrous, and how to be queens.

apps.name: TCG Shop Life Demo
apps.short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

apps.name: TCG: Collector’s Mess Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first rooms of TCG: Collector’s Mess, a cozy first-person collecting game in a house buried under trading cards. Clean up the bedroom, hall, bathroom and laundry, open packs card by card and fill your binders. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Three days behind the counter of a traditional Turkish tea house. Brew cay, grill toasties, run trays out to the shopkeepers on the street, and keep the okey corner from turning into a fight. Around half an hour, online co-op for 1-6 players, and the first day teaches you everything.

apps.name: Temple of Glyphs Demo
apps.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

apps.name: Temtem: Swarm Demo
apps.short_description: Can you Survive the Swarm? Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

apps.name: Test Fire: Armor Penetration Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Real engineering simulation with any projectile, any target, any material. Test Fire is an armor penetration sandbox with a campaign of engineering challenges and an open sandbox editor for making (and breaking!) whatever you want.

apps.name: Thalassomania Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op PS1 horror on a North Sea trawler for 1-4 players. Fish, steer through the storm, keep the engine alive and watch the cameras while the jobs split you up. There's one more aboard than there should be, and you'll hear it before you see it.

apps.name: The  Drawratos Demo
apps.short_description: Draw on cards, bluff, and outplay your opponents in poker games for up to 4 players. In The Drawratos, you’ll have to pass off your drawn cards as real ones so everyone believes you’ve got a strong hand.

apps.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings Demo
The Cup: Creature Card Battler Demo
apps.short_description: The demo of The Cup, a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler. Play THE ROAD: five cases against invasive species, back to back. Draft as you go, and a creature knocked out is gone for the road. Learn from the booth in one tutorial match, then take on the House. Plays fully offline.

apps.name: The Day I Started Harvesting Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game where a simple harvest grows into something far stranger. Expand your fields, hire workers, and survive pests, storms, and bizarre events as your peaceful routine slowly turns into chaos.

apps.name: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo
apps.short_description: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo is a Demo build of a Tactical Autobattler Roguelike where you build an army of monsters, upgrade them and combine their unique abilities and affinities to create powerful teams and defend your dungeon against waves of adventurers. Stop them all!

apps.name: The Ember Guardian Demo
apps.short_description: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

apps.name: The Fight for Beardlandia Demo
apps.short_description: An auto-battler roguelike gacha. Recruit your party, min-max their builds, and stack class synergies as you drag eight recruits thirty waves deep. Gear them up, roll for heroes, and bring down Hjorvan, the Frostfather. Free demo for The Fight for Beardlandia.

apps.name: The Grander Demo
apps.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

apps.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410 Demo
apps.short_description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

apps.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM! Demo
apps.short_description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

apps.name: The Infinite Library Demo
apps.short_description: Write words, fill shelves, and push the Weight of Knowledge to its first fold in this free demo. Six genres, rare Word discovery, undocumented Phrase crafting - and a library that's starting to notice you. The demo ends where the strangeness begins. Wishlist the full game.

apps.name: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall Demo
The Manaworks Demo
apps.short_description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

apps.name: The Membrane Demo
apps.short_description: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

apps.name: The Ninth Witch’s Jail Demo
apps.short_description: The Ninth Witch's Jail is an anomaly-hunt game with a crunchy retro aesthetic set in the Medieval era. Spot the signs of curses or witchcraft in the prison to break out of an endless loop, continue your exploration and confront the ninth witch.

apps.name: The Precinct Demo
apps.short_description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

apps.name: The Primeval Demo
apps.short_description: The Primeval is a survival horror game in which players take on the role of Runchan, a newly arrived transfer student, searching for a way to escape from a school overrun by out-of-control experimental subjects.

apps.name: The Runesmith Demo
apps.short_description: Explore ancient lands, gather rare materials, and forge powerful runes blessed by mighty gods. Craft, hunt, mine, and master the art of runesmithing: a fallen god’s path to reclaim his place among the divine.

apps.name: The Shadow Crown - Frostwynd Chronicles Demo
apps.short_description: Play Act 1 of The Shadow Crown free. Explore Eldergrove village and the Dark Forest, battle goblins, bandits and corrupted beasts, and find the key to the iron door beneath the ancient ruins. A retro text adventure in the spirit of the 1980s classics.

apps.name: The Shaman Diary Demo
apps.short_description:
A story-driven turn-based RPG with deep strategy and rich gameplay.
Explore a vast heroic fantasy world, master skills, gear up, and forge your own path.
The Ravagers are closing in. Will you protect Astreia?
Experience the opening chapters of an epic story inspired by a 650-page original novel.

apps.name: The Studio - Indie Grind Demo
apps.short_description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up the post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.

apps.name: The Unbreakable Gumball - Demo
apps.short_description: An open-world superhero game set inside of a comic book!  Jump, swing, and glide your way around the city of the future!

apps.name: The Well's Blessing Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the mystical Sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

apps.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand Demo
apps.short_description: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

apps.name: Thousands of Chroma Demo
apps.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

apps.name: Tidy Pills Demo
apps.short_description: Step behind the counter of a quiet little pharmacy and bring order to its shelves. Sort, stack and arrange medicines one box at a time in this cozy organizing game. No timers, no pressure, just the simple joy of a perfectly tidy shelf.

apps.name: Tidy Tech Demo
apps.short_description: Bring a cluttered tech shop back to life, one gadget at a time. Try the opening Stockroom and Peripheral Plaza, sort scattered gear into place, and enjoy a little company from BLIP in this relaxed taste of Tidy Tech.

apps.name: Tidy Up Together: Banknotes Demo
apps.short_description: Try Tidy Up Together: Banknotes. Pick up scattered bundles, recognize each design, and place matching notes in any open spot on their shelf. Learn sorting tools as you go, then fill the cabinets at your own pace.

apps.name: Tie Down Demo
apps.short_description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

apps.name: Tiny Ramen Shop Demo
apps.short_description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

apps.name: TOP STEED Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

apps.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion Demo
apps.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

apps.name: Totally Normal Ramen Demo
apps.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

apps.name: TRACE Demo
apps.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

apps.name: Train of Thought Demo
apps.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

apps.name: Tropico 7 - Demo
apps.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

apps.name: Trupki Demo
apps.short_description: Try 23 levels of Trupki for free. Slide rows and columns, form the target shape and find your next “aha!” moment. Play with mouse, keyboard or a compatible controller, in a window or borderless fullscreen. Choose from 24 languages.

apps.name: Tuanbot Demo
apps.short_description: Create desktop companions, discover little stories in Tuan House, and enjoy playful moments with Feihuahua. Link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts. This free TuanBot demo supports up to 3 companions and does not include AI chat.

apps.name: Twilight Requiem Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the opening chapter of Twilight Requiem, a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by classic fast-paced combat systems. Battle through a cursed realm, unlock powerful abilities, and face your first major boss in this playable demo.

apps.name: Undertaker Demo
apps.short_description:
The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns.
As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary.
Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

apps.name: Underveil Demo
apps.short_description:
Experience a new roguelike deckbuilder with no Energy and Spatial Strategy.
Your board is your Energy. Expand your board and engrave powerful effects. Fuse two cards to create new ones, then rotate and place them in limited space. Build your cards, shape your board, and make it uniquely yours.

apps.name: UVSU Demo
apps.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

apps.name: Uyar Party Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into the chaos of Uyar Party! Compete in fast-paced minigames, outplay your rivals, and survive unpredictable arenas with up to 8 players online or against AI. The demo gives you a taste of the full party experience.

apps.name: Vale's Echo Demo
apps.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

apps.name: Vampine: New Order Demo
apps.short_description: Awaken to a world ruled by the Intelligences and reclaim your honor! A turn-based strategy roguelike deckbuilder where you lead a vampire rebellion, bonds powerful servants, craft tactical card decks, and combine unique abilities to outsmart your enemies.

apps.name: VantGrid Demo
apps.short_description: Join one friend who owns VantGrid for free. Chat, join their calls and groups, and watch their shared screen. Friend Pass is a guest experience, not the full application.

apps.name: Verto Demo
apps.short_description: Drop blocks, match colors, rotate everything. This puzzle game adds mind-bending board rotation to classic gameplay. Choose from timed challenges or endless modes, and compete for high scores. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

apps.name: Vibe Train Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

apps.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

apps.name: Void In The Darkness Demo
apps.short_description: Here the enemy doesn't just fight — the enemy writes the rules. Mid-battle, the very laws of war are rewritten, and what was your advantage a moment ago becomes a trap. Summon your army, choose its ground, and turn those rules against the one who wrote them.

apps.name: Void Inc Demo
apps.short_description: Try 14 in-game days of a darkly funny workplace management sim with creeping horror. Plan the workload, clear emails to the beat, and decide who gets the coffee. Keep the CEO happy and your sanity intact. You're on the schedule too.

apps.name: Void Walkers X64 Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on a classic 2D overhead RPG adventure inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Forge your destiny across five distinct progression paths, master tactical combat, and explore a world where your choices unlock powerful hybrid classes.

apps.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite Demo
apps.short_description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies and hold the line across the demo's first three biomes.

apps.name: War Asunder Demo
apps.short_description: A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades.

apps.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Sort thousands of scattered products into boxes and onto the right shelves. This free demo gives you two full warehouses to work through — clean a small one end to end, or take a shift inside the 4,000-product mega warehouse. No timers, no failing.

apps.name: Warpack Demo
apps.short_description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

apps.name: Wasteland Bites Demo
apps.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

apps.name: Watch Party: Watch the web together Demo
We Are Rebellion Demo
apps.short_description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

apps.name: WE'RE ALL IN! Demo
apps.short_description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

apps.name: Welcome to Harmony Demo
apps.short_description: Build your timeline, execute your plan, and survive Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

apps.name: What Hides in Dreams Demo
apps.short_description: To the now sleeping self...welcome back. Face the horrors only a sleeping mind can conjure in the demo to the first-person psychological horror adventure What Hides in Dreams, where death leaves scars.

apps.name: What the Buck?! Demo
apps.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Whiskers Tale Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a curious cat exploring a cozy city. Run errands, solve simple puzzles, make friends, and uncover heartwarming stories in a world full of charm, kindness, and quiet adventure.

apps.name: Whispering Green Demo
apps.short_description: Whispering Green is a cozy first-person magical horticulture. Explore enchanted woods, discover rare plants, and use your Arcane Gun to uncover secrets. Cultivate magical flora, brew powerful remedies, and grow your apothecary into a thriving business.

apps.name: Whodunit Sudoku Demo
apps.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

apps.name: Wild Hive Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! How long will your hive survive?

apps.name: WILD Tactics Demo
apps.short_description: A character-driven turn-based tactical strategy game where planning and positioning decide every fight. Lead a squad of wild agents with shady pasts through high-pressure missions, manage their relationships, and make hard calls that shape every operation in the crime-ridden city of Clawville.

apps.name: Wishknot Demo
apps.short_description: Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this dangerous physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

apps.name: Wizarducks and the Lost Hat Demo
WORKS: Motorsport Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Build a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design parts, repair cars and climb the ranks of motorsport. Tight finances and worn parts force tough choices: repair, upgrade or pay off debts to keep your team alive.

apps.name: Worldkampf '72 Demo
apps.short_description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

apps.name: Wrap House Simulator🌯 Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator Demo! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

apps.name: ZOMBUTCHER Demo
apps.short_description: Meat shop simulator where you play as a ZOMBIE! Sell meat to humans by day, butcher them by night, and manage a dark business through stealth and resource management all while eating BRA-A-A-INS!

apps.name: ぱちぱちタイピング Demo
apps.short_description:
A game that combines the excitement of pachinko’s ST mode with typing gameplay.
Score points by typing during bonus rounds in a score attack challenge!
A dictionary feature is planned for future implementation.

apps.name: フォーチュリア：交易路の開拓者 Demo
apps.short_description: This trial version allows you to play the small and medium maps in the standard versus mode with a 6-month time limit. It supports local play between human players and the computer. More content, including campaigns, LAN matches, and online matches, is available in the full version.

apps.name: プロレゴメナ およそ3分間の交信の先に現れるであろうきわめて超次元的なインターフェースのための序論 特別予備実験
apps.short_description: It's time to begin our preliminary experiment. My CommGear isn't fully operational yet, but I want to get started with what we have now. I'm looking forward to collaborating with you on this project.

apps.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines） Lite
apps.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

apps.name: マジッククリッカー Demo
冒牌英雄 Demo
apps.short_description: Fight alone or alongside friends as a cast of unconventional “heroes,” each with their own unique abilities. Battle endless waves of monsters, collect items, learn skills, choose talents, and create your own powerful build as you defeat mighty foes and fight your way!

apps.name: 出招吧师傅 Demo
apps.short_description: A Roguelike strategy deckbuilder where cards determine your moves. Each card becomes an attack, defense, movement, or special skill. Arrange cards wisely to trigger combos, deal more damage, and adapt to changing enemy attacks.

apps.name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ Demo
勇者喵傳說 Demo
apps.short_description:
MEOWBOUND LEGENDS is an idle RPG starring a cast of adventurous cats!

A group of cats finds themselves transported to another world, where they build a village of their own. They'll head out to fight monsters, collect equipment, and grow stronger—all on their own.

apps.name: 叠叠不休 Demo
apps.short_description: A card strategy game combining town building and dungeon adventures. Stack cards to manage your settlement, produce resources, battle enemies, and explore the unknown. Expand your floating island, collect treasures from the abyss, and lead your town toward greater prosperity.

apps.name: 咕咕嘎嘎-小企鹅 Demo
apps.short_description:
The little penguin that shakes its head and makes that goofy "GuGuGaGa" sound – a viral meme across the internet – has now come to your desktop!
Different interactions will trigger her unique reactions – after all, she is that very meme penguin with all those expressive emotes!

apps.name: 图灵之书 Demo
apps.short_description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

apps.name: 天空，草地，我的小鱼 Demo
孤岛：洪水之后 Demo
apps.short_description: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter. Your survival, your strategy.

apps.name: 安平 An-pêng：離群生存 Demo
崇祯模拟器 Demo
apps.short_description: 1644—the Ming Dynasty is collapsing. Rebels close on Beijing, Manchu armies at the gates, the treasury empty. As Chongzhen, China's last emperor, you command AI-driven ministers who flatter, scheme, and defy you. Rewrite history—or fall as the records say?

apps.name: 幸福里:生门 Demo
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game where every door is a decision. Read the clues, follow the rules, and choose carefully inside a research facility that rebuilds itself every run. Pick the wrong door—and whatever is waiting in the dark comes for you.

apps.name: 开拓物语 Demo
apps.short_description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

apps.name: 异世界火锅店模拟器 Demo
apps.short_description: Play a focused demo of a cozy hand-drawn hot pot restaurant sim in an isekai village. Plan the day's menu, buy and prepare ingredients, seat fantasy guests, manage the dinner rush, and use each night's results to decide the next step for your little shop.

apps.name: 恋しかるべき ～迷い家からの手紙～ 体験版
apps.short_description: Set in 1972 (Showa 47), this story follows a high school student on his yearly summer visit to his grandparents’ rural home. Spending quiet, nostalgic days with his sister and the villagers, he begins to believe this peaceful summer might last… until an encounter in the mountains changes everything.

apps.name: 文具大作战 Demo
apps.short_description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

apps.name: 楼兰王国 Demo
apps.short_description: Loulan Kingdom blends survival city-building with real-time strategy. As the ruler of Loulan, build your city in a procedurally generated desert oasis, prosper through trade along the Silk Road, and fight with all you have to defend your kingdom until the very end.

apps.name: 残存之物 Demo
apps.short_description: A survival crafting game set after an AI uprising. Stranded on a 4km × 4km island, you must gather resources, build shelter, and craft weapons to survive. Currently in early development, with core systems evolving and new content planned

apps.name: 浮块防线 Demo
apps.short_description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

apps.name: 海上有座极极岛 试玩版
apps.short_description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

apps.name: 神祇Pantheon Demo
apps.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

apps.name: 童年诡事录试玩版
apps.short_description: Rural Nostalgia, Chinese Horror, Classic Horror，Realistic 3D Graphics, Jump Scares, Chase Sequences, Psychological Horror, Logical Deduction, Mechanism Puzzles

apps.name: 红色史诗：抗战 Demo
apps.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

apps.name: 终末执棋者 Demo
apps.short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

apps.name: 荒山诡宿 Demo
apps.short_description: Horror vlogger Song Qian checks into a remote mountain inn after getting lost at night. Film footage, explore the aged inn, chat with odd guests — then face inexplicable events after dark. Demo includes the full first chapter, ~15-20 minutes of gameplay.

apps.name: 薪世录 测试版 Demo
apps.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

apps.name: 被困的芙瑞希雅 Demo
apps.short_description: The Demo version of Unfree Freesia. A narrative-driven game where Deduction meets the Dark Arts. Invest crime scenes for evidence and navigate the razor's edge between "Rationality" and "Inspiration." Unlock branching paths through your choices, and decide who survives the encroaching shadows.

apps.name: 轮回小队 Demo
apps.short_description: An "Infinite Genre" style game. Enter diverse worlds—featuring zombies, fantasy, martial arts, and more—either solo or with friends, then return to the "Main God" hub. Experiment with every imaginable ability.

apps.name: 迷失小镇 Demo
apps.short_description: Play as a maiden trapped in a foggy procedural town. Fight mutants with your starter weapon and collect glowing gems. Upgrade gear with gems to unlock new zones and random events: rewards, monster swarms, treasures, cursed trials. Level up for random magic cards;

apps.name: 迷宮下剋上 Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening of Devour & Evolve. Crawl a first-person dungeon as its weakest monster, weaken prey, then devour it or bind it as kindred. Evolve, build a nest, and challenge the first warden in this approximately 30-minute demo.

apps.name: 迷途梦境 Lost Dream Chronicle demo
apps.short_description: "Lost Dream Chronicle" is a 3D action RPG that merges campus life simulation with 3D diorama-style Metroidvania, rooted in dream psychology. Nan, a young rookie chemistry teacher,  finds herself trapped in a dangerous dream world. Fight through the dream, uncover secrets, and save the world!

apps.name: 铅雨 Demo
apps.short_description:
Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army.
You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

apps.name: 0101 - Sponsor
apps.short_description: If you think the game is worth it, you can buy this DLC to be a top sponsor! In addition, you will receive special star!

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Kansas
apps.short_description: Introducing Kansas! A U.S State that is home to a truly authentic cowboy culture and miles of land littered with wildflowers. Located in the Midwest of the USA, Kansas is known for its native grasslands, streams, abundant blue skies, and green grassland vistas.

apps.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – Prophecies of Ash
apps.short_description: Settle on the largest island in Latium, beneath a looming volcano. Its eruptions will force you to adapt. On this bountiful new land, discover a rare resource, bargain with a trader, and bow before a new deity.

apps.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – The Hippodrome
apps.short_description: Build the Hippodrome, host chariot races, and grow your splendor! Your citizens are crying out for more spectacle, and your specialists stand ready to prove themselves on the racetrack.

apps.name: Apewar - African Chimpanzee
apps.short_description: Unlock the African Chimpanzee and bring this intelligent, powerful, adaptable primate from the forests of Africa to APEWAR. Fight online with your new character and expand your primate collection!

apps.name: Apewar - Rhesus Monkey

apps.name: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
apps.short_description: Step right up! We’re searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

apps.name: Undertale + Deltarune Song Pack
apps.short_description: This DLC song pack brings 21 songs from the UNDERTALE and DELTARUNE Soundtracks to Trombone Champ!

apps.name: Unheard-FirstDLC-FREE
apps.short_description: The DLC "The Lethal Script" takes place in The Peak Hotel. Join the investigators as they enter The Peak Hotel and see how this deadly scenario plays out!

apps.name: WhiteClothes-Purify!
apps.short_description: ケモノの女の子がムチムチする系コマンドRPG、「WhiteClothes」がパワーアップしてついに完結！プレイ時間は本編合わせて80時間以上！笑いあり、涙あり、お腹いっぱい、胸いっぱいの冒険を続けよう！

apps.name: Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 2
apps.short_description: Play as former OSS agent and assassin, Jessica Valiant, AKA Agent Silent Death! Hot on the trail of a sinister plot, Valiant finds herself in the offices of Paragon Pictures, Tinseltown film studio turned Nazi propaganda machine.

apps.name: Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 3
apps.short_description: Gun down Nazi enemies as US Army Captain Gerald Wilkins! On the run since the Nazi war machine leveled Manhattan with an atom bomb, Wilkins returns home to reunite with an old comrade and dismantle the deadliest weapon ever made: the Sun Gun.

apps.name: World War Z x The Walking Dead
apps.short_description: A new crossover episode with AMC's The Walking Dead. Play as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and Negan as they fight through hordes of dangerous new slower-moving Walkers across The Prison, Alexandria Safe Zone and Grady Memorial Hospital.
