apps.name: Yokai Art 2: Adult Content Patch
apps.short_description: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.

apps.name: 夜巡守则 Part.2
apps.short_description: Players will explore the seven incredible night patrol rules on campus from the perspectives of five members, uncovering the terrifying truth behind mysterious and bizarre stories through investigation and selection.

apps.name: 1000 Rooms
apps.short_description: 1000 Rooms is a co-operative action horror FPS, that takes place across multiple worlds and realities. Kill countless hordes of the undead with over 1 MILLION weapons.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?"
A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You."
Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.
perhaps  "Imprison" is the only mercy.

apps.name: 2in1
apps.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

apps.name: 3DMOBA
apps.short_description: 3DMOBA is a third-person multiplayer arena game developed with Unreal Engine, inspired by classic third-person MOBA games. Choose from unique heroes, use skill-based abilities, fight against other players, and survive until the end to become the final victor.

apps.name: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！
apps.short_description: A baseball management simulation set in an alternate Japan where all 47 prefectures have pro teams. Choose one of 48 clubs and manage drafts, development, reinforcements, lineups, finances, and the road to the championship.

apps.name: 60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger
apps.short_description: In the atomic wasteland there is but one god: SOUP. Run fast, jump high, and scavenge like crazy, or there will be no soup for you. Survive the dangers of the postapocalypse, bring back all the soup you can find, and become the SOUPER SCAVENGER.

apps.name: 8ave.
apps.short_description:
『8ave.-Octave-』 is an 8-keyboard music game featuring a piano motif.
To focus solely on playing the keys, no special operations like flicks or slides are required.
The sheet music consists only of notes and long notes, allowing you to easily enjoy the feel of playing piano on a keyboard.

apps.name: 9 Fingers
apps.short_description: Play for cash. Pay with fingers. A dark card game of bluffs and counterbluffs. Face the boss solo or compete against a friend and the boss online. Use items and finger bonuses to reveal cards, steal bonuses and make a bluff harder to hide.

apps.name: 9 Layers of Hell
apps.short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you go?

apps.name: A Cat's Manor
apps.short_description: Trapped in a house inhabited by a crazed family, with a hand stitched on its tail. Solve puzzles, craft items & tools, survive deadly encounters, use force or outwit bosses, hide & use stealth. Survive long enough to escape the Manor and decide how it ends.

apps.name: A Short Odyssey
apps.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

apps.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
apps.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

apps.name: A Warm Story
apps.short_description:
Someone Seems to Be in “My” Room!

The renowned writer Koi wakes up in the middle of the night, but finds himself unable to fall back asleep…

apps.name: A-01的宇宙航行日记
apps.short_description: 人类已经死去。一个在宇宙里漂流的人工智能，在无法自杀的绝对清醒中，咀嚼庞大而无处安放的算力，独自面对整个宇宙的衰亡。

apps.name: A.I.M. War Protocol
apps.short_description: A role-playing game with survival and action-simulation elements. You are going to explore a huge world of an alien planet full of mysteries and secrets. Fight, trade, loot, evolve and collect knowledge about the world. Become the best. Survive where others die.🚀

apps.name: A.V.E.N.A
apps.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

apps.name: Abductables
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelite about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

apps.name: Ablight
apps.short_description: Ablight is a classic real-time strategy game set in an alternate universe where diesel, cyberpunk and medieval aesthetics meet. Join the rebellion against the zealotic Inquisition, who have been mankinds scourge for hundreds of years and fight a war for survival. Freedom is within reach!

apps.name: Abnormal Rules Cafe
apps.short_description: In a strange household, a family member is a pig-headed impostor. Read the rules, study their routines, search for supplies, and survive the night. Execute an innocent, and they become a chicken-headed hunter.

apps.name: Above the Cloud: Time Bound Mansion
apps.short_description: Uncover the mysteries of the mansion in this co-op classless Action RPG. Permanently unlock abilities, gear and relics to create your perfect class fantasy. Step into the nightmare of the Time-Bound and defeat its denizen to progress and uncover the fate of the estate.

apps.name: Abyss Outpost: Auto Frontline
apps.short_description: A roguelite auto-battler. As an explorer, venture into the perilous abyss to collect bio-data and print unit cards. Equip gear and tactical modules, build your frontline, auto-summon massive armies, survive brutal boss assaults, crush fortified enemy lines, and forge an immortal legend!

apps.name: Abyss Ring
apps.short_description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.

apps.name: Abyss Walker
apps.short_description: Abyss Walker is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG. Chain attacks and skills, defeat dungeon bosses and turn reward cards. Challenge the abyss for equipment drops, compare stats and set bonuses, then return to town to upgrade your gear for the next fight.

apps.name: Abyssal Guardians
apps.short_description:
A 1-4 player fps co-op set in a dystopian future, where you are hired to take an elevator down multiple layers to eliminate hostile anomalies and gather resources for the Abyssal Company. Explore ever enlarging floors, gather items, make money, kill kill kill. 
How far will you go for glory?

apps.name: Abyssal Station
apps.short_description: A Lovecraftian space tower defense. Hold a station rebuilt every run against endless waves pouring from the rifts, bargain with offerings that feed the corruption, and dig deeper until the core gives out.

apps.name: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR
apps.short_description: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR is a one-of-a-kind title featuring the unique Ace Style gauge system that shifts based on how you play (Ace Style) and the choices that you make during missions.

apps.name: AEA
apps.short_description: All Eyes Above is a co-op shooter for a crew of up to four players, where your teamwork is the only thing standing between civilization and obliteration.  Join the ranks of elite soldiers and fight a ruthless faction in a moving battlefield across an epic 10 mission campaign.

apps.name: Aether Abyss
apps.short_description: Aether Abyss is a 2D rougelike action game. You're in the realm between worlds and must hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies in arena style levels.

apps.name: Aether.Garden
apps.short_description: The original New RTS. One race, many styles, no limit. Play head-to-head, enjoy the co-op Adventure, or seek the leader board, battling to become the King of the Hill in an endless spectator-friendly five player revolving struggle.

apps.name: Afterconflict
apps.short_description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

apps.name: Aftergods
apps.short_description: Play as a god who survived Ragnarök! Rise from the aftermath to form a new pantheon and restore the fallen Seeds of the World Tree. Recruit followers, build temples, and battle giant monsters solo or with friends across a mythical handcrafted open world.

apps.name: Aftermyth
apps.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

apps.name: Afterpub
apps.short_description: Grandpas in wheelchairs, a pub full of games and a mountain to race over. Bet on the chaos, throw everything you grab, and play with friends online in Mountain Run, 1v1 Duels and many party games.

apps.name: Afterwork Apocalypse
apps.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

apps.name: Age of Harvest
apps.short_description: Age of Harvest is a deep 2D simulation traditional Roguelike. Explore a living world, manage your body and wounds, and survive an ever-changing world as you uncover its mysteries and bring about the true Age of Harvest.

apps.name: Agency 13
apps.short_description: Agency 13 is a co-op supernatural horror game where you investigate mysterious deaths, locate the bodies, and gather evidence to uncover what happened. Identify the entities responsible and find a way to banish them. But beware—some secrets are better left buried.

apps.name: Agile Team
apps.short_description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner.  Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

apps.name: Ai-Breakout
apps.short_description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

apps.name: Aibond
apps.short_description: An anime-style AI companion with true long-term memory. No installation, free to start. Chat, play, study together — your always-present everyday friend.

apps.name: AI桌面伴侣 - 艾露芙 ErufuAI
apps.short_description: ErufuAI is a smart virtual companion app that grows with users through interactive learning. It offers personalized experiences with features like custom Live2D models, character cards, and voice cloning.

apps.name: Akashic Slingshot
apps.short_description: One weapon. One health. One ███.

apps.name: Akata's Adventure
apps.short_description: An idyllic VR climbing adventure. Explore a handcrafted world with Akata, your fox-like companion, on an immersive quest from the distant past of the Skyclimbers universe.

apps.name: Akgwi Slash
apps.short_description: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

apps.name: Alderun
apps.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

apps.name: Aleph's Garden
apps.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

apps.name: Aleryos : Le Réveil des Monarques
apps.short_description: Aleryos is a free-to-play persistent space strategy MMO. Develop your planets, design fleets, master the Pillars, confront rival players and PvE threats, and build an alliance powerful enough to dominate the galaxy.

apps.name: Alien Prospectors
apps.short_description: Head out onto an alien planet with a drill, a scanner and a limited supply of air. Dig up over a thousand different finds, sell them at headquarters, and upgrade your way to the deepest, rarest deposits, on your own or alongside other prospectors. Stay hydrated!

apps.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
apps.short_description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

apps.name: Alone at Sea
apps.short_description: First-person lifeboat survival in the open Pacific. Salvage wreckage, spear fish and catch rain while thirst, fever, sharks and storms close in. No GPS. No compass to start: read the sun and stars with your own hand and steer for land you can't see. One life: when you die, the sea keeps you.

apps.name: Alone on the Lost Isle
apps.short_description: An atmospheric open-world survival game featuring exploration of a mysterious island, base building, crafting, and a dog companion. Face hostile inhabitants of the island.

apps.name: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
apps.short_description: Alpha 7: The Last Hope: A frantic one-button bullet hell style space cyberpunk. Survive with Dave across 6 stages, master 12 ships, unlock the Lore, and enjoy the original jukebox. An extreme, fully inclusive challenge.

apps.name: Alterum
apps.short_description: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.

apps.name: Altitude Zero
apps.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

apps.name: An Archers Fate
apps.short_description: Try the first ten waves free. Hold, aim, release at the perfect moment: time every shot, dash through attacks, build your archer from 22 upgrades and bring down the Iron Warden, then take on Heat. The full game goes much deeper, with more bosses, arenas and endless waves.

apps.name: Annihilated
apps.short_description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

apps.name: Anomaly Express
apps.short_description: Anomaly Express is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror aboard a winter train. Spot anomalies, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the supernatural force behind this endless journey.

apps.name: Anti-anti
apps.short_description: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

apps.name: AntiMatcher
apps.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

apps.name: ANU
apps.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

apps.name: APPENDIX C
apps.short_description: Five contracts on machines you don't own, played at a real DOS command line. You can read every file on the volume for free — taking one is what gets noticed. Every run is ranked on how much noise you made.

apps.name: Arborrosa Insidia
apps.short_description: A retro-inspired horror game where you, as a scientist, will explore the local flora, desperately trying to find a semi-mythical plant that promises a better life. In these hazy landscapes your loneliness is only an illusion.

apps.name: Arcade City
apps.short_description: Welcome to Arcade City, the ultimate gaming paradise where the fun never stops... or does it? Tackle 2D pixel-art minigames while uncovering disturbing anomalies hidden inside. Keep playing, stay focused, and whatever you do, don't stop being happy!

apps.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
apps.short_description: Ride attractions, play minigames and chase online high scores across three themed islands! Shoot ducks, feed raptors with a crossbow, hunt pterosaurs from a roller coaster or rescue sailors from the kraken. Win teddies at the Claw Machine and collect Dino Cards for your Lodge.

apps.name: Arcane Abyss
apps.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

apps.name: Arcane Arena
apps.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

apps.name: Arcane Commander: Overdrive
apps.short_description: An incremental game combining resource production, upgrades, automation, and combat. Build your base, command a squad of robots, and unleash powerful Overdrive abilities. Click to accelerate your progress or let your systems run automatically as you fight to escape an alien planet.

apps.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
apps.short_description: Relive the past with Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure! Play the first 9 of 36 levels free. Ilenor the Brave’s wand, cauldron and diamond are stolen, and his beloved cat Shadowtongue has been catnapped! Blast through levels of pure chaos, filled with enemies and deathtraps, to get them back.

apps.name: Arcane Overdrive
apps.short_description: Arcane Overdrive, is a survivor-like game where you combine different vehicle parts to create your own gameplay and movement style.

apps.name: Arcane Quest Legends
apps.short_description: A classic action RPG in the old-school hack & slash style. No fixed classes: mix warrior, wizard and ranger skills into your own hero, hire an ally, and fight through hordes of orcs, undead and demons across four story acts to face gigantic bosses.

apps.name: Arcane Quest Legends 2
apps.short_description: Hack & slash through time in this classic action RPG. As Death's Soul Collector you fight across medieval fantasy, samurai Japan, pirate seas, the Wild West, a modern city, a post-apocalyptic wasteland and a sci-fi future. No fixed classes: build any hero and recruit the souls you reap.

apps.name: ArcaneBound
apps.short_description:
ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG.
Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

apps.name: ArcanoPlay
apps.short_description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

apps.name: Archi Vista
apps.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

apps.name: Arctic Station Six
apps.short_description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs to read your instruments, warn of gales, launch weather balloons, send out a drone and more. Grow the site level by level from a small outpost to a fully fledged research station.

apps.name: Arena Invaders
apps.short_description: Hold the ring. Arena Invaders is a neon twin-lane shooter: orbit the rim, drop to the inner lane to fire outward, and hold back swarms that come from both sides. Play the classic Arcade campaign or survive 10 minutes of escalating chaos

apps.name: Arizona Sunshine®
apps.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

apps.name: ASEMA
apps.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

apps.name: Ashenburrow
apps.short_description: An underground survival and simulation game. Wildlife hunts, NPCs make camp, talk and fight… with or without you. Lead your expedition, alone or with up to four players, and remember: even underground, night falls.

apps.name: Ashes & Blood
apps.short_description: Ashes & Blood is a fantasy strategy RPG blending fast-paced tactical battles, 4X-inspired strategy, and roguelite progression. Break the rules, build absurd combos, uncover Varyndel's secrets, and unlock even more chaos with each expedition. Turn-based strategy has never been this unhinged.

apps.name: Ashes of the Swarm
apps.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

apps.name: Aster Initiative
apps.short_description: Desktop puzzle-horror. Navigate a huge mid-90s internet and use a variety of programs on your work computer to take down the pharmaceutical company you work for without getting caught.

apps.name: ASTERIS
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player action roguelite that fuses thousands of powerful builds with MMO-style co-op raids. Reshape every active skill to suit your style, inherit a god's mighty power and awaken. Dive into gear and growth, appearance collecting and a player marketplace.

apps.name: AsterMaster
apps.short_description: A roguelite shooter on a hex grid where bosses are clouds of 6,000 shards: every hit carves a real crater, dig through the plating and chunks tear off. Enemies move on the beat, you play in real time. Stack weapon mods, chase synergies, haul your ore back out alive. Steam Deck friendly.

apps.name: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
apps.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

apps.name: Astral Trial
apps.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

apps.name: Astro Pirates
apps.short_description: Space pirate co-op hack-and-slash roguelike flight shooter game-description-salad!

apps.name: Astrobarian
apps.short_description: Astrobarian™ is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

apps.name: Athanasia
apps.short_description: Fight the past in Athanasia, an immersive horror FPS set in an abandoned research facility overrun with prehistoric predators. Outwit nature, delve deep and uncover the facility's mysteries.

apps.name: Athelan Battlegrounds
apps.short_description: Made by 2 people, Athelan Battlegrounds is an old school PvP turn-based tactics where player skill matters most. Build your team and engage in a meaningful battle of wits against other players in this "Chess meets LoL" indie game!

apps.name: ATMOSFAR
apps.short_description: Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.

apps.name: AUREUS GEMWORKS ― リリトリオンの宝石工場
apps.short_description: Build a gem factory, one card at a time. Combine factory automation with deckbuilding as you mine, refine, transport and ship precious gems. Work with an eccentric crew in the abyss and meet the demands of Lilitryon, your gold-loving supervisor.

apps.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
apps.short_description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

apps.name: Auto Mutant Creatures
apps.short_description: A roguelite autobattler where your build can outlive your creatures. Assemble three mutants with risky powers and wild synergies, position your squad, and watch them fight. Choose a mutation and pass some upgrades to the next generation. Play Solo or asynchronous online PvP.

apps.name: Away Team
apps.short_description: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included game. Mistakenly shipped off to an alien world, you will need to harness the environment and master temperature, pressure, chemical reactions and more in order to survive, and possibly, thrive.

apps.name: B.L.U.E. NOVA
apps.short_description: B.L.U.E. NOVA is an online co-op PvE third-person shooter that grows from solo play into battles with up to 30 players. Choose your hero, connect through “R.I.N.G.”, unleash “Infinite Barrage,” and join forces to destroy the final “Master Tower”!

apps.name: Baacadia
apps.short_description: Scout doesn't speak. Neither do the Clofen. You're a recorder robot, and they're your flock. Shepherd them across a post-apocalyptic desert with one tool: Record and Replay. Capture ambient sounds, play them back—the world reacts. Bring them home through bold, stylish landscapes.

apps.name: Babel Destiny
apps.short_description: A hardcore isometric soulslike in the Tower of Babel. Every enemy announces its blow in a dead language. Red, you roll. Learn its letters and the same blow comes in white: now you parry it. Speak the Tower's words, climb its strata, and ring the Knell.

apps.name: Bach Rediscovered
apps.short_description: A music jigsaw puzzle where the finished picture is Bach. Listen to scattered phrases, fit the voices together, and hear the composition take shape. From a single melody to interwoven fugues, put your musical ear to work.

apps.name: Backmarkers
apps.short_description: Take over the worst team on the grid and run all of it — drivers, sponsors, the garage, every pit call. Climb a living three-tier racing pyramid where rivals rise and fall around you, in a broadcast-style management sim that remembers every result.

apps.name: Backrooms Insane
apps.short_description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

apps.name: Backwards
apps.short_description: Backwards is a first-person psychological horror game where survival depends on three rules: walk backward, turn when you’re being watched, and move forward only when danger leaves you no choice. Read the hallway, trust your senses, and don’t get comfortable.

apps.name: BAD DREAMS
apps.short_description:
Bad Dreams is a Solo VR Horror game with immersive gameplay based on real gesture. A unique experience, where nightmares become reality.
Fight, Run, Jump, Wipe your eyes, Cover your ears... while avoiding the game's traps and puzzles, you won't come out unscathed!

apps.name: Ball and Stick
apps.short_description: Two bodies, one connection. Roll, swing and launch a Ball and Stick through a physics-driven sci-fi adventure, alone or with friends, and cause chaos with wild attachments

apps.name: Ballpark Days
apps.short_description:
"Ballpark Days" is a narrative-driven baseball game played from the perspective of a catcher.
The matches feature 3D action-based gameplay.

The story progresses as you play through matches, and earning the team's trust brings you closer to victory.

apps.name: Ballpeak
apps.short_description: Roll, balance, and find your way through a world of challenging courses in this relaxing physics-based adventure. Control balls made from different materials, each with unique physical properties, and master the art of rolling your way to the finish. Stay balanced and complete every level!

apps.name: BallsyDrop
apps.short_description: Do you like causing chain reactions? BallsyDrop is a satisfying physics puzzler where one perfectly placed ball can set off massive chain reactions. Navigate through various levels with teleporters, blockades and score extra points with the timed balls!

apps.name: Band of Crusaders
apps.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

apps.name: Banner Born
apps.short_description: Banner Born is a single-player medieval fantasy action RPG that blends directional combat, real-time troop command, and a living campaign. Begin alone, recruit companions and soldiers, master weapons and magic, and rise from mercenary to ruler.

apps.name: Bannerlings
apps.short_description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

apps.name: Bargan's Treasure
apps.short_description: Bargan’s Treasure is a narrative puzzle-adventure set in a forgotten village inspired by Saudi Arabia’s mountains. Explore ancient ruins, unravel Bargan’s strange inventions, and restore water and power as you uncover the mystery of a dagger lost for centuries.

apps.name: Barnburners
apps.short_description: 5-on-5 arcade hockey with huge hits, dirty dangles and top shelf goals. Pick from 24 fictional clubs, build a Franchise, take the game outdoors, or face friends in couch and online head to head play.

apps.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
apps.short_description:
Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books...
Until her eyes fell out.
You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression.
There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

apps.name: Battle Barn: Tactics
apps.short_description:
A roguelite tactics game about liberating cute mother fluffers from a farm animal fight club...IN SPACE! 

Capture enemies to fight for you, upgrade and genetically alter critters for combat, and take out an evil space clown overlord while you're at it!

apps.name: Battle SHIRYU
apps.short_description: Real model footage × generative AI! Show your hand to a webcam and Battle SHIRYU recognizes it automatically! Steer a handmade paper dragon, smash matching-colour Moai, and set off chain explosions. No special markers or prepared backdrop needed. Mouse controls are available too.

apps.name: Beadroom
apps.short_description: Make fuse bead creations, iron them and decorate your apartment with things you have made yourself. A cozy crafting game with patterns, free mode and tools to unlock. Export your designs as printable templates to craft them in real life, too.

apps.name: Beaver Creek
apps.short_description: A casual, water-physics puzzle game about building dams as a beaver (2 - 3 hours). Gnaw down trees, and grab and throw objects to organically build dams, back up water, and progress to the next level.

apps.name: Becoming Pablo
apps.short_description: Rule the underworld in Becoming Pablo. A grand-strategy city-builder set in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade. Lead a cartel, conquer territories, manage operations, and outsmart your rivals. This isn't just about building an empire. It's about surviving it.

apps.name: Bed Wars
apps.short_description: Build across the clouds, defend your bed, and raid rival islands in a first-person team battler. Gather resources, buy guns and melee gear, and turn a narrow bridge into your next attack route. Practice solo or take on bots before the next team fight.

apps.name: Beefy Boi
apps.short_description: A job simulator horror. Clock in. Survive. Reach the quota. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him.

apps.name: Beelionair
apps.short_description: A cozy idle sim about bees and their hives. Plant a wild meadow, send your swarm out to forage, and watch the honey pour in. Grow your hives, breed new bee strains, research upgrades, and re-queen your colony across four biomes. Your hives keep filling up even while you're away.

apps.name: Behelade
apps.short_description: Fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up, consisting of 5 stages full of beautiful, intricate patterns and bosses. Wield the magic sword “Behelade” to find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the forest creatures go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

apps.name: Beltrunner
apps.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

apps.name: Bet Your Friends
apps.short_description:
Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS!

BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE.

First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS!

Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

apps.name: Better Days 2
apps.short_description: The pioneer of bishoujo extraction shooters returns! Buy once, play solo PvE, no microtransactions. Switch first/third person, change outfits via nanotech mid-raid and fill your trunk with loot. Amid shifting weather and eerie encounters, extract now or get greedy?

apps.name: Between Empires
apps.short_description: Lead a nation from 1700 to 1936 in a historical grand strategy game of politics, economics, diplomacy, and war. Appoint ministers, reform institutions, and face consequences that can return generations later.

apps.name: Bibidi Bibidi!
apps.short_description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.

apps.name: Biden Blast
apps.short_description: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

apps.name: BIGGER BANG
apps.short_description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

apps.name: Birds of Ascent
apps.short_description:
Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds.
Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

apps.name: Black Autumn: 1438
apps.short_description: A realistic medieval pixel art RPG set in the Hron valley in the autumn of 1438. Fight in armour you put on piece by piece, ride horses into battle, pick locks and purses, and gamble with cards or dice. No magic and no monsters, only the real Hron valley as it was in 1438.

apps.name: Black Kings Defense
apps.short_description: Build a maze out of chess pieces and defend your king in this Tower Defense take on the timeless classic, Chess! Pawns, rooks, bishops, knights and queens strike by their own moves as the white army marches across a 3D board, through a full hand balanced campaign.

apps.name: Blendead
apps.short_description: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

apps.name: BlockBabe
apps.short_description: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

apps.name: blockia
apps.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

apps.name: BloodSpiller
apps.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

apps.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
apps.short_description: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

apps.name: Boomsday
apps.short_description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

apps.name: Booty Battler
apps.short_description: SinglePlayer Roguelike meets Auto-Battler Card game! Manage a crew of pirates to fight through endless auto-battles while collecting powerful relics, managing cursed loot, upgrading the ship and casting spells.

apps.name: Borregada o Facto
apps.short_description: Borregada or Facto is a quiz about current affairs, politics, history, and society. Answer questions, earn points, use cards and bonuses, and compete with your friends. Uncomfortable questions, real facts, and sources to check them yourself.

apps.name: Borrow or Rob
apps.short_description: The Pantheon sends armies back from the future; humanity has never won. Now you fight backwards too. Two agents: one fights Phase 1 forward, the other refights it in reverse, where your past agent returns as a hologram to strike with you: the TEMPORAL PINCER. A retro future roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Borrowed Flesh
apps.short_description: A deck-building roguelike of body horror where your whole party shares one deck: when a hero falls, every card they own dies with them. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, survive permanent mutilation and unraveling minds, and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

apps.name: BoteK.O.
apps.short_description: Start a band, run your bar and fight to the beat! BoteKO is a co-op rhythm beat ’em up for up to 4 players where every hit lands on the beat of your own instrument. Play locally or online, nail the timing and turn every brawl into a show.

apps.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
apps.short_description: Bounce On is back! Roll and bounce your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress. Dozens of challenging platform levels to explore to find all the secrets.

apps.name: Bouncy Blobs
apps.short_description: You are a blob. Prove your worth as the greatest blob to ever live by solving puzzles or vanquishing your squishy brethren.

apps.name: Bowerland
apps.short_description: The Euchre roguelite. Call trump, win tricks, deal damage and decimate your foes as you take on the Bower King's evil henchmen in this single player 1v1 card battler.

apps.name: Bowlbo: The Quest for Bing Bing
apps.short_description: A sinister Witch has kidnapped your beloved Bing Bing. You must travel the sweeping lands of Cósta Cré and do what it takes to get your poochingus back from the Nightmare Realm!

apps.name: Boxed
apps.short_description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

apps.name: Boys in the dark
apps.short_description: Survival horror meets gay dark romance. Trapped in a nightmare realm, fight grotesque monsters and solve twisted puzzles. Caught between a possessive lover and a mysterious stranger, you must uncover the truth. Will you survive the horror and the heat of Boys in the Dark?

apps.name: Brawliens
apps.short_description: Toy aliens, total chaos, zero friendships left. Land on the planet's sites, win minigames, buy sneaky gadgets, then knock your friends out of orbit in THE FINAL BRAWL. An online alien party game for 2–8 players, with bots to fill any empty seat.

apps.name: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira
apps.short_description: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira is a fighting game that features capoeira as its main fighting style. In this game, you'll experience numerous characters and ways to fight capoeira. Let's get moving!

apps.name: Break Shot Hero
apps.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

apps.name: Breakaway Hockey League
apps.short_description: Fast, team-based competitive hockey. Lace up and take control of one skater in third-person. Dominate the ice with dynamic movement, precision shooting, skillful passing, and massive hits. Build chemistry with your squad and climb the ranks in nonstop hockey action.

apps.name: Breaking Armor
apps.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

apps.name: Breast Milkshake Cafe
apps.short_description: A strange virus left your childhood friend Miku with a very unusual side effect — nonstop lactation. Instead of losing heart, you decide to open your own milkshake cafe, bring together a team of girls sharing the same delicate predicament, and turn an old fixer-upper into the hottest spot in town!

apps.name: Brewalmighty
apps.short_description: Turn a bucket in a garden shed into the only brewery in town. Brew, bottle and sell door to door, sabotage the lager monopoly, rob the competition and outrun the consequences, alone or with mates who are, legally speaking, "volunteers". Nice garage.

apps.name: Brick Builds
apps.short_description: A relaxed brick building studio for curious builders. Follow a guided first build, then make it your own with custom colors and moving parts. Save your creations, make visual instructions, and explore other builders' work through Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Brick Mayhem
apps.short_description: A physics-based autobattler where tiny plastic warriors battle across fully destructible fortresses. Customize your army, unleash explosive sieges, and enjoy chaotic brick-filled destruction.

apps.name: Brightfall
apps.short_description: Brightfall is an isometric open-world survival-craft for 1-4 players where light is your last defence against a living darkness. Explore cursed Celtic islands, craft powerful weapons, build a safe haven, and fight to keep your flame alive - because when it dies, your sanity follows.

apps.name: Brothel Tycoon 2
apps.short_description: Step into the heels of Yvonne in a stunningly realistic nightclub tycoon. Experience a living, breathing 24/7 business where lighting, music, and staff management collide. Unlock rooms, host events and watch your empire grow in a world where the party never stops.

apps.name: BrouHaHa
apps.short_description:
Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy
coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

apps.name: Bugulon 12
apps.short_description: Bugulon 12 is an performant incremental idle RPG with a near endless grind. Operate a bunker on the titular planet: collect resources, level skills, and unlock new bunker frames, weapons and hardpoints. Play it active, idle, or anywhere in between.

apps.name: Bullet Breakfast
apps.short_description: Bullet Breakfast is a 3D co-op arena shooter where you play solo or team up with other heroes. Choose your hero, wield class-specific weapons, collect powerful upgrades, survive waves of undead, and defeat the Demon King before sunrise.

apps.name: Bumper & Thumper
apps.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

apps.name: Burger Truck
apps.short_description: Run a hands-on burger truck in PC VR. Take orders, grill patties, build burgers and serve your customers. Work through daily shifts to unlock a bigger menu, or cook together in online co-op. Headset required.

apps.name: Burn all out
apps.short_description: Fired for missing the trash bin and dumped in the basement, channel your burnout into pure rage in this chaotic roguelike. Fight your way up the corporate ladder, crush middle management with office supplies, craft insane builds, and uncover this shady corporation's dark secrets.

apps.name: Burrowburrow
apps.short_description: Build a town in a magical but dangerous wilderness as you recruit different animal dudes and grow your community from a few weirdos around a campfire to a whole village!

apps.name: Buzzwire
apps.short_description: Host your own buzz-in quiz show. Run it from your PC, put the board on your stream or Discord, and friends buzz in from their phones with a 4-letter room code. Viewers can play along too, and Twitch chat can pick categories and steal clues.

apps.name: CACTBOY
apps.short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

apps.name: Candy Crawlers
apps.short_description: Candy Crawlers is a co-op Halloween horror game where you and your friends trick-or-treat through haunted suburbs, collect as much candy as you can, and get home alive.

apps.name: Candy Harvest
apps.short_description: It's Halloween night and you've ventured into town for some trick-or-treating.

apps.name: Candy Rush!
apps.short_description: A roguelike survivor where the clock is your own greed. Fights never end on their own — the waves loop, and every loop makes enemies stronger. Bank your build and leave, or stay one more round. Choose your route, evolve your weapons, and meet the boss with whatever your greed built.

apps.name: Capitol Diktatoria
apps.short_description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

apps.name: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park
apps.short_description: A pixel-art run based safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

apps.name: Captain McSpacebiff
apps.short_description:
Hot-swap between 1st person shooting and 3rd person brawling in this Atom Punk styled adventure.
Collect crashed ship parts to gain new abilities, save the doofy locals and vanquish the Soviet Moonion!

apps.name: Capybara Dungeon
apps.short_description: Become a capybara and brave dangerous dungeons with up to 4 players. Dodge traps, face strange creatures and survive the chaos together, online or in local split-screen. A cooperative adventure where every mistake becomes a story.

apps.name: Car For Sale Together
apps.short_description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

apps.name: Card Harts Reborn
apps.short_description: A F2P 3D strategy card game. Invoke Combatants, cast Sorceries, and wager Hearts on an altar inside of an Ancient Egyptian tomb, in a game far older than this age.

apps.name: Card Heroes: Rune Deck
apps.short_description: Fantasy turn-based card battler. Time your charges, chain five-element counters and rage-fueled ultimates. Conquer 15 dungeons across three difficulty tiers, brave the trial tower, duel a ranked arena, collect 541 cards and become the Rune Master.

apps.name: Card Shop: Tidy Up the Trading Cards!
apps.short_description: a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 6,010 trading cards, booster boxes and graded slabs back where they belong after prerelease night, a collection buyout and the shop cat wrecked the store. Doors open at dawn.

apps.name: Cardelis
apps.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

apps.name: Cardstock City
apps.short_description: A trading card life simulator, in a strange world where people are replaced with living cards, and every paycheck you earn can be spent on another booster pack. Work all kinds of jobs, rip packs, chase the rarest pulls, run your own shop, or just collect all the animals of a place called Earth.

apps.name: CAREFUL WITH THAT!
apps.short_description: CAREFUL WITH THAT! is a hilariously chaotic physics co-op delivery game for 1-4 players. Balance unstable cargo through difficult Terrain and differend Biomes. Coordinate every single step or drag your entire crew into the abyss!

apps.name: Carpoli - Car Board Game
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, drive across living 3D maps and build a car empire. Buy cars and businesses, collect rent, race rivals for their cars and fill your garage with prestige. A fast, friendly board game for 2–4 players: against bots, on one PC or online with friends.

apps.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal
apps.short_description: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

apps.name: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
apps.short_description: A story-driven real-time strategy game inspired by classic RTS. Experience a mission campaign filled with memorable characters, unexpected alliances, and humor. Build your kingdom, command Humans and Orcs, create custom maps, and share your battles with the world.

apps.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
apps.short_description: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

apps.name: Cat and Paste!
apps.short_description: A chaotic copy-and-paste hide-and-seek with cats that can turn into anything. "Copy" a stage object to transform into it, then "Paste" decoys everywhere to hide in plain sight! A prop hunt party game for up to 16 players online!

apps.name: Cat Meme Wars
apps.short_description: Cat Meme Wars is a third-person action RPG inspired by meme culture. Fight with absurd weapons, combos, dodges and magic, explore strange lands, battle bosses, craft gear and uncover the secret behind the cat-dog war. Fight seriously—or just enjoy the memes.

apps.name: CATCAR Pit Crew
apps.short_description: Be the pit crew of a race team. Jack the car, wrench off the wheels, swap tires and refuel by hand while the race keeps going. Co-op with friends. Things will catch fire.

apps.name: Catch a Cheater by the Hand
apps.short_description: Cheat your way through nine card and tile games. Peek at rivals’ hands, swap cards from your sleeve, and steal chips—but watch for tells and call out the cheats around you. Get caught, or accuse the wrong player, and the Axe Man takes a limb.

apps.name: Catch The Ducks
apps.short_description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

apps.name: Cats and Hats
apps.short_description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats! A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

apps.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

apps.name: Cats Here
apps.short_description: 😺 Discover 100+ hidden cats 🐾 in the colorful landscape. 🏆 Earn TONS OF ACHIEVEMENTS. How many cats 🐈 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

apps.name: CatSitter - Remastered
apps.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

apps.name: Celebria
apps.short_description: From movie star to music icon, you run the show in Celebria. Guide your entertainer through landing roles, releasing music, touring the world, climbing global charts, chasing prestigious awards, and running a celebrity brand, all while navigating the pressures of fame.

apps.name: cenker's mod
apps.short_description: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

apps.name: Century of Conquest
apps.short_description: Hex-grid tactics × elemental spell cards × hero expeditions. Command 59 unit types across four races in initiative-driven battles, weave 75 elemental spells mid-combat, besiege castles, and lead your hero through a three-layer campaign map to face the abyssal overlord.

apps.name: Century of Steam
apps.short_description: Century of Steam is a physics-based multiplayer railroad simulator and strategy game. Build your route through beautiful landscapes, customize and operate your fleet of historic trains, discover the sights, sounds, and stories of railroading with industry-leading steam, firing, and audio simulation.

apps.name: Chaos Table
apps.short_description: A chaotic social deduction game for 6–10 players where roles never stop shifting. Talk, lie and betray your way to the very end. You can’t trust anyone here — not even the person sitting next to you. Play every angle and prove you’re the sharpest mind at the table.

apps.name: Chase Buddies
apps.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

apps.name: Cheese Racers
apps.short_description: Thread a hovering wheel of cheese through gaps that never stop tightening. A hit costs a slice; dodge clean and it grows back. Chase your best, race everyone on the Daily Seed, and beat friends and ranked rivals on the exact same course. Earn skins, shapes, trails and maps as you play.

apps.name: Chef Knight: Desktop Adventures
apps.short_description: Run a fantasy restaurant on your desktop while exploring dungeons for fresh monster ingredients. Cook, serve, upgrade, decorate, and grow your shop while you work, play, or relax.

apps.name: Chess Duel
apps.short_description: Bring chaos to the chessboard. Choose your powers, spend stone points, shield a piece or recall a fallen queen. Face Steam friends, AI rivals and tournaments in atmospheric 3D chess, with separate Classic and Chaos ranked ladders. Medieval combat is now in private testing.

apps.name: Chess War
apps.short_description: Chess War brings chess to life in epic 3D battles between legendary armies from different historical eras. Challenge friends online or locally, face a competitive AI, and watch every capture unfold through dynamic, action-packed combat animations.

apps.name: ChessGuardians
apps.short_description: Play on boards that challenge the imagination — from a classic office to holographic, post-apocalyptic and more. Face different engines, variants, import your games, and play against millions of players. The chess you know. The excitement you never imagined.

apps.name: Chicken Shop Simulator - Fast Food Empire
apps.short_description: Welcome to the chicken shop! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a chicken fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to grow your chicken business. Take orders, fry chicken, and increase your earnings by selling food to customers.

apps.name: Choose Wrong, Die
apps.short_description: In Six Girls: Choose or Die, six fatally seductive women crash into your life. Behind their pulse-pounding charm lies a chilling death trap. Every choice decides your fate—choose wrong and die instantly. Survive the clash of desire and terror!

apps.name: Chop or Die: Axe of War
apps.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

apps.name: Chrome Circuit
apps.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

apps.name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos
apps.short_description: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set in 500 AD Oman. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s most enigmatic stories, including The Nameless City and Nyarlathotep, it pulls you into a chilling investigation of cosmic horror and creeping madness.

apps.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
apps.short_description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

apps.name: Claw & Order
apps.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

apps.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
apps.short_description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

apps.name: Clayverse
apps.short_description: Embark on an epic quest in the extraordinary world of Clayverse. Mold your clay hero, master crafting, and explore a mesmerizing multiverse. Engage in tactical clay combat inspired by classic MMORPGs, and experience gory claymation for a thrilling, darkly humorous twist.

apps.name: Clean 'Em Ocean
apps.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

apps.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
apps.short_description: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, seven stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Click Bait
apps.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

apps.name: Click Start
apps.short_description: Click Start is a branching visual novel with over 25 hours of story content about relationships, boundaries, and consequences. Meet four heroines and discover multiple endings—what matters is not only who you choose, but how you treat others along the way.

apps.name: Click! Make Zombie!
apps.short_description: You click! You make zombies! You upgrade your zombies until there are so many of them you forget what you were even doing and just watch them swarm around the hapless humans in a gigantic tsunami of destruction until the whole map is nothing but little marching zombies doing fun zombie things.

apps.name: Clicky Islands
apps.short_description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

apps.name: Climb the Fools
apps.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

apps.name: Cloak Hero
apps.short_description: Cloak Hero is a rougelite dungeon crawler with a mix of auto and manual control combat mechanism. With weapons, magic and special powers, our hero fights to survive and grows stronger to face the evil force down in the deep.

apps.name: Clocking Out
apps.short_description: It's 6 PM. You're going home! Dodge everyone trying to hold you up in this arcade commute. Pick from eight office workers, reach home across ten chapters with a checkpoint every 300 steps, collect animal hoods with iced coffees, or chase a new endless-mode record.

apps.name: Cloud Getaway
apps.short_description: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!

apps.name: ClusterForce
apps.short_description: ClusterForce is a fast arcade 3D flying sports game for up to 8 players online, a unique combination that demands many of your skills at once. Carry energy balls from magnetic ramps to the goal without getting caught by your rivals and their glider weapons!

apps.name: COCOBOY
apps.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

apps.name: Codenames
apps.short_description:
Codenames is a clever word game of deduction, teamwork, and strategy, inspired by the popular board game loved worldwide.
Give one-word clues, link multiple words, and read your teammates’ minds to win before the other team does.

apps.name: Coffee Keeper
apps.short_description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

apps.name: Coins in Place
apps.short_description: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

apps.name: Coins Must Be Made
apps.short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

apps.name: Coldchain: Depot Management
apps.short_description: Run a temperature-controlled food service depot in this detailed management simulator. Plan delivery routes, manage warehouse operations, hire staff, maintain your fleet and balance the books as everyday challenges put your decisions to the test.

apps.name: Color Fear
apps.short_description: The Scariest Horror game you will ever experience. Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want viewers to help them find out who is breaking into their house! Survive each night against the Intruders and the Horror that comes from The Color Fun Coloring Show!

apps.name: Common Darkness
apps.short_description: An XCOM-style turn-based tactics campaign against a demonic incursion, solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Take cover, flank, and revive your fallen under fire; then research, rebuild, and decide which calls for help to answer. Four powers. One world to lose.

apps.name: Companion Baduk
apps.short_description: Learn and master Go (Baduk/Weiqi) with unique AI companions, custom game analysis with move explanations, ranked puzzles, joseki training, and a rich proverb database. Play, practice, and improve your skills at your own pace!

apps.name: Conquest of the Realms
apps.short_description: Build your town. Rally your heroes. Fight for your realm! Conquest of the Realms blends epic boss battles, army building and territorial warfare across five fantasy realms. Capture Keeps, seize powerful loot and lead the charge toward the mysterious Nexus. Different Paths, Same Horizon!

apps.name: Conspiracy at Headquarters
apps.short_description: Investigate a conspiracy inside a corporate headquarters. Explore in first or third person, solve access-card puzzles, and fight hostile robots in this single-player action adventure. Try the free three-floor factory demo, including Lucy’s side story and a vault boss.

apps.name: Copy Cats
apps.short_description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

apps.name: Corala: Deity's Loom
apps.short_description: Corala: Deity's Loom is a dark-fantasy action-adventure game with puzzling dungeons, tense combat, and a 2000's inspired visual style.

apps.name: Coralium
apps.short_description: Coralium is a 2.5D platform adventure where a magical baby coral restores the dying reef. Collect bleached corals, learn powers from sea creatures, and switch between water and air to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and bring life back to the ocean.

apps.name: Core Awakened
apps.short_description: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.

apps.name: Cornerfall
apps.short_description: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

apps.name: Corridor 13
apps.short_description: Psychological anomaly horror set in an abandoned school corridor. Find what has changed and make the right choice. But even the right choice doesn't guarantee escape. The corridor won't let you leave that easily.

apps.name: Corrupted Dice
apps.short_description: A dice roguelite where even your best dice break. Unlock upgrades across runs, combine dice and relics, reshape your collection at the Black Market, and wager in minigames while keeping heat and corruption under control.

apps.name: Corrupted Skies
apps.short_description: Command a fractured army against two rival factions in this tactical turn-based card battle. Every unit has a story, every spell has a cost, and only one commander walks away.

apps.name: CosmicCritters
apps.short_description: CosmicCritters is an action game set in a ranch. Feed your critters, collect the resources they drop, and defend them from waves of hostiles — all while juggling between your Feeder, Vacuum, and Laser Gun. The waves never stop, and your critters depend on you.

apps.name: CosmoLaunch System
apps.short_description: CosmoLaunchSystem is a hybrid game about managing a space agency and piloting a rocket. You play as the agency director. You accept contracts, invest in research laboratories, design launch vehicles in the VAB, and deliver your clients' payloads.

apps.name: Cosmos Knights - Abyss Survivors
apps.short_description: Defend the worlds of the Gaia Empire against the threat of the Abyss in this pixel-art action survival roguelite. Battle hordes of creatures, combine powerful abilities, grow stronger with every run, and defeat formidable bosses.

apps.name: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets
apps.short_description:
Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter!
Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!

apps.name: COVR
apps.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

apps.name: Cowpokers: Dead Man's Frontier
apps.short_description: Become a one-outlaw army in a haunted western bullet heaven. Dodge the dead, evolve your weapons, and tackle optional objectives across four frontiers. Ride home to upgrade your gear, reinforce Dustwater, and defend the town against a nighttime siege.

apps.name: Cozy Cargo
apps.short_description: Someone's having a bad week. Your job is to pack them a comforting package. A cozy roguelike where every object reacts to the ones beside it, so you really don't want the scented candle next to the old novels. Three parcels each day, Monday to Friday.

apps.name: Cozy Castle
apps.short_description: Cozy Castle is a hand-crafted castle diorama you tend like a little world in a jar — warm rooms, shifting seasons, and the quiet company of visitors passing through. No timers, no pressure, just a calm place to make your own.

apps.name: Cozy Game Restoration
apps.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

apps.name: CPA:Reports Bousy
apps.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

apps.name: Crate Escape: Program & Deliver
apps.short_description: Program your warehouse robot in secret, lock in, and watch every robot run its program at once. Shoves, conveyor belts and lasers will test the best plan. Race, deliver parcels, knock rivals out or capture flags, against the AI, on one screen or online. Same rules as the Crate Escape board game.

apps.name: Crayon Sparks
apps.short_description: Draw your escape route in a hand-drawn bomb arena! Chain explosions, collect upgrades and turn tricky terrain to your advantage. Challenge 50 solo stages, battle friends online with up to 8 players, or share one computer for local battles with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Crazy City Golf
apps.short_description: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

apps.name: Crim Ludus
apps.short_description: Crim Ludus is a grim-dark PvPvE arena where enslaved mages are forced to battle beneath a world ruled by demons. Fight in deadly arena matches that combine realtime grid-based movement, strategic spellcasting, and relentless monster hordes in a brutal test of positioning and survival.

apps.name: Crimson Furnace
apps.short_description: Manage a clandestine tavern where gangs, poachers, and Council spies cross paths. In this cozy weird simulator, cook cursed dishes, manipulate your patrons, and build your reputation to expand your cult’s influence.

apps.name: Crossfire
apps.short_description: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

apps.name: Crown & Applause
apps.short_description: Your boss is a Dragon King. Your audience has tomatoes. Play a mouse jester in this comic narrative rhythm game set to bardcore: hit the beat and keep the candles burning, then choose whether to please the Crown, the Crowd, or Yourself. The job comes with several possible endings.

apps.name: Crown of Ages
apps.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in an organically crafted fantasy antiquity. Build cities, advance through new ages, wage wars, and unleash magic. Roguelite choices shape every city and every run anew — until the world ends and your empire is reborn from the ruins.

apps.name: Crucible Of Time
apps.short_description: A nostalgic love-letter to 90's era 4X strategy games reimagined with the best modern features of the genre. Armies fight in groups while supply chains must be managed. Powerful diplomatic rivals and apocalypses triggered by player choices. Can you build an empire that survives the Crucible Of Time?

apps.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, staff it, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests happy - or set loose a kraken, a lightning storm and pirates and see if she stays afloat.

apps.name: Crusaders of the Blessed League
apps.short_description: Build a party of adventurers and help them ascend into legendary heroes. Find exceptional loot, craft unique builds, discover powerful synergies, and lead your crusader party through increasingly dangerous battles in this deep fantasy autobattler.

apps.name: Crystallium
apps.short_description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

apps.name: Ctrl Alt Destroy
apps.short_description: Ctrl Alt Destroy is a chaotic multiplayer party brawler where Y2K-era computers battle for power, beat each other with keyboards, and fight to be the last machine left plugged in.

apps.name: Cube on a Leash
apps.short_description: Cube on a Leash is a dungeon crawler roguelike about commanding your very volatile pet cube. Use your leash to avoid collateral damage as the cube carries out your sequences of attacks -- both manually and automatically -- and becomes your customizable agent of mass destruction.

apps.name: Cucked By My Girlfriend
apps.short_description: Anissa works long days and comes home to Theo. He cooks, she teases,  and they've always liked it that way. Then she joins a gym, and a trainer named Marcus starts coming up in conversation.

apps.name: Cult Crasher
apps.short_description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

apps.name: Curse of Resthaven
apps.short_description: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

apps.name: Curses Cleared
apps.short_description: Cursed villagers knock on your candlelit cabin, and the only way to lift a curse is to beat it. Win fast, combo-chaining Puzzle-Fighter match-battles, build your block set, and break the curse before it breaks you.

apps.name: Custimity
apps.short_description: Free-to-play online arena Action RPG: fight PvE waves, duel players in PvP, and build powerful skill and item loadouts. Between clashes, bet on rival fights — read builds, trust your instincts, and turn sharp calls into gold. Survive, outplay, and climb the ranks.

apps.name: Cutout Village
apps.short_description: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

apps.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
apps.short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

apps.name: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator
apps.short_description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

apps.name: Dark Pillage
apps.short_description: Explore forgotten dungeons and collect valuable treasure in this true 8-bit adventure!

apps.name: Darksiders 4
