apps.short_description: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

apps.name: Datum
apps.short_description: A roguelite quiz deckbuilder where trivia is your weapon. Answer questions across a variety of categories, then combine cards and relics into game-breaking combos. Level up and use meta progression to unlock new cards and craft powerful builds.

apps.name: Daughter of Voodoo
apps.short_description: Daughter of Voodoo is a single player narrative horror experience where the dead are more than monsters. Investigate hauntings, uncover the truth behind lost lives, and perform voodoo rituals to help restless spirits find peace. Some souls seek understanding. Others refuse to let go.

apps.name: Dead Last
apps.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

apps.name: Dead Party
apps.short_description: On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood rises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders!

apps.name: Dead Watch
apps.short_description: You're stuck in a time loop ⌛. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next murder.

apps.name: Death Pool Club
apps.short_description: Oh, a new face? Welcome to Death Pool Club. Every ball you sink takes a bite out of your rival's health. But we share the table, darling. Whatever you leave lying around is mine next turn ♠ The pockets are shady and the executives cheat openly. Beat them all, if you can.

apps.name: Death To The Deathless
apps.short_description: 《Death To The Deathless》is an adventure game featuring lightweight roguelike elements. It combines deck-building with slot machine mechanics for combat. This game contains no real-world monetary gambling or microtransactions whatsoever.

apps.name: Debauchery & Magic
apps.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

apps.name: Deck & Defense
apps.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

apps.name: Deck Forge
apps.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

apps.name: Deckwork
apps.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge powerful synergies. Discover relics that change the rules and take on dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

apps.name: Deductopia
apps.short_description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Little Problems and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

apps.name: Deep Frost
apps.short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

apps.name: DEEP SEAL
apps.short_description: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

apps.name: Deeplanders
apps.short_description: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths and bringing light into them. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.

apps.name: Deepworks
apps.short_description: Earth is gone. The fleet is hungry. Drop a Hub on a generated claim, find the seam, and let the robots dig. Every machine you build makes noise — and noise is how the machines that took the planet find you. Hold the line, launch with the take, sell it, and go deeper.

apps.name: Defense Of Legends
apps.short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

apps.name: Defense The Drone
apps.short_description: Drone swarms close in from every side: survive 10 minutes until reinforcements arrive. Level up mid-fight, build and modify 11 towers, break shields with the right damage type and bring down giant bosses in this neon roguelite tower defense.

apps.name: Deja-Vu of the Dead
apps.short_description: Drink. Die. Repeat. When a mysterious experimental sparks a city-wide zombie outbreak you find yourself trapped in a 25-minute temporal time loop. Every decision you make matters. Explore an interconnected city, talk to fully voiced survivors, collect weapons, and uncover 23 distinct endings.

apps.name: Delligatium
apps.short_description: Delligatium is a surreal RPG where you devote yourself to a Striver, Gods born from mortal desire.

apps.name: Dementium II
apps.short_description: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.

apps.name: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER
apps.short_description: Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more you die, the stronger you become! Raising RTA Simulation RPG has arrived! Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!

apps.name: DenimDoug_909
apps.short_description: Follow Denim, a blue dog, on a bizarre adventure filled with strange characters, unexpected choices, and plenty of random outcomes. This animated FMV point-and-click game features 20+ different endings, and every choice can lead somewhere unexpected!

apps.name: Departure of Darkness
apps.short_description: Emma is forced to clear a horrifying parasite-infested airport as she fights to save her brother. In this 90s style Retro Survival Horror, you’ll have the option to save or leave behind fellow survivors during your adventure. However, your choices will have consequences...

apps.name: Depth Charge
apps.short_description: Fate pulls your soul into the orange deep.

apps.name: Derby Dynasty : Horse Racing RPG
apps.short_description: At first light, a young horse waits for you on your farm; beyond the gates lies a living world where 2,500 horses breathe. Raise it, care for its body and spirit, ride with it, and carve your name into the story of the Derby, where victory is written by a nose.

apps.name: DERELIKT
apps.short_description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

apps.name: Desk Rumble
apps.short_description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

apps.name: Desktop Duck
apps.short_description: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

apps.name: Desktop Oasis
apps.short_description: Turn your desktop into a slowly growing water oasis. Typing and everyday PC use generate Inspiration to unlock creatures, boats, decorations, and rare finds. Let it grow quietly while you work, then return to arrange the world and play with drifting objects through real-time water physics.

apps.name: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG
apps.short_description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

apps.name: Desktop Taxi
apps.short_description: A cozy idle taxi sim with Lofi beats. Grow your taxi business quietly in the corner of your screen while you work.

apps.name: Destined Dungeon Quest
apps.short_description: By tracing lines across matching tiles on the gameboard to battle foes and gather resources, Dungeon Quest delivers a dungeon‑crawling turn‑based RPG with an old‑school soul. Explore the depths, uncover secrets, gather loot, and grow your arsenal of unique abilities.

apps.name: Devil Lift
apps.short_description: Demon hunting is a day job in Devil Lift, a tag battle roguelike deckbuilder. Play as the Lilith Society, a group of underpaid and overworked demon hunters as they protect humanity from the Archbeasts of the Underworld before their shift ends.

apps.name: DeVILSTOPIA
apps.short_description: Devilstopia is a grid strategy battle roguelike inspired by retro classic games. Collect diverse skills, unleash creative combos, and overcome powerful foes. Unpredictable dangers await in a mysterious world.

apps.name: Devour & Evolve
apps.short_description: You are born at the bottom of the food chain, in a first-person maze that grows more dangerous the deeper it runs. Weaken your prey, then choose: devour it, or bind it and carry it home. What you carry home lives in your nest, pairs, and lays — and the egg it lays is the body you wake up in next.

apps.name: Dice and Daydream
apps.short_description: Roll five dice, use limited rerolls to shape the result, and play cards powered by your dice total. Combos like pairs and straights trigger bonus effects. Build your deck in a childhood-daydream roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Dice Hoarder
apps.short_description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

apps.name: Dice Looter
apps.short_description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

apps.name: Dice Shepherd: Incremental
apps.short_description: A small incremental game about rolling d4 to d100 dice on a grassy field. Every roll pays gold and fodder. Spend it on promotions and skills that sinergize. Play it idle or hands-on, the numbers keep climbing.

apps.name: Dice Throne Digital
apps.short_description: The official digital adaptation of the hit board game, Dice Throne. Dice Throne Digital is a tactical 1v1 hero battler, where dice meet strategy. Roll for powerful abilities, play cards to bend your luck, and outplay your opponent.

apps.name: Die Trying
apps.short_description: Plunge into a world ravaged by the dead in this hilarious co-op shooter. Blending silly antics with open-world sandbox freedom. Escape with a plethora of loot, or Die Trying!

apps.name: Diecast
apps.short_description: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

apps.name: DIESELDOME: Ultraviolent Gladiator Shooter
apps.short_description: DIESELDOME is an ultra-violent Roguelite FPS that fuses movement shooter combat with Survivors-like mechanics. Enter a brutal tournament, shred endless hordes, gamble your gold, bet your blood, and break the game with absurd power for the entertainment of a ruthless Roman-punk crowd.

apps.name: Diggems
apps.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

apps.name: DIGITAL EXORCIST
apps.short_description: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississippi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

apps.name: Digsum
apps.short_description: A relaxed incremental mining game about digging deeper, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering ancient artifacts.

apps.name: DIMAZE
apps.short_description: The instant an enemy starts casting, swallow the spell, magic circle and all. Fire their fireballs and lasers right back at them. The stronger the enemy, the stronger your weapon. Climb an ever-changing tower in this 3D action roguelite.

apps.name: Dirty Mop
apps.short_description: Your father vanished from this building years ago. Now you're their janitor — and the master key opens every door. Snoop, scheme, and seduce your way to the truth in this isometric adult adventure where every secret you uncover becomes your favorite new toy.

apps.name: Disc Treks
apps.short_description: Disc Treks is a sandbox disc golf game with exploration, gathering, course modification and building.  Intuitive physics-based gameplay that captures the feel of the disc flight.

apps.name: Distant Trails
apps.short_description: Explore open forest, steep mountains and muddy singletrack in this easy-paced outdoor adventure. Take a crew of trail runners out to remote locations to repair damage, protect nature and investigate unexpected events with only their feet for transport and a backpack to carry supplies.

apps.name: Dodge Mayhem
apps.short_description: Dodge Mayhem is a fast-paced top-down arena game about dodging, grabbing, charging, and throwing.

apps.name: Domain Expansion
apps.short_description: Draw lines and claim territory in a 3D arcade action game. Read enemy movements, choose between safer captures and bold DEEP cuts, and take on 24 stages followed by a tougher second loop.

apps.name: DomeLand
apps.short_description: Leaving the city behind, driving a pickup truck to a remote wilderness to build a dome farm from scratch. Hand-fabricating components, erecting shelters, growing crops, and running an aquaponics system, then bringing the harvest straight to the farm table.

apps.name: Dominion Arena
apps.short_description: A sci-fi roguelite auto battler where you recruit a squad of cyber-enhanced fighters, combine skills and items, adapt your build between rounds, and face other players' lineups in asynchronous tournaments to climb the rankings.

apps.name: Dominoir
apps.short_description:
Dominoir is a domino roguelike where every tile can make—or break—your run. Build clever chains, close wraps, stack powerful Schemes and Marks, and chase outrageous scores. Outsmart the House, bend its rules, and prove that at this table, luck is only the beginning.
Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

apps.name: DON'T LET THEM BOARD!
apps.short_description: It's 21XX. AI rules the world, and every morning humanity is crammed onto commuter trains bound for a life of servitude. Pick one of six oddball heroes, then punch, kick and blast the crowd off the platform before the doors close. Chaotic action with online co-op for up to 3 players.

apps.name: Doodle Duel
apps.short_description: Turn quick sketches into brave warriors in a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Draw fighters, weapons, armor and skills, match elemental colors, defeat patterned bosses, and climb an arena tower with a team that is uniquely yours.

apps.name: Doomed Crew
apps.short_description: Co-op Horror (1-4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?

apps.name: Doughby
apps.short_description: Doughby, a little donut with a hole lot of heart, left home to collect the strangest things in the world of Torlo. Carry them. Throw them. Put them somewhere stupid. Explore abstract, odd puzzles in this wordless, harmless comedy.

apps.name: Down Range
apps.short_description: Experience a tactical shooter that blends arcade and realism! Choose between 2 game modes and jump straight into combat solo or with friends on the battlefield, or use a game master mode to build your own scenario. Customize weapons, uniforms, gear, and gameplay parameters. Your fight, your rules!

apps.name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27
apps.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27. Build through the draft, trades and free agency, manage contracts and rotations, develop your players and create the strategy that will turn your team into a dynasty.

apps.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN!  Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

apps.name: Dragon Fields
apps.short_description: Live the simple life in this cozy game where you farm crops, go fishing, play music, raise and mutate dragons, and customize your character!

apps.name: Dragon Riders
apps.short_description: An Ethical Gacha Game, Story-Driven BL or Bara Romance VN, and Card Battler! Bond with a SENTIENT dragon and date 1 of 4 customizable Love Interests! Card battles, team management, deck building, gacha unlocks, rich lore, dragon/dragon love, dragon/human, and a way to become a dragon yourself!

apps.name: Dread Pilots
apps.short_description: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

apps.name: Dream Broadcast Simulator
apps.short_description: Run the little TV station that broadcasts a sleeping city's dreams. Choose three dream tapes a night, fit each to its timeslot, lock the signal, and keep your Dreamers tuned in for 21 nights. A cozy strategy game built for one-more-night runs.

apps.name: DreamForge
apps.short_description: DreamForge is an AI-powered gaming platform where you create, play, and share highly personalized story adventure games. Design games, shape characters, and explore unique stories created by you and your friends.

apps.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
apps.short_description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

apps.name: DRIFTIT
apps.short_description: Top-down drift racing with deep arcade physics. Throw one car sideways through 20 hand-built tracks in five low-poly worlds, chain slides for points, chase your own ghost and set the fastest three-lap time on Steam leaderboards checked against every run's replay.

apps.name: Drownlight
apps.short_description: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

apps.name: Drug Dealer 2049
apps.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

apps.name: Drums & Steel
apps.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

apps.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator
apps.short_description: Make, pack, and ring up Dubai chewy cookies! Run a small shop all on your own in a Korean university neighborhood in this first-person management sim. Face growing crowds and comic mishaps as you discover how much more hectic a shopkeeper's day gets when business starts booming.

apps.name: Duck Duck Shoot!
apps.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

apps.name: Dude Simulator: New Home
apps.short_description: Dude Simulator: New Home - an open-world sandbox game. A sudden cold snap hits your town, forcing you to hastily pack up and move to a new home in a different city.

apps.name: DULL ACHE
apps.short_description: A horrifying JRPG-inspired adventure follows a sequence of events that multiple people experience after one fateful day... Find their wills to live throughout a multi-chapter story.

apps.name: Dumpster Divers
apps.short_description: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

apps.name: Dungeon Depths
apps.short_description:
Dungeoneer is a rouge-like, RPG, souls-like maybe future MMO game.

Taking big inspiration from Dark Souls, Runescape, Hypixels Skyblock, Metin 2 and Enter The Gungeon.

apps.name: Dungeon Lurker
apps.short_description: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

apps.name: Dungeonbowl Knockout Edition
apps.short_description: Dungeonbowl ups the danger of the American Football inspired sport by adding exploding chests, teleporters, lava and other traps in dangerous dungeons!

apps.name: Dungeons & Furry
apps.short_description: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

apps.name: Dungeons & Runestones
apps.short_description:
A turn-based digital tabletop RPG with a built-in Dungeon Master. 
Unlike other virtual tabletops, the Dungeon Master is included. 
No setup, no scheduling, just create your heroes and begin your adventure.

apps.name: Dunthera
apps.short_description:
Construct your towers, guide your hero, and resist escalating waves of monsters.
Collect resources from enemies, select impactful cards, face powerful bosses, upgrade your towers and hero to control the fate of your battlefield !

apps.name: Dwarf Forge
apps.short_description: Dwarf Forge is a top-down arcade forge-defense game. Heat raining metal in a rotating ring of flame, hammer it into weapons and armor, then wield your work against the goblins trying to steal your forge.

apps.name: Dwarf Wars
apps.short_description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

apps.name: Dwelling on the Hill
apps.short_description: A devout man built his house on top of something older than scripture. He tried to seal the passage. He failed. Now you are inside, and the door is locked.

apps.name: Dyna-Brix
apps.short_description:
Dyna-brix is the new indie brick breaker game.
Destroy bricks on dynamic levels to an original and dynamic soundtrack, with precise controls and physics and minimalistic and readable visuals.

apps.name: DYTH
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

apps.name: E-Files
apps.short_description: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

apps.name: Echo Era
apps.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

apps.name: Echo in the Lightless Deep
apps.short_description: Echo in the Lightless Deep is a deep-sea survivor roguelite. Symbionts fight for you; you steer, dodge and build. The brighter your core, the farther you see and strike, and the more the deep sends at you. Five giants guard the way down. At the bottom, choose: return to the light, or stay dark.

apps.name: ECHO//syntax
apps.short_description:
Awaken. Scavenge. Survive.

ECHO//syntax is a beat-em-up scrapper game set in a far future robotic world.

apps.name: Echonox: Echoes of Heartholm
apps.short_description: ECHONOX is an online role-playing game for solo play or with friends: Fighter, Scout or Adept, eight peoples, a land full of secrets and giants only a party can defeat.

apps.name: Eclipse Conquest
apps.short_description: Eclipse Conquest is a 3D fantasy trading card game. Build your deck, open boosters and face other players in tactical turn-based duels, or sharpen your strategy against the AI on richly detailed battlefields.

apps.name: Eclipse: Corrupted Galaxy
apps.short_description: After falling into the underground of the company where you work, you must escape while game characters come to life and hunt you down. Explore dark environments, solve puzzles, and reveal the obscure secrets of Ruzu Co. to discover the story hidden behind the scenes...

apps.name: Ecstatica
apps.short_description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

apps.name: Ecstatica II
apps.short_description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

apps.name: Egg Rush
apps.short_description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling roguelite game. Collect a wealth of treasures and items to power yourself up, encounter all kinds of special events, and use their abilities wisely to overcome every challenge!

apps.name: Eggstra Tidy
apps.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Hatch helper chicks, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

apps.name: EinStein
apps.short_description: An alchemy roguelike where you spin your wheel and watch items devour, merge, and upgrade one another. Collect relics, trigger chain reactions, and snowball your Magic—every run carves out a unique alchemical path.

apps.name: Eisenkiefer
apps.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

apps.name: Elder Hills
apps.short_description:
Survive fifteen minutes on six hills against rhythm-possessed hordes. Discover 29 weapons, 27 evolutions and 15 super evolutions across 8 classes. A dark-fantasy beat driven bullet-heaven roguelite.


Let the rhythm set you free.

apps.name: Electric Crust: Galactic Pizza Delivery
apps.short_description: Fifteen stages of side-scrolling arcade shooting, wrapped around the worst pizza delivery route in the galaxy. Bullet patterns, boss tiers, and a rank ladder Ace never asked for. One-time purchase. No ads. No IAP. No data collection.

apps.name: Elemental Lands
apps.short_description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

apps.name: Elements Destiny
apps.short_description: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional journey with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

apps.name: Elementys
apps.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

apps.name: Elmer
apps.short_description: Elmer is a Metroidvania-style adventure game. Your presence here is the proof that you are seeking your own original sin, your own mask.

apps.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
apps.short_description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and restore the ancient fortress of Sunveil.

apps.name: Emanet: Milli Mücadele
apps.short_description: Wars are not only won on the front lines. Experience an atmospheric 2D adventure set in occupied Anatolia through the eyes of a child. Sneak past patrols, solve non-violent puzzles, and discover authentic historical artifacts.

apps.name: Ember and Ash: The Cradle
apps.short_description: A fantasy story game about a long road and the people who walk it with you. Choose your path, fight with timing and skill, grow close to your companions, and face an ending shaped by every choice you made.

apps.name: Emberville
apps.short_description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

apps.name: Emoji Combo Arena
apps.short_description: Mix two emojis. Unleash ridiculous combos. Blast your friends in a chaotic online party FPS for up to 4 players! Discover 70+ combos, from exploding crying faces to screaming meteors. Battle free-for-all or 2v2, or jump into a match against bots.

apps.name: Empires of Black Powder
apps.short_description: A Napoleonic RTS with card-based army building and direct commander combat on horseback to support your troops. Open packs, equip your regiments, and command combined arms of infantry, cavalry, and artillery in real-time battles. Keep your veteran guard alive and bring them into the next battle.

apps.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
apps.short_description: A 4X asynchronous galactic strategy game. Eight houses, one shattered galaxy, two to eight commanders. Design fleets, fight three-band battles with named captains, and take your turn when you have ten minutes. Campaigns can run for weeks without a fixed game night.

apps.name: Ending Vorrak
apps.short_description: It is thousands. You must end it. A top-down co-op shooter for 1-4 players against one living swarm, and you can throw every bug in it. Blast them into walls. Crush them under the hive's own bones. Feed them to a tornado. If you go down, the swarm turns you against your own crew.

apps.name: Endurance Motorsport Series
apps.short_description: Endurance Motorsport Series immerses you in the heart of this unique experience: get behind the wheel as a driver, but also step into the shoes of the race engineer to make crucial decisions from the pit lane.

apps.name: Enmity: Warfare
apps.short_description: Enmity: Warfare I is a modern-era multiplayer real-time strategy game where players command armies, manage logistics, and control provinces across a large-scale battlefield to shape the outcome of war.

apps.name: Envido
apps.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

apps.name: Eredian Stronghold
apps.short_description: Push lanes, capture buildings, and defend your base in this fast-paced Action RPG. Slaughter hordes of enemies, find legendary loot, and fight your way to the Stronghold of Eredian.

apps.name: Escalation Pending
apps.short_description:
Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required.
A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

apps.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
apps.short_description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

apps.name: Escape from Playtime
apps.short_description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

apps.name: EscapeFromSeoul
apps.short_description: Explore, fight, and extract from a Seoul built from text and symbols. A real-time, top-down PvE extraction shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 3 players. Scavenge gear, customize weapons, complete contracts, and upgrade your hideout.

apps.name: Evac Bay 09
apps.short_description: You're trapped in the seemingly endless corridors of a space station, desperately searching for the evacuation bay 09. But the station is not as empty as it seems; you must observe for subtle, unsettling occurrences and log them if you want to move forward. Can you break the loop and escape?

apps.name: EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR
apps.short_description: Build your own club, plan events, and master lighting, sound, drinks, power, and guests. Design your venue freely, host parties, concerts, and more – a crazy sandbox simulator packed with systems, chaos, and surprises.

apps.name: Everburning Dark
apps.short_description: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

apps.name: Everlong
apps.short_description: The storm takes the island one stone at a time, and only the last hero standing ever sees it pass.

apps.name: Everything Mart
apps.short_description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

apps.name: Evil Cabin
apps.short_description: Tocantins, Brazil, 1978. A storm chaser's car dies by an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere. The night is long, the woods are dense, and the radio keeps talking to him. First-person psychological horror.

apps.name: Expedition Idle
apps.short_description: An idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters!

apps.name: Explosiovania
apps.short_description: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

apps.name: Extra Terrestrial Perception
apps.short_description: Walking outside one night, bright lights appear overhead. You wake aboard an alien ship. Use your resourcefulness, along with newfound psychic powers to overcome the enemies and obstacles that stand in the way of escape.

apps.name: Eye of Syn
apps.short_description: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

apps.name: Fabriek
apps.short_description: Dig into a first-person factory game. Mine resources, craft and connect machines into automated production lines. Make your space beautiful.

apps.name: Face Picka
apps.short_description:
Play board games with friends using faces you draw yourself! 
FacePicka is a board game café simulation 
where you create your own faces, enjoy fun mini-games, pull pranks, and switch expressions as you play.

apps.name: FaceRobots
apps.short_description: Chaotic 1-4 player co-op with ragdoll physics. You're tiny robots wearing your live webcam as a face. Smash trash cans and suitcases, sell the loot, unlock new zones and take down ridiculous bosses, from a dumpster that swallows players to a giant poop king.

apps.name: Facial Expression Variety Show
apps.short_description: Make a face. Steal the show! Mimic wild expressions on camera in Facial Expression Variety Show. Practice across 10 solo rounds or compete online with up to 6 players. Take turns in the spotlight, compare scores, and celebrate on the podium. Your face is the main event!

apps.name: Fall of Bali
apps.short_description: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided into many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has seen war for nearly two centuries and now the threat of imperialism has come. With all your might and potential, can you survive and win this era?

apps.name: FalseGods Gambit
apps.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

apps.name: Family Gambling
apps.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

apps.name: Fantasy World Manager
apps.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

apps.name: Far Company
apps.short_description: Crew a starship with up to three friends. Fly its fighters, man its guns, board enemy ships and rob them blind, and carry each other home. Or throw each other out of the hangar. Friendly fire is on. The feed remembers who did it.

apps.name: Farm Break
apps.short_description: Farm Break is a 3D arcade game in which you play as Piggo the piglet. Moving from wall to wall, you need to paint every corner of the pen to advance. But be careful: some of them aren't as safe as they seem.

apps.name: Farmkill Remastered
apps.short_description: Defend your newly acquired farmhouse and garden from an ever-growing zombie horde that attacks every night. Buy deadly flowers, fences, fully automatic weapons, bombs, exploding chickens and more to defend your farm at all costs!

apps.name: FarmWings
apps.short_description: A vertical idle shmup: your fighter flies, dodges and shoots on its own, and you command its evolution. Beat adaptive AI bosses across 5 biomes and 3 difficulty modes, forge gear up to +10 and trade items on the Steam Community Market. Always in a corner of your screen.

apps.name: Farstrand
apps.short_description: Seven years after HELIOBANE, a cartographer wakes on a cold world with an arm of alien glass. Freeze the hive's creatures into platforms, grow its buds into bridges, feed them until they burst, and map six worlds on the frozen roads between stars. An Amiga-style sci-fi metroidvania.

apps.name: Farthest
apps.short_description: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

apps.name: Fate & Pivot
apps.short_description: Fate & Pivot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game where risk brings reward. Survive as blocks appear naturally, or spawn more to double your score multiplier. Master color combinations, face unpredictable Fates, and push your luck. How far will you go?

apps.name: Fate Candle: Three Kingdoms - Chronicle Restored
apps.short_description: Armies are easy to raise. A true general is hard to recognize. After the fire at Red Cliffs, heroes scatter under aliases. Rise from one city, judge them by deeds, and restore their names. Govern, forge bonds, grow your faction, and win ten-slot battles to end the chaos before the world collapses.

apps.name: Fathom Reach
apps.short_description: An underwater roguelike deckbuilder where every dive is a gamble. Chain explosive card combos, push deeper for richer loot, and surface before your hull breaks. Bring the haul home to upgrade your deck and build a base other players can raid while you're away.

apps.name: Feetball
apps.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

apps.name: FIGHT-QUEST
apps.short_description: Punch, slash, and blast through hordes of fairy-tale creatures in this first-person action roguelite. Stack absurd abilities, conquer deadly arenas, and bank your hard-earned gold for new unlocks.

apps.name: Figure Me Out
apps.short_description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

apps.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
apps.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

apps.name: Finger of Blood
apps.short_description: A classic first-person horde shooter where your weapon is your own hand. Shoot with a finger gun, parry every blow with perfect timing and riposte with knife or fists. Survive endless waves, spend souls at the trader, stack perks into brutal builds and take down enemies.

apps.name: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion
apps.short_description: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion is a fast-session rogue-like in which sitting on your throne allows you to reign over the battlefield.

apps.name: First Person Basketball
apps.short_description: First-person online basketball, from 1v1 to 5v5. Drive past defenders, find an open teammate, or finish at the rim. Simple controls: just WASD, Space and the mouse. Play with friends, challenge the AI, or practice your shot.

apps.name: FirstPlate
apps.short_description: Run a restaurant under constant pressure. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely to host dozens of tables. Curate your menu and adapt your layout as you grow. Play solo, team up in co-op, or battle for customers in the upcoming competitive Versus mode.

apps.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
apps.short_description: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.

apps.name: Five Nines - Datacenter Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own datacenter in first person, solo or in 4-player co-op. Rack servers, hand-route every RJ45, fiber and power cable, meet your SLAs, survive outages and chase the five nines: 99.999% uptime.

apps.name: Flag Conquest
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

apps.name: Flag Fiasco : Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidy-up game where the whole world is a mess. Find 2,000 flags scattered across a grand oval room, spot the fakes, rescue flags from plushies and put every one back where it belongs on a giant world map. No timers, just order.

apps.name: Flempire
apps.short_description: Flempire is a mix of 1. person action shooting and RTS in a fantasy world. Switch between having the full overview of the entire battlefield, constructing buildings, controlling groups of units, or choose to be in the middle of it, become a rank-an-file unit or a hero with special abilities.

apps.name: FLICKSHOT
apps.short_description: FLICKSHOT is a hyper-stylish physics-based fighting game focused on using recoil to blast your ship around the arena. Come for party game chaos, stay for deep competitive tech and skill expression. Ricochet around 40+ stages to a bumpin’ soundtrack with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Foodland Puzzle
apps.short_description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

apps.name: Football
apps.short_description: Lead your nation on an epic journey to become World Cup Champions, from spectacular strikes to unforgettable victories, and write your name in football history.

apps.name: For the Common Wealth
apps.short_description: 2.5D Realtime Tactics. Based in an alternative history and future Australia, this Cannon Fodder-inspired game pays homage to classic Amiga titles. Story-led, control your 6 SASR operatives using a selection of weapons. You decide how to tackle a mission, pick day or night, loud or quiet.

apps.name: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter
apps.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, japanese-styled role playing video game in the Forgiveness RPG franchise!

apps.name: Fortress Connected
apps.short_description: Jump in and experience the tense action of Half-Life 2, Left 4 Dead, and many other worlds as your favourite gang of Mann Co. hired guns, as well as a few new faces in this crossing of various source engine worlds.

apps.name: Foundlings
apps.short_description: Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, consort with cunning daemons, watch the motions of the planets and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose.

apps.name: Four Walls Inc.
apps.short_description: Run one hotel or a thousand. Grow your own brands or build hotels for others to run, buy out rival chains, invest in land with partners and joint ventures, and set up regional offices that run on their own. A tycoon about how hotel companies really grow.

apps.name: Fox Arcana
apps.short_description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

apps.name: Fred Fuches Around
apps.short_description: Fred Fuches Around is an FPS game where a guy named Fred and (almost) all of his immediate family was killed inside of his home and now the ones who fuched around will find out.

apps.name: Frequency: Chernobyl
apps.short_description: An immersive adventure game about the secrets of radio broadcasts. Take a journey to the Exclusion Zone, face the time anomaly, and solve the mystery behind the broadcasts from 1986.

apps.name: Friendship Boat
apps.short_description: Rock the boat. Test your friendship. Push, grab and throw your way through a physics party for 2–4 players, or try to keep a tiny boat afloat together in a chaotic two-player voyage. Rescue your friend, cause the next disaster, and let the aftermath do the talking.

apps.name: From Misfortune Comes
apps.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

apps.name: Frozen Echo
apps.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

apps.name: FrQ
apps.short_description: FrQ is a collection of audio-reactive arcade games and music visualizer where your music becomes the game. Play anything you like through Spotify, YouTube or your favorite music app, then watch as the gameplay, levels and psychedelic visuals react to your music in real time.

apps.name: Fruitless Campaign
apps.short_description: Set the azimuth, elevation and launch speed, read the wind and the weather, and lob shells across endless procedurally generated islands to destroy every fruit. Play untimed on Easy or race the clock on Normal and Hard. Earn weapons from airdropped crates, or take on up to three friends online.

apps.name: Fuel Needed
apps.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

apps.name: Fuman Ghoul
apps.short_description:
A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters.
Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

apps.name: Gambapets
apps.short_description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

apps.name: Gambeat
apps.short_description: Start with pawns, end with clowns. Build a roster of evolving pieces, stack game-breaking stickers, and chain together absurd high scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Gambiarra Garage
apps.short_description: Gambiarra Garage is a car mechanic game inspired by 2000s Brazilian car culture. You inherit your grandfather’s garage and start from scratch, dismantling, assembling, and repairing cars with realistic systems. Improvisation, creativity, and your decisions shape every result.

apps.name: Gate Fall
apps.short_description: An astronaut falls through an ancient Gate onto an unknown world. Dig with your laser, fly with your jetpack, build a factory, help living towns… then cross the Gate: crystal lands, a floating Paradise, and three epic bosses in 2D, 3D and first person.

apps.name: GearGrit
apps.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

apps.name: GemSlasher
apps.short_description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

apps.name: Generated Hero
apps.short_description:
Combine skill parts to create your own hero!
Take your hero into the dungeon and aim to conquer all 100 floors!

apps.name: GeoChaos Rumble
apps.short_description: GeoChaos Rumble is a hand-drawn 2D multiplayer brawler for 2–4 players. Battle across forts and platforms: drain your rivals' health or knock them into the sea! Discover 70+ weapons and 20+ random events that bring new twists to every fight.

apps.name: Geoplanetical
apps.short_description: A geopolitical simulation that starts on January 1, 2026, with the world as it stood that day. Govern one of 200+ nations and territories, or lead its opposition: laws, budget, elections, strikes, diplomacy, war. The other governments never wait for you. No scenarios, no end date.

apps.name: Get Nowhere
apps.short_description: Read immersive dialogue sequences, make crucial choices to shift the storyline, and unlock multiple distinct endings in this story-focused visual novel. Your decisions alter character relationships and rewrite the fate of every role.

apps.name: Gilded Shoals
apps.short_description: A relaxing incremental fishing game with short voyages and lasting upgrades. Explore five coastal locations, chase rare catches and Golden Shoals, and build a living aquarium with unlockable backdrops and freely placed decorations.

apps.name: GILDEN
apps.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

apps.name: Ginga Legends
apps.short_description: A football roguelike deckbuilder with tactical depth on and off the pitch. Build your club, chain the perfect play, and climb from amateur pitches all the way to the top league.

apps.name: Glintland
apps.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

apps.name: Global Parity
apps.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance budgets, pass laws through parliament, win elections, forge alliances and wage war on a living front line, while AI nations build, scheme and fight around you. Every decision has a price.

apps.name: Gloomy Tavern Stories
apps.short_description: A fantasy potion crafting game where you experience the life of an alchemist. Gather materials that you can craft into different types of potions. Potions can be used as bombs. Solve puzzles by utilizing the effects of your potions. Hire heroes as mercenaries to battle monsters and bosses.

apps.name: Glorybound
apps.short_description: The horde moves when you end your turn. Command up to three champions in a turn-based survival roguelite. Reposition, combine spells, and shatter frozen enemies with steel. Survive 100 rounds and spend earned renown on permanent upgrades.

apps.name: GloveUp!
apps.short_description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

apps.name: Glyphtrip
apps.short_description: GLYPHTRIP is a raycast ASCII dungeon-crawling roguelike where the beat runs through the world you have to navigate. Instructions are sparse. Explanation is fleeting. The deeper you go, the less reliable either becomes.

apps.name: Goblin Hoarder
apps.short_description: Sort thousands of stolen treasures and transform a chaotic goblin cave into the ultimate organized hoard.

apps.name: God Codex
apps.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

apps.name: God of Strafe
apps.short_description: God of Strafe is a hand-drawn cosmic bullet-hell looter. Pilot four starfighters, build a moon-phase board of 24 chips and 8 double-faced cores, and tear through planetary gods' bullet patterns. Kill bosses, take loot, retune your build, dive deeper. Local JSON mods supported.

apps.name: Gods & Liars
apps.short_description: Gods & Liars is an 8-player social deduction game of faith, deception and survival. Hidden Heretics strike at night while the Priest and Inquisitor fight to expose them. Lie, accuse, deceive and survive — because when God is watching, no one can be trusted.

apps.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
apps.short_description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

apps.name: Godzone 6
apps.short_description: Build your own mutant! Each one must find their own unique way to escape the Godzone in the world's first first-person mutator - from the creators of Void Bastards and Wild Bastards.

apps.name: Gold Dredge Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own dredging operation, explore abandoned dredges, recover valuable parts, bring your machinery back to life, and expand operations in your hunt for gold rush. Play solo or team up with friends and see how far your gold rush can take you.

apps.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
apps.short_description: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.

apps.name: Golf Sim Sim
apps.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

apps.name: Good Children Say Grace
apps.short_description: My parents adopted an orphan who burned down her house. I haven't slept since my girlfriend disappeared. Now everything looks like eggs. Good Children Say Grace.

apps.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
apps.short_description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

apps.name: Gorilla Gauntlet
apps.short_description: Punch, Smash, and Slam your way through an army of ragdolling enemies to become the ultimate Gorilla. Zoom across arenas with your snappy Dash and Spin moves. Unlock cosmetics and face new foes as you progress through the Gorilla Gauntlet!

apps.name: Gorilla Racers
apps.short_description: Gorilla Racers is a colourful arcade racer. Drift, boost and fire your nitro through eleven wild arenas, alone or online with up to 4 players. Toss the Coconut Bomb, grab the Golden Banana, collect and upgrade cars and gorilla drivers, open packs and climb the trophy road.

apps.name: Gotching
apps.short_description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

apps.name: Grab Your Deck
apps.short_description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

apps.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨
apps.short_description: A wild 1980s crime adventure where dating, dirty jobs, drag races, shootouts, and adult fun collide. Explore the city, make money, build relationships, and cause trouble as you work your way toward the biggest score of your life.

apps.name: Grave Ambition
apps.short_description: They used the Overlord as a training dummy. Bad idea... In this casual voxel incremental action-RPG, every recruit you smash leaves a stat in your bones. Grind, evolve into new undead forms and climb seven floors to the five heroes who put you there.

apps.name: Graveyard Orbit
apps.short_description: A relaxed space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Drift through a neon-lit megastructure. Pick it clean, tile by tile. Trade your haul for parts, experiment with your ship's build, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.

apps.name: GRAVHOUNDS
apps.short_description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

apps.name: Greedy Getaways
apps.short_description:
Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways!
Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!

apps.name: Green Again
apps.short_description: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!

apps.name: Gregor's Tithe
apps.short_description: You and up to 5 friends must raid and pillage to satisfy Gregor or face his very, very large and mighty wrath.

apps.name: Gremlin Party '03
apps.short_description: Gremlin Party '03 is a cartoon platform fighter loosely inspired by the game that started it all.

apps.name: Greyward: Castaway Survival
apps.short_description: Wash ashore on a misty island, build a camp and survive the Grey: a night mist that burns. Climb endless rune towers, break the Grey camps and free their chiefs, sail to eight far islands, and play solo or in Steam co-op with up to four castaways.

apps.name: GRID OPS
apps.short_description: Premium, single-player open-world extraction shooter set in a San Francisco warzone. Scout with UAV radar, hijack vehicles, take a combat helicopter armed with minigun and missiles, clear hostile territory, and reach extraction alive.

apps.name: Gridfire
apps.short_description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

apps.name: Gridiron Remastered
apps.short_description: Control one player in high-octane 7v7 american football action. Compete from an immersive third-person view and work with your squad to dominate the competition. Precision physics based passing, explosive runs, and strategic coordination. This is football reimagined for competitive online play.

apps.name: GridPi: Defense 3014
apps.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

apps.name: Grimdelve
apps.short_description: The world above is gone. Guide two souls through a rotting underground and shape who they become with character traits in this grimdark role playing game. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Anyone can die, your choices matter, and people remember how you treat them.

apps.name: Grimmloch
apps.short_description: A persistent text-based MMORPG where NPCs remember your secrets and shape a living world rooted in European folklore. Turn-based tactical combat, criminal gameplay, and collaborative storytelling that writes itself into canon. Built by Role-players for Role-players.

apps.name: Grimoire of Blanks
apps.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks in your cards with words and turn the same sentence into traps, area attacks, or reckless combos. A roguelite deckbuilder for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
apps.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

apps.name: Grind Grid
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

apps.name: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
apps.short_description: Open packs, collect absurd Grombos, and build your own card shop. Hunt rare and shiny cards, complete your collection, and decide which treasures to keep or sell. Decorate your store, deal with peculiar customers, and hire staff to keep business running.

apps.name: GuGuGaGa-DeskPet
apps.short_description:
The little penguin that shakes its head and makes that goofy "GuGuGaGa" sound – a viral meme across the internet – has now come to your desktop!
Different interactions will trigger her unique reactions – after all, she is that very meme penguin with all those expressive emotes!

apps.name: Gun Goose
apps.short_description: The most realistic goose simulator ever made... Gun Goose is a fast-paced shooter where you play as a goose with guns. HONK AND LOAD!

apps.name: Gunfetti
apps.short_description: Every match is a brawl in this 2D pixel-art multiplayer shooter. Characters with completely different skills pile into the fight over the zone. Take it with your team, or clean house in a free-for-all.

apps.name: Guns of Eschaton
apps.short_description: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

apps.name: Guns, Princess and Braves
apps.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

apps.name: Hack Protocol
apps.short_description: Hack Protocol is a multiplayer hacking sim where you build software, breach servers, steal data, upgrade your hardware, and cover your tracks. Play solo against NPCs but watch out for other players to compete with other hackers. Clean your logs!

apps.name: HAEX
apps.short_description: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.

apps.name: Hail of Hexes
apps.short_description: Featuring five playable characters, over thirty gameplay-altering items, and over eight unique upgradeable spells, every Hail of Hexes run will be unique. Explore new builds and truly master the classic arcade combat in this hand-drawn side-scrolling shoot-em-up.

apps.name: Half Faith Tower
apps.short_description: Ascend an endless tower in this dark fantasy roguelite where strategy meets luck. Arrange your weapons, drop the orb, and unleash powerful attacks, defenses, and magic. Face increasingly deadly enemies, grow stronger, and fight to survive. Every floor is a new challenge. How high can you climb?

apps.name: Hallelujah!
apps.short_description: Cause an outrageous amount of bloodshed, raze countless buildings, and abuse the God-given blessings bestowed upon Samson in this raw action roguelike retelling of the Bible’s most savage warrior.

apps.name: Halloween 3D
apps.short_description: A haunted manor, its creatures and nine letters to gather. Explore the levels alone, fight up to four friends online, or build the shared manor with every player: a world made of blocks that everyone reshapes, and that stays.

apps.name: Halloween On Goober Street
apps.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences.  With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

apps.name: Halloween Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Race through a whimsical haunted manor, gather matching clutter into your satchel, return every treasure to its proper place, and banish mischievous spirits before the clock strikes midnight.

apps.name: Hammered Heroes
apps.short_description: Hammered Heroes is a fantasy Auto-Battler Roguelite where you recruit a drunken band of heroes, build your party, and descend through an ever-deeper dungeon. Choose your classes, upgrades, and path, then watch your heroes brawl automatically. Die, grow stronger, and descend again.

apps.name: Hanafuda
apps.short_description: Discover the traditional Japanese 🎴Hanafuda (花札 - Flower Cards) games, brought to life as a beautiful, modern 3D tabletop game. Match cards to create pairs, complete a set and collect points, or call Koi-Koi to risk it all for more. Play against the computer, or other players online.

apps.name: Hand Eternal
apps.short_description: Dropkick homunculi and escape soulless machinations as an undying runner in a nauseating first-person parkour gauntlet.

apps.name: Hand Me The Splorch!
apps.short_description:
Get your dad the tools he needs before he blows a fuse!
Navigate a dark and dingy garage to find tools, fix breakers, do paperwork (those lawyers just keep calling), and much more all while your dad verbally assaults you. Will you have the fortitude to succeed?

apps.name: Hardpack Rally
apps.short_description: Vern, a retired rally driver, leaves you an old two-door and a note on the hood. Slide through woodland bends, mountain passes, snowy hills and open desert. Beat Vern’s stage times and earn the next set of keys as you progress through a single-player arcade rally career.

apps.name: Hardship
apps.short_description: Hardship is a set on a dynamic world in a strange solar system. Build your city, Design your buildings and progress through an in-depth technology tree.  Gather resources, craft tools, manage citizens’ needs, and battle the elements.

apps.name: Harmony Of Tea
apps.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

apps.name: Harmony Strike
apps.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

apps.name: Harrowlands
apps.short_description: Harrowlands is a medieval fantasy colony sim where you build your settlement, manage Fateborn with unique traits, shape relationships, survive raids, magical threats, and the demands of a powerful kingdom.

apps.name: Harvest Story
apps.short_description: Merge ingredients on a tiny platform, cook up dishes, and sell your way to survival. The landlord shows up every week like clockwork, and rent only gets steeper—so merging isn't enough, you need a plan. Hire robots to automate production, unlock a tech tree to expand your farm.

apps.name: Hatchbar
apps.short_description: A little village lives in a strip at the bottom of your screen. While you work, adventurers hunt on their own, wielding the Hatchlings you raise as weapons. Enhance them until they take on a new look, mix any two into a new one, and follow the village journal. One price, no ads.

apps.name: Haunted Ghost Hunters
apps.short_description: Become a ghost hunter! Enter forbidden places crawling with paranormal activity. 🦇 Lost mansions, abandoned asylums, forgotten graveyards, decaying castles... Grab your gear. Enter the fog. Reveal what hides within.

apps.name: Haunted House Director
apps.short_description: You don’t survive the haunted house. You run it. Haunt a cast who think, argue, and panic on their own. Feed on their fear, grow your ghost, and direct the night until they break. No two hauntings go the same way.

apps.name: Haunted Paws
apps.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

apps.name: Hauntworks
apps.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

apps.name: Have you seen my knife?
apps.short_description: More than 1,800 parts from 216 unique guns and 17 ammo boxes rain down on your workshop. Assemble each gun part by part, test-fire it and rack it in its case on the wall. Tidying up has never been this loud.

apps.name: Hazelton Hollow
apps.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

apps.name: Hazzard Hearth
apps.short_description: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

apps.name: Heaps
apps.short_description: Heaps is a genre-defining sandbox game that builds the universe of you. In Heaps, your real world interests generate endless 3D worlds giving you the creative freedom to explore, discover and evolve. All in an environment designed by two neurospicy artists for interest-based nervous systems.

apps.name: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim
apps.short_description: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim is a visual novel that lets you date characters from the beloved renovation simulator. Mend their hearts with your choices, help through relaxing minigames, and find love… or stay single forever!

apps.name: Hearth of the Deep
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game about a dwarf clan digging 200 levels down to rekindle the World's Heart. Break rocks, defeat guardians, hire and upgrade dwarves, grow the Rune Tree and set out on new expeditions.

apps.name: Hearthfield
apps.short_description: Hearthfield is a cozy farming and small-town life sim set in a hand-built 3D valley. Every door opens, the town keeps its own hours, and you can bring up to three friends along. In development and growing, with a new post every month.

apps.name: HEARTSLOT
apps.short_description: Pull the lever, pay each day’s installment, and build a luck-bending skill set across a 12-day contract. Raise a holographic robot’s affection, push the machine into overclock, and survive every bill until the robot of your dreams is finally yours.

apps.name: Heather's Haunted House Party
apps.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl.  A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

apps.name: Heist of Fools
apps.short_description: Team up for chaotic fantasy heists with 2–4 players. Use four thieves’ unique abilities, outsmart guards and traps, haul enchanted loot, and escape before your mistakes bring the owner home.

apps.name: Hell Dream 👺
apps.short_description: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!

apps.name: Hell: Rancor
apps.short_description: A horror walking simulator set in a Japanese residential neighborhood. At night, a mysterious vegetable stall called the "Enkon Stand" appears. They say anyone who eats its strange vegetable, "Enkon," becomes addicted and can never eat anything else. What is the truth behind the rumor?

apps.name: Hello Sunshine
apps.short_description: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

apps.name: Hellsino Pokerlike
apps.short_description: Gamble for your soul in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your life. Build deadly poker hands, unleash massive Nexus combos, and shield your cards from demonic Dealers. Cheat the casino and break the house before it breaks your deck.

apps.name: Hentai Beach 2
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting journey to the sunny beach, where beautiful girls are waiting for you, ready for any adventure! Don't miss the chance to feel like a real hero of erotic fantasy in this exciting clicker game!

apps.name: Hentai Clicker: Akane is streaming
apps.short_description: Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock Akane’s scenes, outfits, and voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Akane is streaming, a playful adult anime clicker.

apps.name: Hentai Clicker: Nefira is streaming
apps.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Nefira, a very naughty Egyptian queen. Unlock outfits, scenes, upgrades, voice reactions, and seductive progression in Hentai clicker: Nefira is streaming.

apps.name: Hentai Puzzle: Lexxa
apps.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Lexxa: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Lexxa, a very naughty succubus. Complete challenges, progress through the game, and unlock tempting images and scenes piece by piece.

apps.name: Her Revenge
apps.short_description: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

apps.name: Heretics Amulet
apps.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

apps.name: Hero Strike
apps.short_description: All the strategy of a classic RTS with zero micro required. Draft your army from 75+ fantasy units, command a leveling Hero, and engineer formations that spawn fresh every wave. Counter your rival, seize the middle line for bonus gold, and crush the enemy Citadel in 3v3 tug-of-war battles.

apps.name: Hexiv
