apps.short_description: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and feed your crew while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

apps.name: Hexshroom
apps.short_description: Run inside a six-sided tunnel and leap between its faces to the beat. Hexshroom is a psychedelic audio reactive runner where every gap, hazard and glowing spore is placed by the music. 20 song-shaped levels, an Endless mode that never stops, and your own MP3s.

apps.name: HEXWING
apps.short_description: Fly through cursed skies in HEXWING, a gothic survival shooter. Build your arsenal with upgrade cards, collect souls, and face monstrous bosses across three haunted realms. Unlock hunters and permanent talents, then return for a harder run.

apps.name: Hi Sudoku
apps.short_description: Settle into classic Sudoku, one logical step at a time. Explore five difficulty levels, fixed stages and free play, with pencil marks, step-by-step hints and four visual themes. Hide the timer and solve at your own pace.

apps.name: Hidden Front
apps.short_description: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

apps.name: Hide and Sheep
apps.short_description: Blend in with the AI sheep, identify the other players, and strike before they do! Figure out each mushroom’s effect, then eat wisely... or cause pure chaos!

apps.name: Hide No More
apps.short_description: Hide No More is a sound-driven Blindfold Hide and Seek game,Supports up to 8 players online. Blindfolded Hunters can sense their surroundings within just 5 meters, but sound can lead them to their targets. Hiders must use distance and the environment to evade capture.

apps.name: Highguard
apps.short_description: Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

apps.name: Highland Keep
apps.short_description: Highland Keep is a third-person survival strategy set in the dark, mist-covered medieval Scotland. As a clan leader, you will engage in base building, colony management, survival mechanics, and real-time action combat in an open world.

apps.name: Hijinks High
apps.short_description: Hijinks High turns an average school day into a disaster with up to five friends. Pull off ridiculous classroom objectives, hold off the faculty with your own bodily fluids, and make the bus before the janitor drags you to detention. Then go home to the Cul-De-Sack and do it again tomorrow.

apps.name: Hold On
apps.short_description: Struggle. Fall. Triumph. Hold on. A small yet grand journey across life. Simple interactions connect seemingly unrelated moments, from the microscopic to the cosmic.

apps.name: Hold the Bastion
apps.short_description: Defend your bastion against waves of goblins closing in from every direction. Choose from three classes and six weapons, each with its own skill tree. After every wave, pick one of three upgrade cards and build up your defenses for the next assault. How long can you hold out?

apps.name: Hold The Noise
apps.short_description: Listen to beautiful and captivating noises! It will be truly amazing. Are you ready to hear some great noise? Just press and hold the space bar. Are you really ready now?

apps.name: Homeguard
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

apps.name: Honk
apps.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

apps.name: HOOD
apps.short_description: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.

apps.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
apps.short_description: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

apps.name: Horochi's Challenge
apps.short_description: Change gravity in six directions and push crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Switch between Meguru and Bimba, work out moving pillars and rail platforms, and solve 50 stages across five worlds. Then aim for the fewest moves to earn gold medals!

apps.name: Horror Game Creator
apps.short_description: Horror Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiences—from quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

apps.name: Hot Seat Triage
apps.short_description: Triage is easy, until your own brain starts lying to you. Pick patients from a crowded ER, spend scarce questions, and call NOW, SOON or LATER before their aura fades. Every one of 498 cases hides a real cognitive bias trap, written by an emergency physician.

apps.name: Hotel Carnivalia
apps.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

apps.name: Hotel Milgram
apps.short_description: A short reverse horror story about a maid working at Hotel Milgram, a supernatural hotel entity.

apps.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike
apps.short_description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

apps.name: Human Fall Flat 2
apps.short_description: Team up and let your creativity run wild in Human Fall Flat 2, the outrageous new sequel to the much-loved capers of everyone’s favourite physics-based human friends.

apps.name: Human Power Plant
apps.short_description: The last job left for humanity in an ultimately automated society was pedaling bicycles to generate electricity.

apps.name: Hunter Bro VR
apps.short_description: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 friends.

apps.name: Hunter's Arena: Legends
apps.short_description: Hunter’s Arena is a multiplayer PvP & PvE melee combat-based Battle Royale set in the ancient Asia. Survive and become the deadliest Hunter in the world of Hunter's Arena!

apps.name: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
apps.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

apps.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
apps.short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

apps.name: HYDROPUNK
apps.short_description:
HYDROPUNK is an isometric souls-like, where the engineering obsession meets Lovecraftian dread.
Pressure above. Abyss below. Know the rules. Break the right ones.

apps.name: Hyper Snatch
apps.short_description: A 5v5 capture the flag game built on skill-based movement, utility orbs, and ultimate abilities. Master chaining slides, dives, b-hops, and super jumps to juke defenders and run the flag home, or play tactically with team orb strategies to control the field. No guns, just tags and outplays.

apps.name: Hyperlane Highway
apps.short_description:
A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed.
Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards.
Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.

apps.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
apps.short_description: Forty weapons, one mouse. Whirl a flail, throw a chakram, slam a warhammer: each run deals you three, and every one cuts its own way. Socket two more, raise them to FORGED, and hold the crystal through thirteen themes.

apps.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI
apps.short_description: A game for anyone who loves hating on AI games and, of course, sucking dicks in the evening. Hunt down slop, leave comments, collect dicks and beat the bosses!

apps.name: Ice Cream
apps.short_description: Sell ice cream and get closer to the girls on a tropical island! Chance encounters, quests, dates, and explicit animated scenes spice up your workdays. Explore the island, play minigames, and don't forget to pay your debts!

apps.name: ICEWAKE
apps.short_description: Steer a nuclear icebreaker across a frozen, sunken world. Scan the ocean with sonar, send a mini-sub down to the ruins of civilization, salvage resources, fight off air raids and create a vaccine in time to save the sick in underwater towns.

apps.name: Idle Gas Station Tycoon
apps.short_description: Turn a tiny roadside pump into a thriving highway service empire. Serve cars, grow your station, hire staff, add a shop, car wash, garage, truck stop and EV chargers, then expand to new locations. A relaxing low-poly idle tycoon, no ads, fully offline.

apps.name: Idle King: Loot Together
apps.short_description: IdleKing is a dark fairy-tale idle loot RPG with online co-op. Auto-battle monsters and bosses, collect and upgrade your gear, and grow ever stronger. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

apps.name: Idle Legions
apps.short_description: Your legion fights on its own, even with the game closed. Five heroes, five acts and bosses with their own mechanics. Forge your gear, raise pets, test your build against other players, and go down into the Abyss for what drops nowhere else.

apps.name: Idle of the Dead
apps.short_description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

apps.name: Idle Plinko
apps.short_description: Build the ultimate Plinko machine in this incremental idle game. Level up to discover unique boards, buy powerful upgrades, unlock special balls, gamble to transform your pegs, and prestige for permanent perks. Compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboards.

apps.name: IdleBound
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where every skill matters. Mine, fish, chop, forge, and fight your way from a grim frontier village to a tear in reality itself, even when you're not playing.

apps.name: if you stay
apps.short_description: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

apps.name: Igni-Qua
apps.short_description: Igni-Qua is a co-op puzzle platforming adventure where you master Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Combine elemental powers, solve environmental puzzles, overcome hazards, and battle mutated creatures together online or on your own.

apps.name: Iman
apps.short_description: IMAN is an 8-bit Religious Horror Adventure inspired by "FAITH: The Unholy Trinity", putting you in the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man who must confront the possessed, the power of Dark Magic, and mystical beings.

apps.name: Impossible Wonders
apps.short_description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

apps.name: Impression Cabinet
apps.short_description: Jigsaw puzzles at a print workshop table. Assemble 24 archival and original prints with distinct piece cuts, free rotation, and room to build off the board. Finish each Working Proof to reveal the completed print, then file it in your Cabinet. Selected prints offer a Second Look challenge.

apps.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
apps.short_description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

apps.name: Industrial Empire Online
apps.short_description: Build a complete industrial empire: extract resources, produce steel, aluminum, fuel and polymers, manage logistics, manufacture heavy equipment, and compete for tenders against other players. Rent or build enterprises, control costs, fulfill contracts, climb the ranking. Every point is built.

apps.name: Infected Dawn 2
apps.short_description: Infected Dawn 2 is an action oriented zombie survival game with elements of time management and puzzle solving. Get to the safehouse, and explore the neighboring landmarks to find weapons and gear before nightfall; make every second count.

apps.name: Infinite Fireball
apps.short_description: Shout your incantations to cast spells in this chaotic co-op party game for up to 20 players! Explore dungeons, brawl in free-for-all or team deathmatches, and customize your magic words and character look. Embrace the chaos and show your unique style!

apps.name: Infinity Girl
apps.short_description: Infinity Girl is a high-speed rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm.

apps.name: INTUS
apps.short_description:
Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

apps.name: Investigation of Room 413
apps.short_description: A first‑person indie psychological horror set in a cursed roadside motel. Solve story‑driven puzzles, uncover twisted memories, and decide if you can ever leave Room 413.

apps.name: Ionic Drive
apps.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

apps.name: Iron Command
apps.short_description: Command a war machine from inside the battlefield. Iron Command is a classic base-building RTS — harvest, build, research, attack — playable on your monitor or in VR, where the battlefield lies in front of you and your orders go out from a tablet on your wrist.

apps.name: Iron Corbo Kung Fu Janitor
apps.short_description:
Junk-Fu-Vania. Be the broom !   

🥋  Customize your own kung fu combos.   
🥊  Flamboyant finishers.   
🧹  Sweep, sanitize, smash your way through a comical, nonlinear, post-civilization romp.

apps.name: Iron Void : Silent Space
apps.short_description: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 120 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 10 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

apps.name: Isekai Parlor Simulator Gold
apps.short_description: An erotic management simulator in which you build your very own monster girl parlor from the ground up!

apps.name: Island of Embers
apps.short_description: Build a human settlement on a volcanic island plagued by fireballs, earthquakes, and ash. Control golems, unlock buildings through research, and face a living landscape that wants you gone. Can your home survive, or will the volcano erase it?

apps.name: Isle of the Jötunn
apps.short_description: You are the sole survivor of a terrible shipwreck. The isle is rich with the resources to keep you alive but, it seems there is another inhabitant. A Jotun of fearsome strength has lived here for ages and doesn't enjoy visitors.

apps.name: Isles of Krom
apps.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down extraction ARPG blending challenging visceral combat with a high-stakes extraction loop. Craft and upgrade gear for your Ward before deploying them into the perilous Krom archipelago to retrieve vital materials and halt the creeping Corruption.

apps.name: IT THINKS!
apps.short_description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

apps.name: It Will Open
apps.short_description: You are a newly hired night-shift employee at the Arden Hotel. While controlling access to the parking lot and responding to guest complaints, you begin to experience a series of suspicious and disturbing events. Uncover the secret hidden within the hotel—and survive.

apps.name: IVORY
apps.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

apps.name: JANKEN 100
apps.short_description: A competitive rock-paper-scissors game focused on prediction and mind games. Freely distribute 100 attack points between Rock, Paper, and Scissors, and the value assigned to your winning hand becomes the damage dealt. Features CPU battles, Online Casual Matches, and Ranked Matches.

apps.name: JANOLITH
apps.short_description: Every stone carries two letters – one on each side. Place words, then flip stones already on the board: STONE becomes STORE. A word-building roguelite where heavy letters face up drive your Mult, long fresh words send your score soaring, and bosses bend the rules.

apps.name: Jar of Gnomes
apps.short_description: An incremental colony game in an allotment garden. Hundreds of gnomlings pick berries, merge fruit in a magic cauldron and fling it through the air. When the run slows down, make jam: jars buy lasting upgrades in the Gnome Village under the compost heap.

apps.name: JARED
apps.short_description: 2D puzzle platformer where you are a repair droid descending into a dangerous facility. Transport fragile, broken computers along the way and help them reach the Repair Station. Solve environmental puzzles, find helpful upgrades, and unravel the facility's dark mystery.

apps.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced
apps.short_description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

apps.name: Joe Lost Island
apps.short_description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

apps.name: John Whisk
apps.short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

apps.name: Jubaku
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

apps.name: Junk Robot
apps.short_description: Junk Robot is a lighthearted, robot-building roguelike where you destroy enemy robots, scavenge their parts and add them straight to your own robot!ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ

apps.name: Junkyard Reseller
apps.short_description: Explore abandoned junkyards, discover valuable items, clean and restore them, then sell them for profit. Expand your land, hire workers and delivery drivers, and turn a small resale operation into your own junkyard empire.

apps.name: Junkyard Space Agency
apps.short_description: Build ships from scrap and fly them in a gritty space sim. Venture solo or team up. Hunt for parts, haul vital resources, and keep your space agency afloat.

apps.name: Jurassic Park: Survival
apps.short_description: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.

apps.name: Just A Dice Game
apps.short_description: A roguelike where your deck is a bag of dice. Roll, choose some to score, and reroll to beat escalating targets. Lava erupts into obsidian, ghosts spawn on clear boards, and bombs reroll everything around them. Stack relics into game-breaking combos and laugh in the face of RNG.

apps.name: Just A DVD Incremental
apps.short_description: Remember waiting for the DVD logo to hit the exact corner of the TV screen? Now you don't have to wait. Upgrade speed, efficiency, and special effects to maximize your bounces in this relaxing incremental idle game. Will it hit the corner?

apps.name: Just a Rescue, Bro!
apps.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

apps.name: Just another thief
apps.short_description: Join a a group of thieves stealing from the rich in a dystopian world. Navigate through enemies with style streaming your heist to the world.

apps.name: Just Be Alive
apps.short_description: You can't attack. You can only dodge. Team up in 1–4 player co-op (friends or bots) and climb a tower full of cute bosses and mechanics. If at least one of you is still standing at the end, the whole team wins.

apps.name: Kachow Kart Racing
apps.short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

apps.name: Kaironia
apps.short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.

apps.name: Kayak with friends
apps.short_description: You and your friends, on kayaks! Master the art of kayaking and conquer fierce rivers with your friends (and against them). Explore the world’s most beautiful rivers and become the ultimate kayak warrior in this frantic racing adventure.

apps.name: Keep Chaos
apps.short_description: Survive relentless hordes in full 3D! Keep Chaos is a fast-paced, third-person bullet-heaven roguelite. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players, master 8 distinct heroes, stack powerful upgrades, and fight to conquer the battlefield.

apps.name: Kegs of Eternity
apps.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

apps.name: Kevin's In Trouble
apps.short_description: Fight your way through unrelenting waves of enemies in this top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven. Build and upgrade your deck with powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

apps.name: Keyp It Up
apps.short_description: The mother of all slop games. Melt your brain with this hypnotic key-jingling number-go-up game, or buy it for a friend if you hate them.

apps.name: Kindled:To The Starlight
apps.short_description: Kindled: To the Starlight is a life sim set in rural China during the 2015 poverty alleviation campaign. Farm, breed crops, befriend and marry NPCs, run for village director, and trade with Five Elements cards as prices follow real supply and demand. Farm, befriend, campaign, trade — all up to you.

apps.name: Kinetile
apps.short_description: Build a route for one rolling ball, then let physics test your plan. Arrange jumps, teleports and sliding platforms in this 3D puzzle. Solve 56 handcrafted levels, then keep going with endless generated puzzles in Infinity mode.

apps.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
apps.short_description:
Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him.

Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

apps.name: Kingdoms in Ink
apps.short_description: A fantasy world's history unfolds on a single map. In this grand strategy game, kingdoms rise, borders shift, and kings and generals pass through the generations. Simply watch, or command a nation and unite the world. Follow towns, people, dragons, and adventurers through a history all your own.

apps.name: Kingshatter
apps.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

apps.name: Kiss or Kill
apps.short_description: A branching romance thriller set inside a deadly holographic dating show. Raise Heartflutter Scores, protect your group, and survive seven days of eliminations.

apps.name: Kiss魔咒：the accursed child
apps.short_description: A male lord's heir gender-bends into a stunning beauty?! A single sneeze sparks a crisis where the only cure is intimate contact with dangerous suitors. Trapped between a loyal knight, a scheming fiancée, a tsundere wizard, and a toxic tutor, can you survive this rom-com?

apps.name: Kitty Cat Match!
apps.short_description: A match 3 game featuring cute cats (and one dog) with multiple different modes to be played solo or with up to 49 other people or friends!

apps.name: Kleks Academy
apps.short_description: A magical platformer where you draw your own solutions! Explore fairytale worlds, solve puzzles with creativity, and uncover secrets in the Kleks Academy.

apps.name: Klocky
apps.short_description: The world moves too fast. Spread an old drawing under the lamp, fit the gears one by one, and hear the machine you built tick for the first time. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth really drives the next.

apps.name: KNELL
apps.short_description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

apps.name: Knight Games
apps.short_description: Knight Games is a casual party game where you compete in minigame tournaments to reclaim a broken kingdom. Enjoy ‘knight games’ of old (like Jousting / Archery) or rediscover classic 'night games' (like Hide & Seek / Capture the Flag). Between events, explore a vast kingdom to unlock new challenges!

apps.name: Koruzan
apps.short_description: Begin as a chieftain with a few tents and a borrowed oath. Grow a clan into a march, a march into a realm — on a living map where lords scheme, caravans trade and armies march without you, and every choice you make is written into a chronicle the world remembers.

apps.name: Kreabordis
apps.short_description: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

apps.name: Kukata: Word of Ghosts
apps.short_description: Your words are your only weapon. Banish the restless dead in this Malaysian folklore typing horror. Face the Pocong and Pontianak in an abandoned school using fast-paced typing combat and ritual crafting. Can you find the words to survive? Start typing now.

apps.name: Kulipari: United
apps.short_description: Unleash your inner warrior in this high-octane 3D Beat 'Em Up! Team up with friends in 4-player local or online co-op to defend the Amphibilands. Master unique combat styles, dodge deadly hazards, and battle the Scorpion Army in a cinematic adventure expanding the Kulipari saga.

apps.name: La Famiglia
apps.short_description: A painted noir mafia saga: plan the week, rule the city, found a dynasty.

apps.name: La Fiebre: Puerto Rico
apps.short_description: An open-world racing game inspired by Puerto Rican car culture. Customize your ride, explore island-inspired locations, and compete in realistic drag races and street events with functional timing systems and online multiplayer.

apps.name: La Mer La Guerre
apps.short_description: Experience Beautiful Age of Sail in this unique single player simulation. Pirates, smugglers, traders and navy officers. Stunning graphics, realistic sailing and combat, and deep persistent living world depending on your actions.

apps.name: Lamplight Yard
apps.short_description: By day, plant potatoes, fix the gate and build crossbows. By night, hold Grandma's little yard with a flashlight until the convoy comes. An 8-chapter campaign, a 9-stop roguelite road trip, daily routes and an endless watch.

apps.name: Land Of The Valiants
apps.short_description: Land of the Valiant blends RPG, survival, and life simulation in a multiplayer medieval world. Build, produce, trade, and survive in a player-driven economy where Khalendor becomes what its inhabitants make of it.

apps.name: Lanternborn
apps.short_description: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

apps.name: Laser Lightshow
apps.short_description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

apps.name: Last Convoy
apps.short_description: Speed or firepower? Survive or dominate? Build your armored convoy car by car in this survivors-like auto-shooter. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

apps.name: Last House Standing
apps.short_description: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

apps.name: Last Ranger
apps.short_description: Return to a mountain reserve abandoned after the storms. Restore its radio network, repair roads, survive the wilderness, and follow a nine-year-old transmission into the sealed North Range. Play alone, online, or in local split-screen co-op.

apps.name: Law of Entropy
apps.short_description: A llama seeks vengeance in a fractured abyss. Plan a grand tower defense, wreak physics-based havoc, and obliterate all who ever wronged you in this steampunk single-player action platformer.

apps.name: Leaf Us Alone
apps.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

apps.name: Learn To Rock
apps.short_description: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

apps.name: LeechWire 2003
apps.short_description: It's 2003. Your modem screams, pop-ups multiply, and your shared folder is your empire. Leech files, seed them for credits, close fake virus alerts before they eat your bandwidth, and keep your LeechMessenger friends happy in this Y2K idle game.

apps.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing
apps.short_description: A co-op arena survivors roguelike for 1–4 players where the leftovers fight back. Pick a food, pick a class and survive 20 waves of germs, mold and expired dairy with a ridiculous loadout of kitchen weapons. Fuse, evolve, synergize — and vote with your friends on what horror to open next.

apps.name: Legacy of Mind
apps.short_description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

apps.name: Let's Go Hunting
apps.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

apps.name: LFG
apps.short_description: LFG Bossing is a voxel action RPG from Bad Circuit Games. Explore a procedurally generated world solo or with friends, descend into sprawling caverns, battle powerful bosses, and hunt for rare gear. Choose Rogue, Knight, Ranger, or Mage, hit dungeons and brave the Gauntlet for unique rewards.

apps.name: Light Out of Sight
apps.short_description: Turn The Power Back On Inside a Haunted Mansion, while Fighting Off Paranormal Monsters.

apps.name: Light Up the Dark
apps.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

apps.name: Lilloville
apps.short_description: Bring a seaside shopping street to life in this cozy shopkeeping game. Arrange bouquets, bake bread, pour latte art, style hair, cook meals, and run your own little stores. Decorate your shops, meet the neighbours, and enjoy the small joys of life in Lilloville.

apps.name: Liminal Descent
apps.short_description: Descend into a nightmare where familiar places become something terrifying. Explore eerie liminal spaces, evade creatures with unique behaviours, uncover the truth behind your disappearance, and search for a way out. **Try the free demo.**

apps.name: LINE WARLORD
apps.short_description: Real-time line defense, played in roguelite runs. Spend rations to send units to the front, pick relics between fights, and destroy the enemy base. Stacking relics, unit promotions, three commanders with their own ultimates.

apps.name: Little Angler
apps.short_description: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

apps.name: Little Drone TuTuTu
apps.short_description: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.

apps.name: Little Jimmy´s Nightmare
apps.short_description: Little Jimmy's Nightmare is an action roguelite where cute hand-drawn 16-bit charm meets brutal combat, flying guts and powerful item synergies. Explore handcrafted worlds, build outrageous combinations and carve your way through cultists, monsters and bizarre bosses.

apps.name: Little Loops
apps.short_description: Make a little space your own in this cozy fidget and idle game. Pop, spin and fold, trim a bonsai, or shape pottery. Collect new looks, arrange your desk and let little helpers earn joy while you relax—with a desktop companion and 25 mellow music tracks.

apps.name: LITTLE MINER WORLD
apps.short_description: Mine, build, and explore! Start as a rookie and delve into the depths of the Mega-Mountain in this incremental mining game. Gather materials, construct buildings, and upgrade your miner to unravel the mystery hidden at the core and become the World’s Greatest Miner.

apps.name: Little Noël: Christmas Village
apps.short_description: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

apps.name: Llamalandia
apps.short_description:
Llamalandia is a cozy adventure game with town-building elements, about finding your family.
Build your llama sanctuary to protect your family, raise the baby llamas, and invite other cute animals to live with you in this magical place.

apps.name: Locked in love : The Office
apps.short_description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

apps.name: Loftia
apps.short_description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

apps.name: Logistik
apps.short_description: Build, schedule, and grow your rail network to fulfill transportation demands. Optimize paths around forests, mountains and rivers, and balance fuel costs. Across real-world continents or on endlessly unique maps, build the best railway company, one train at a time!

apps.name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
apps.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

apps.name: Londya
apps.short_description: Build your own combat styles in a single-player action RPG. Level up to unlock new attacks and evolve your styles as enemies learn your fighting patterns. Protect Londya on the road to the Lond, and adapt before your own habits become your downfall.

apps.name: Long Way Gnome
apps.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

apps.name: Loot Before Dusk
apps.short_description: Cozy top-down extraction shooter. Raid the corrupted Wildwood, purify Gloamed creatures, bonk goblins and rival scavengers, and reach the exit before dusk. Then rebuild your village, trade, craft and cook. No blood, real stakes. Play solo or in online co-op with friends.

apps.name: Lords of the Fallen II
apps.short_description: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.

apps.name: Lost Camp
apps.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

apps.name: Lost in the Blizzard Abyss
apps.short_description: One of the world's hardest survival FPS games. The blizzard constantly drains your Health, and standing still means waiting to die. Keep moving, seek Health, collect five Crystals, obtain the Frost Crown, and offer it at the altar to stop the blizzard. Challengers from around the world are welcome.

apps.name: LOST IN THE DARK LABYRINTH
apps.short_description:
The labyrinth is waiting for challengers! Free demo available. 
Enter a giant dark labyrinth with limited light, ammo, health, and time. Find the keys, survive traps and enemies, and escape within 60 minutes.

apps.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
apps.short_description: Uncover mysteries on an epic journey to the heart of the uncharted island of Arnak in this captivating blend of deck-building and worker placement. Become the leader of an expedition and dive deep into uncharted territory. But you’re not alone—and fame and glory await only the most successful team.

apps.name: Lost Zone: Survival
apps.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

apps.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
apps.short_description: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

apps.name: LRT-2
apps.short_description: LRT-2 is a first-person atmospheric railway experience inspired by Manila's LRT Line 2 in the Philippines.

apps.name: Lucky Newt
apps.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home.

apps.name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
apps.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

apps.name: Lumbrix
apps.short_description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

apps.name: Lunaton: Rescue mission
apps.short_description: 🐾 Transform an abandoned island into a thriving resort! Time moves in real time, and the seasons change weekly. Hire townspeople, collect evening profits, tend to your farm, and explore the neighboring mystical islands by train at your own pace.

apps.name: Lust of the Dead
apps.short_description: Lust of the Dead is a first-person survival horror experience set inside the decaying St. Erebus Hospital, where a mysterious outbreak has turned desire into something far more sinister.

apps.name: Mad Craft
apps.short_description: An adventure-focused voxel sandbox with building, crafting, and village life. Gather resources, craft gear, and face dungeons and powerful foes with allies. Enjoy fishing, farming, cross-species romance, marriage, and raising a family—or collect items and put them on display.

apps.name: Magehold Fairwinds
apps.short_description: Crew a leaking airship across five acts of painted sky. Route Flow, raise wind shields, cast from the Casting Room and board your enemies in real-time-with-pause battles, then pay off the debt, if you can. An airship roguelite set in the world of Magehold.

apps.name: Magic Ball Sort
apps.short_description: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

apps.name: Main Bastion
apps.short_description: Take command of the final frontier as hordes of beasts march toward your stronghold. Build a powerful defense, set cunning traps, station brave defenders, and use sentry towers to protect your kingdom. Each tower has unique abilities, and choosing the right combination is key to survival.

apps.name: Malleus
apps.short_description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

apps.name: Margin of Error
apps.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this roguelite dungeon RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the dungeon makes you pay.

apps.name: Mariachi Legends
apps.short_description: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

apps.name: Market Moe
apps.short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

apps.name: Master Builders
apps.short_description: Master Builders is a strategic building game about constructing Gothic cathedrals. Plan your worksites, win over craftsmen and guilds, secure resources, and outbuild rival master builders to create the city’s grandest landmark.

apps.name: Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite
apps.short_description: Unique playstyles bring each legend to life in the fight against Hordak’s unstoppable horde. Battle your way through a variety of diverse biomes and obstacles with every playthrough and engage in Trials of Eternia, arcade mini games for precious bonuses.

apps.name: MatchMaker95 - A Programming Simulator
apps.short_description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit — all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

apps.name: Math Marsh
apps.short_description: Math Marsh is an arithmetic arcade game where every correct answer buys you time. Guide a fly across numbered lily pads, eat the numbers that complete each equation, and dodge hungry frogs, lizards, and spiders. Choose your operations and difficulty, then see how far you can go.

apps.name: Maze 1211
apps.short_description: Wait. Where am I? Why is there a maze? Why am I holding a lantern? A first-person psychological mystery. Wander a vast night maze with a few flags and a stick of chalk. Mark your way, follow what the signs, and try to remember which way you came. If you can.

apps.name: Meadgard
apps.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

apps.name: Meat Engine
apps.short_description:
Meat Engine is a Sci-Fi boomer shooter inspired by Scorn, Quake, Dusk and Doom. 
The game is set in a dark and distant future stricken with war and death.
 Featuring fast and brutal retro combat.

apps.name: Mecha Simultactics
apps.short_description: Hey, Pilot! Join the battle in this multiplayer tactical party fighter where everyone selects an action, then all actions play out at the same time. Customize your mech and take on your opponents with simultaneous-turn-based combat, anime-inspired replays, and online PvP.

apps.name: MechaCorps Draft
apps.short_description: Outdraft your enemies in a simultaneous competitive card game with no wasted picks. Claim critical parts, deny key resources, and assemble ruthless Mechs. Prove your strategy in a decisive auto-battle. Quick PvP. Free to play. Never pay-to-win.

apps.name: MECHBORN
apps.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

apps.name: Medovox
apps.short_description: Medovox is an incredibly atmospheric sandbox farming simulator with realistic stylized graphics. Buy cars, build up your farm, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world with very beautiful nature. Earn your first million!

apps.name: MeMento*fragMent
apps.short_description: "Begin again. Recall all that is."

apps.name: Meow Dungeon: Idle Cat RPG
apps.short_description: Build a party of pixel cats and let them auto-battle through 24 dungeons. They fight, loot and level up on their own, and keep adventuring even while the game is closed. Collect 14 breeds, hunt legendary gear and grow your cozy cat inn.

apps.name: Message From Aliens
apps.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

apps.name: Meteor Spin
apps.short_description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

apps.name: Method in the Witchness
apps.short_description: A cozy game of sorting, riddles, and puzzles on a little witch’s table. Arrange magical objects, discover hidden secrets that may help in later puzzles, and uncover a gentle story—one uniquely sounding item at a time.

apps.name: Method Of Entry
apps.short_description: Method of Entry is a slow paced close quarters 5v5 tactical shooter inspired by the golden age of methodical FPS games. With no hero abilities or killstreaks, it focuses on precision gunplay, disciplined teamwork, and tactical decision making in tight, high pressure engagements.

apps.name: Metro Anomaly
apps.short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

apps.name: Metro Station Designer
apps.short_description: Metro Station Designer is a 3D station-building and crowd simulation game. Plan multi-level concourses and platforms, lay out ticket gates, escalators and transfer passages, then replay the morning and evening rush to find the bottlenecks as over ten thousand commuters pour through.

apps.name: Metromino
apps.short_description: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

apps.name: Midnight Bakery
apps.short_description: Midnight Bakery is a first-person bakery simulator with a horror twist. Serve customers, prepare coffee, restock shelves, and customize your shop. But as the nights go by, strange events begin to unfold. Can you keep your bakery running when reality itself starts to unravel?

apps.name: Midnight Shop
apps.short_description: Seven days after your grandmother vanished, you open her shop, which only trades after midnight. Under the counter glass lies a card of house rules in her handwriting, but not all of them are hers. Keep the rules to survive the night, or break them for the strangers who come in from the rain.

apps.name: Mimic Alert
apps.short_description:
You are on a service to detect and destroy mimics — creatures capable of taking the form of any object. Carefully inspect your surroundings and use all your attentiveness to detect them.

Play the full campaign in online two-player co-op with a friend.

apps.name: MIMIC HUNGER
apps.short_description: A hungry little Mimic for your desktop! Let it ambush adventurers while you work, open loot chests, and collect 300 items. Raise familiars, evolve, and climb the rankings in this idle companion game. Sit back and watch, or lend a hand when you like.

apps.name: Mimic Hunt
apps.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a stealth game where you hide among a crowd of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and eliminate your assigned targets without being exposed. Players can take the role of Hiders or Hunters, working together or against each other. Play solo or online with friends.

apps.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
apps.short_description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

apps.name: Mine Away
apps.short_description: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

apps.name: Mineral Zone
apps.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Mining Days
apps.short_description: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

apps.name: Minus Sixty
apps.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

apps.name: Minutes to Meltdown
apps.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

apps.name: MIRROR CRYPT
apps.short_description:
A surreal action RPG where dreams fight back. 
Explore vivid realms, face your nightmares, and choose what to destroy — or forgive.

apps.name: Miscea: Sanguin's Laments
apps.short_description: Fulfill your role in Soul's plan and take up arms against the bloodthirsty Buggers so that the Boubou people can survive and complete their divine task. Experience a story-rich turn-based tactics RPG set into the fantasy world of Miscea.

apps.name: Misery Relay
apps.short_description: Wake up. Write some code. Help Liliya with the jam. Tomorrow is yesterday. A first-person psychological mystery in a small Russian flat, where the days run backwards and your wife is never quite the same woman twice.

apps.name: Misfortune
apps.short_description: Fight monsters with a slot machine. Spin, hold and reroll to land deadly combinations. Build your reels with powerful symbols, collect relics and unlock extra paylines. Shape your luck—and survive long enough to cash out.

apps.name: MLF: Pro Catch
apps.short_description: Grab a friend and feel every fish fight back. A fishing sim with 50+ species across six diverse waters, real casting and trolling, and authentic gear. The official Major League Fishing game.

apps.name: MMCitadels
apps.short_description: A colorful RTS with rainbow skills.

apps.name: MMO Botfarm Simulator
apps.short_description: A game about running a botfarm on an oldschool MMO to gather and sell resources, level up your bots, and clear dungeons to find loot.

apps.name: Modern Frankenstein
apps.short_description: Step into a modern reimagining of the Frankenstein legend and experience chilling survival horror. Battle monstrous creations, including the iconic Frankenstein's Monster. Solve supernatural puzzles created by a madman. Your job is simple agent, stop Dr. Frankenstein.

apps.name: Mole & Ore
apps.short_description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

apps.name: Momentigrade
apps.short_description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

apps.name: Monkey Do
apps.short_description: Escape a crumbling zoo as Mak, a stealth-savvy monkey who dismantles robot Keepers, springs traps on them, and recruits fellow animals to stage his ultimate breakout. Will the malicious owner be able to stop him or will Mak be the monkey wrench in his operation?

apps.name: MonMusu Breaker
apps.short_description: A classic Brick Breaker with a naughty twist! Smash through challenging stages, unlock new characters and scenes, and put your aim and timing to the test. Can you break your way through them all?

apps.name: Monster Cove
apps.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

apps.name: Monster Girls of Another World: Pleasure Chronicle
apps.short_description: A casual erotic action RPG with fully animated sex scenes and over 200 animated pixel-art CGs! Explore, earn money, and visit monster girl brothels. Write about your encounters and sell your articles to fund your next visit. Enjoy simple one-button combat, fishing, and casino games along the way!

apps.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin Trial Version
apps.short_description:
In this demo for Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin, players are able to play the opening portion of the game for free. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the retail version.

Mount up and get ready to experience an all new RPG adventure set in the world of Monster Hunter.

apps.name: Moon Swarm
apps.short_description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

apps.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
apps.short_description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

apps.name: MoonVeil
apps.short_description:
A tense co-op PvP social deduction game for 3–12 players.
Loot by day, survive the night, uncover the werewolves — or become one.

apps.name: Moorlet
apps.short_description: Build a tiny island, place the curses that threaten it, and defend your village when night falls. Connect terrain tiles, gather resources and raise your defenses in a compact island builder where every new piece of land brings another decision.

apps.name: Morvex
apps.short_description: Morvex is a free-to-play, round-based zombie survival FPS. Battle relentless undead hordes, craft and upgrade powerful weapons, face deadly bosses, and climb the global leaderboards. How long can you survive?🧟‍♂️⚡

apps.name: Mossvale
apps.short_description: Mossvale is a small online fantasy RPG where you fight monsters, collect gear, complete quests, fish, cook, trade, and grow your character in a shared pixel world.

apps.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
apps.short_description: Buy, fix, customize, and sell motorcycles. Start with old bikes, restore every part, test ride, and grow your own dealership. Take risks, make smart deals, and become the best in town!

apps.name: Mount Lomyst
apps.short_description: You need to go up... but you cannot jump! Mount Lomyst is a 2D platformer where you must reach the summit using only a grappling hook and your climbing skills.

apps.name: Mountain Rescue: Caucasus
apps.short_description: Somewhere in the snowy Caucasus, Babu needs rescuing and you're the rescue team and carry Babu home on your back. Gently.

apps.name: Moving Company Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own moving company with friends! Pack fragile items, carry heavy furniture, load the truck, and deliver everything in one piece. Play solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Earn tips, build your reputation, and grow from a small crew into the city's top movers.

apps.name: Mowed Down
apps.short_description: A multiplayer prop hunt where the hunter drives a lawnmower. Hide as anything from a hay bale to a piano across ten arenas, score only while a mower can see you, and come back as a mower or a ghost when you're caught. Lobbies of up to 40, four mowers, and a Map Maker.

apps.name: Mr. Panas
apps.short_description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

apps.name: Munchy Lair
apps.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

apps.name: Munshi Meadows
apps.short_description: Hatch a Munshi from an egg and raise it your way. Train it with potions, get to know its personality, and see which of 43 forms it grows into. Then take it racing across 70 courses, throw it into cage matches and puzzle trials, build it a garden, and bring your friends along.

apps.name: Murder Meet Cute
apps.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

apps.name: Mushroom Sweeper
apps.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedural forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens.

apps.name: My Cozy Home
apps.short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of.  The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

apps.name: My Dirty Little Lake
apps.short_description:
Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game.
With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear.
Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house.
Wildlife appreciates your work.

apps.name: My Futa Kitsune Mommy
apps.short_description: 👻 My Futa Kitsune Mommy is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game 😈 where you explore a Apartment while a seductive, hypnotic-kinky futa kitsune ❤️ constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you. 👻

apps.name: My Gaming Shop
apps.short_description: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

apps.name: My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
apps.short_description: Solve seven types of puzzles across 100 increasingly challenging levels and unlock ever more revealing images of a bold goth beauty. Earn up to three stars, beat your best times, and fill your private gallery in My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle.

apps.name: My Little Black Hole
apps.short_description: A quiet pixel-art desktop companion. Let a little black hole absorb stress objects, discover planets and constellations, and arrange a universe of your own while you work or take a break.

apps.name: My Mom Says I’m Fine
apps.short_description: Survive a twisted toy room in this action roguelike bullet heaven. Choose living toys, unlock weapons and spells, craft powerful builds, upgrade runes, and defeat waves of creepy enemies in fast-paced single-player runs.

apps.name: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
apps.short_description: Climb a hazardous mountain that gets meaner with every ascent... until it breaks you. Master Goblin Mountaineering, including rubber-arm slingshotting and fart propulsion. Not challenging enough? Hunt down bizarre accessories to become the most 'ahem' gorgeous Goblin.

apps.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
apps.short_description: Adventurers, let's get exploring! Plunge into the mysterious dungeon and discover all sorts of wild mysteries...

apps.name: mythorune
apps.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

apps.name: NAGERU or NADERU
apps.short_description:
Let's answer the quiz about these cute puppies!

Does this puppy want you to throw something for him!? Or does he want you to pet him!? Which is it~!

apps.name: Nano Dash
apps.short_description: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

apps.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
apps.short_description: Fight with flowing sleeves and turn a last-moment dodge into a counterattack. Journey through six stages of Korean folklore, face restless spirits and bosses, and shape your dance through three progression paths and equipment combinations.

apps.name: Nascor Descent
apps.short_description: Awaken in a tower beyond death, where five realms conceal unspeakable horrors. Fight your way through a labyrinth of deadly traps and monstrous foes, and let your morality shape your path to salvation. Will you reclaim your life, or be lost to the depths forever?

apps.name: Nebulon Colony
apps.short_description: Nebulon Colony is a 3D colony sim. You take command of the first crew of astronauts, tasked with building the first colony on a distant planet. Dig, craft, build, trade, automate, level up, grow plants, herd animals, drive rovers and more.

apps.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
apps.short_description: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

apps.name: Neon Hustle
apps.short_description: A first-person management sim set in a living crime-noir town. Recruit workers, pitch clients on the street yourself, manage rising city heat, and keep the operation running before the night forces itself to end. Mature themes, no explicit content.

apps.name: NeoTanker
apps.short_description: Tiny tanks, big decisions. A turn-based tactics game where every tile changes the odds: capture cities, build your army and outplay a sharp robot general, a friend, or anyone online. Free, no ads, no pay-to-win.

apps.name: NERO
apps.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

apps.name: Netherwake
apps.short_description: Netherwake is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game. Explore a town consumed by unnatural fog and a facility beneath the mountain. Hide from deadly anomalies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what happened before they find you.

apps.name: Netherworld: Blood Moon
apps.short_description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

apps.name: Network Engineer
apps.short_description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

apps.name: Never Stop Climbing
apps.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

apps.name: NeverVeil Gate
apps.short_description: NeverVeil Gate is an online multiplayer social deduction game where words are weapons and trust is fragile. Players complete tasks while an Imposter hides among them, unable to kill directly but able to summon the Gate’s entity with a secret keyword. Trust the wrong voice and the gate will answer.

apps.name: Nice Dice: Game of Throws
apps.short_description: Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!

apps.name: Nie Xiaoqian
apps.short_description: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

apps.name: Nightcap Witch
apps.short_description: "Nightcap Witch" is a rogue-lite strategy game where you battle using a limited set of units. Build a deck of 7 cards and defend the spring from the onslaught of nightmare legions. Can you drive away the nightmares and reclaim your peaceful sleep?

apps.name: NightMaw
apps.short_description: A physics-driven multiplayer horror game where insatiably hungry, man-made monsters stalk, pounce, and devour each other in procedurally generated dungeons.

apps.name: Nik and Kit
apps.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, 1980s arcade era video game in the Nik and Kit franchise!

apps.name: No Survivors
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers, battle an escalating police and military response, upgrade nine brutal weapons, and turn a fully destructible lakeside camp into your deadliest weapon. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

apps.name: Nocturnal 2
apps.short_description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

apps.name: Nodal
apps.short_description: Nodal is a logic puzzle game where you simply connect nodes by drawing lines. Every node must be connected, but special conditions on nodes change how lines can be drawn between them. Also try your hand at endlessly generated puzzles and daily challenges!

apps.name: NODE: PROTOCOL
apps.short_description:
A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back.

Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

apps.name: NODGE
apps.short_description: Every song is a boss fight. A neon rhythm shooter where bullets, lasers and walls hit on the beat, every track brings its own monster, and one hit too many ends the song.

apps.name: Nomad Drive
apps.short_description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

apps.name: Nonogram Detective
apps.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

apps.name: Northern Saga
apps.short_description:
Northern Saga is an old-school real-time strategy RPG inspired by classics like Ogre Battle.

Command your clan across real-time battlefields, construct specialized combat formations, and master combat where every positioning choice matters.

apps.name: Northrealm Tribes
apps.short_description: Build a Viking village, manage resources and guide families through generations. Develop production chains, trade with visiting merchants and defend your settlement against longship raids. Join an online guild to strengthen a shared clan base and wage asynchronous guild wars.

apps.name: NOT Math Puzzle
apps.short_description: Equations arranged by your own hands create far more than just calculation results! Discover the unexpected role formulas play in this Sokoban puzzle game.

apps.name: Not My Son
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

apps.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
apps.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

apps.name: Nothing Belongs Here
apps.short_description: Six worlds collide in a cozy first-person tidy-up game. Sort 4,899 scattered belongings into their rightful homes, fill shelves row by row, earn coins for upgrades, and uncover hidden surprises. No timer. No pressure. Just one enormous mess to make right.

apps.name: NoveCard
apps.short_description: NoveCard is a relaxed solo strategy card game. Each round, score three of five cards and hold two for the next. Nine rounds, nine scoring categories—each used once. Swapped cards go to the bottom of the deck in order and may return as it cycles. Balance scoring, holding, and swapping to aim higher.

apps.name: Nowhere
apps.short_description:
Nowhere is a detective horror game rooted in Nordic folklore.
Investigate the disappearance of four tourists deep in the wilds of Norway. Gather evidence, follow leads and find the truth as you uncover a history of religious conflict and customs.

apps.name: NTR Clinic
apps.short_description: Once betrayed, now the temptation. Pursue forbidden relationships with four partnered women at a couples clinic. An adult NTR visual novel with a story of secrets and betrayal, beautiful illustrations, 50 animation clips, and story-linked minigame challenges.

apps.name: Null & Aether
apps.short_description: Null & Aether is an isometric/top-down Action Role-Playing Game that blends  fast-paced combat with  puzzle-solving, secret-hunting, loot gathering, and dungeon crawling.

apps.name: Nutshot Simulator
apps.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

apps.name: O'BLOCK
apps.short_description: You start with $300 and a shoebox. You end up selling sneakers to billionaires, if you can read who's lying. Every buyer hides their number and some lie about it. Free to play: name your price, win the deal, climb from the block to a billion.

apps.name: Obelus Manor
apps.short_description: Lose your mind in an ever-changing labyrinth full of spirits and paranormal forces. Uncover the secrets of an abandoned manor in this hand-drawn first person dungeon crawler.

apps.name: Objecipher
apps.short_description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

apps.name: Oblivion Line
apps.short_description: Oblivion Line is a deckbuilding roguelike puzzle RPG set in an underground city where memories are traded. Connect drops, reshape your deck, and plan around enemy intentions. Manage your sanity and weigh difficult choices as you follow an abandoned subway line.

apps.name: Obrum
apps.short_description: OBRUM is a strategic logical puzzle roguelite where you manage an unstable system, trigger devastating chain reactions, and fight to keep the board from collapsing. OBRUM rewards pattern recognition & long-term planning. You are not solving a puzzle, you are engineering outcomes.

apps.name: Ocean Dynasty Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build your own shipping company, plan global routes, and guide a fleet through a dynamic trading network. Take on transport contracts, trade goods, upgrade ships, and react to market opportunities and unexpected events.

apps.name: OddSpawns
apps.short_description: Explore. Catch. Fight. Survive... Gamble! A creature-collecting auto-battler. Explore paper diorama-style worlds, catch bizarre creatures, build powerful synergies using the creatures and items you collect!

apps.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
apps.short_description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

apps.name: Oh Baby Blocks
apps.short_description: A cosy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

apps.name: Oh Puck!
apps.short_description: Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!

apps.name: Oh Shear!
apps.short_description: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

apps.name: Omertà: Mafia Novel
apps.short_description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

apps.name: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
apps.short_description: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

apps.name: ONE FLICK ～ COIN CLASH ～
apps.short_description: Flick coins, knock your opponent’s pieces off the table, and protect your 100-yen King. Build decks from coins with different sizes and weights, conquer 335 CPU stages, face nine Coin Masters, and collect all 1,005 badges. Play solo or battle a friend locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: One Line Wonder
apps.short_description: The one-line puzzle, with fresh twists on the familiar rules. Find your own route through tangled paths and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing complexity fall into place.

apps.name: One More Donut
