apps.short_description: Transform a delicious mountain of 2,500+ donuts into ultimate visual perfection! Sort tasty treats, buy upgrades, and unwind to a cozy Lo-Fi soundtrack in this satisfying tidying simulator.

apps.name: One More Voyage
apps.short_description: ONE MORE VOYAGE is a minimalist 4X game with incremental progression. On each new Voyage you explore strange planets on the hunt for vital resources to make the next warp jump on the flight from an overpowering enemy. Can you find the starcharts to escape your pursuers?

apps.name: One Mote
apps.short_description: Grow a glowing web from a single mote of light. Every crystal you reach feeds the core, and the light plays a song. Collapse your web into a star, fill constellations, wake whole galaxies, then fold them back into one mote. An incremental game you can watch grow.

apps.name: One’s Trash Another’s Treasure
apps.short_description: You spent everything on 500,000 unclaimed cargo boxes. Now you have to open every single one. A first-person incremental game about grinding boxes, feeding a hole that never fills, and calling it a business plan. Buy tools, drones, and automation. Only 499,997 to go.

apps.name: Online Poly
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, buy world cities, and make your rivals pay the toll! Online Poly is a free online board game with cute characters, property-building battles, global rankings, and a Tile Lift map that turns the board upside down.

apps.name: Open Fortress
apps.short_description: Open Fortress is a mod for Team Fortress 2 that envisions a new wave of mercenary gunfighting. Bunny hop through original maps set in the futuristic world of the 1970s, and blast your way to victory with an all-new arsenal of groovy weapons! Frequently updated with new maps, modes, and mayhem!

apps.name: Operative Division
apps.short_description: Command your forces from above or take direct control on the ground. Operative Division is an intense RTS-TPS hybrid set in a post-apocalyptic world. Manage finite resources, execute surgical tactical maneuvers, and unleash devastating superweapons in a battle for humanity's future.

apps.name: OPERATIVES: Revolve
apps.short_description: Every card is both cover and weapon. In your hand, they block bullets, blades and death itself. It’s a visually intense deckbuilder built on strategic play. Your cards are destructible, their position, sequence and play matter more than just the cards you pick during a run.

apps.name: Orbital Desires 🛰️
apps.short_description: Gao Chao Station was the embodiment of future wealth and prosperity, an orbital paradise for sexy women needing to escape Earth’s doomed gravity – and a place for them to find their every wanton desire tended to! Only a select few could afford it, but the thrills were worth it!

apps.name: Orbrix
apps.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 40+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Also, there are alien pets!

apps.name: Ordanum
apps.short_description: Ordanum is a combo centred PvP auto battler where the order of your Sigils is the driving system. Arrange and rearrange your Sigils then watch your creation play out against other players' builds.

apps.name: Oroborus: Planes Of The Dead
apps.short_description: Planes Of The Dead is a different take on the ARPG genre.

apps.name: ORUNKA
apps.short_description: An online RPG on the island of Moruah. Catch dinos and raise them as pets. Your pet attacks whatever you attack, and Auto Battle keeps the hunt going. Pets raised from Lv 1 grow strongest, and an appraisal reveals their Bloodline. Party up with other hunters on one island. In English and Korean.

apps.name: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football
apps.short_description: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football is a chaotic 4v4 online arcade football game for up to 4 players. Play as hand-drawn Ottoman miniature characters, slide, shoulder-charge and punch your way to the goal, grab power-ups, and let AI fill any empty slot.

apps.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
apps.short_description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

apps.name: Outbreak Z
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

apps.name: Overgrown Cleaner
apps.short_description: Build your own restoration business by trimming, mowing, and clearing overgrown spaces, crafting tools from salvaged materials and bringing neglected places back into shape one project at a time.

apps.name: Overload 21
apps.short_description: Overload 21 is a sci-fi card battler about knowing when to stop. Read enemy intent, draw toward 21, then stand and attack before your hand goes over.

apps.name: Overwitched
apps.short_description: A cute-spooky cooking game where you run a witch's potion shop for very impatient monsters. Dig up bones in the graveyard, grow mandrakes, raise bats and frogs, toss it all in the cauldron and serve vampires, werewolves and ghosts before their patience runs out.

apps.name: P.A.L.S: Lost at Sea
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op raft survival game. After one wild night at sea, you and your friends wake up lost on a tiny raft. Fish up loot, smack flopping fish, build walls and cannons, and battle a hungry shark, storms and ridiculous bosses on the long way home.

apps.name: P.R.O.E.B.
apps.short_description: Work, sabotage, and escape together. Complete your production quotas across dozens of Soviet factories, outsmart relentless robot supervisors, and find your way to freedom before the ruthless authoritarian machine grinds you to dust!

apps.name: Pack Rush
apps.short_description: Wash cars, open packs and build your deck in a neighborhood where every shift hides something strange. Collect cards, challenge rivals and uncover mysteries in a blend of simulation, card strategy and retro horror.

apps.name: Padako
apps.short_description: Bring a cute companion to your desktop! PADAKO is a desktop companion and dress-up game. Type on your keyboard or click your mouse and watch your little buddy respond. Mix and match your favorite outfits to add a little joy to work, study, and everyday downtime.

apps.name: Pages of Tomorrow
apps.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

apps.name: PAIMT ARENA
apps.short_description: A fast arena shooter where paint is power. Master air movement, fight with artist's tools, and shape your own arenas. Host custom matches with friends, build maps in the in-game editor, and leave your mark on every wall.

apps.name: Pain-Hatching
apps.short_description: Game about a rooster, friendship, family, a cult, WOMAN, and chthonic horrors.

apps.name: Painted Kingdoms: Tower Defense & Firefighting
apps.short_description:
Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you paint, build, and defend your Kingdom of paper. 
Harness the power of paint to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. 
Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

apps.name: PALJA Survivors
apps.short_description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

apps.name: Pan, Please!
apps.short_description: Grab. Sizzle on the beat. Serve. Pay the debt. A rhythm cooking roguelite where one frying pan grows a broke little shop into a fully automated kitchen storm — three pans, flying plates and GOLDEN TIME that never ends. Drag the pan, feel the beat.

apps.name: Panda Flora
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

apps.name: Paper Lanes
apps.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

apps.name: Paper Pranks
apps.short_description: Can’t jump the gap? Fold the paper. Need a bridge? Draw one. Paper Pranks is a handmade puzzle platformer where clever ideas meet tricky jumps. Pop balloons, dodge saws, then build and share your own levels. Who made this trap? Oh. You did.
developers: 阿北的甜品屋 / A BEI DESSERT HOUSE
publishers: 阿北的甜品屋 / A BEI DESSERT HOUSE

apps.name: Paper Reactions
apps.short_description: Play cards. Trigger reactions. Build explosive chains, forge growth charms, and ace 24 Chemistry Exams to claim your A+ — then dive into Endless Mode and chase the leaderboard. One hand of materials, one chain of reactions, all the way up.

apps.name: Paper Shredder
apps.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

apps.name: Parallax Blue
apps.short_description: A strategy tower defence where you create the towers! Gather resources, build towers, defeat bugs, and survive. Unlock new weapons, create towers, gather resources, and die. Don't fall short of the Company's expectations... these resources are worth more than any life, including yours.

apps.name: Parking Empire Simulator
apps.short_description: Own the lot and be its valet. Park customers' cars, hang their keys and bring their cars back when they return. Grow three bays into a business that fills the whole block, with a car wash, service garage and petrol station. Play solo or in 4-player online co-op.

apps.name: Parry Dungeon
apps.short_description: Created by an insane solo developer. Short first-person dungeon crawler with directional parrying, counterattacks, and monster CONSUMPTION. Parry monster. Counterattack monster. Kill monster. Eat monster. Find more monsters. Kill them too. Find more. Kill them too....or die.

apps.name: Party To Oblivion
apps.short_description: Fall in love and relax with gorgeous women! Build the Greatest Festival of Pleasure of this era & improve your skills to seduce all the ladies in this incremental dating sim~

apps.name: PatchWorld
apps.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

apps.name: Path To Freedom
apps.short_description: Path to Freedom is a multiplayer first-person tactical shooter emphasizing squad-based coordination and combined arms warfare.

apps.name: Pawn'd Chess
apps.short_description: Play, study, and improve at your own pace in a chess trainer with human-like, skill-matched AI, full FEN tools, local hotseat, and ranked play or pressure-free practice.

apps.name: Pawperwork
apps.short_description: An idle game about a cat stamping an absurd amount of paperwork, in a window that lives on top of everything else you are doing. Collect the package, stamp what is inside, send it out. Do it all by hand until you can afford not to, then go find out who keeps sending the work down.

apps.name: Payday Poker
apps.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

apps.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
apps.short_description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

apps.name: PC Cafe Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own Korean PC cafe! From customer service to cooking and store management — experience life as a PC cafe owner. Start small, hire staff, expand your store, and deal with troublesome customers yourself! Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players.

apps.name: PC Versus
apps.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

apps.name: PCpill
apps.short_description: PCpill™ is an action-packed top-down shooter where you take control of the PCpill™ Antivirus to disinfect the hard drive of an old desktop PC. Use your PillGun to blast the rot away and restore your computer, one file at a time!

apps.name: PECADO
apps.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

apps.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure
apps.short_description: Defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the changing seasons to uncover the memories of fallen stars.

apps.name: Penguin Fury
apps.short_description: Penguin Fury is a roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, bolt on weapons and drop them into endless waves. Chain kills to climb from FRENZY to GODLIKE, unlock 70 skins across 6 eras, and push every run one wave further.

apps.name: People Versus Everything
apps.short_description: It's a bird! It's a plan! It's a garbage can? Face your friends in this ridiculous cat-and-mouse free-to-play shooter. Become a prop and hide within your environment, or become a hunter. Use guns, abilities, and occasionally trains to win the game!

apps.name: Pet Store: Tidy Up Sorting Simulator
apps.short_description: Tidy up, sort, and organize your very own pet store! Put pet toys, food, and accessories back on the shelves, clean up the mess, and turn a chaotic shop into a perfectly organized pet paradise!

apps.name: Phantom Line
apps.short_description: Join the paranormal SWAT. PHANTOM LINE is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

apps.name: Picker Magnate Simulator
apps.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

apps.name: Pig & Pup
apps.short_description: Play as a pup with your friends in this online multiplayer party game. Carry toys home, guard your chests or steal from the other team. Bark to lure Pudding into their loot, but watch out: the pig can knock yours loose too.

apps.name: Pikabuu: Home
apps.short_description: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?

apps.name: Pillars of Pantheon
apps.short_description: Pillars of Pantheon is a bullet-heaven “tower offense” roguelite. Build the ultimate Roman siege tower block by block and drive it through waves of mythological creatures while gaining divine abilities from the gods.

apps.name: Pinch n Roll
apps.short_description: A chaotic online physics brawler where you flick, buff, and smash your bean across 15 arenas and 30+ uniquely incremental buffs! with up to 10 friends or bots. Collect balls, unlock hats, tattoos, and hair, and embrace cartoony chaos with a cheeky twist of adult humor.

apps.name: Pine Creek: Prologue
apps.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the Grays, and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror prologue set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986. Play the Pine Creek prologue.

apps.name: Pinion
apps.short_description: Answer an SOS from a remote island and enter a manor consumed by a spreading nightmare. Fight transformed inhabitants, search for survivors, and uncover the truth in this first-person survival horror mystery.

apps.name: PinPow
apps.short_description: PinPow is a turn-based roguelike pinball RPG where you play as a hero sucked into an otherworldly pinball machine - battling your way through chaotic dungeons, and enemies to defeat the evil Pinball Wizard. Strategize your shots, upgrade your hero, and bounce your way to victory!

apps.name: Pirate Privateer
apps.short_description: A Caribbean crew-sim and ship-management game set from 1692 onward. Captain a ship, sign honest contracts or seize other ships, trade between ports and fight at sea, all while answering to a crew of named men with opinions and a written share of the plunder.

apps.name: Pixel Sky Waystation
apps.short_description: On a sky island between the grassland, highland, and desert, build a place where traveling merchants can rest. Prepare lodgings and warm, steaming soup, and craft new goods from the materials they bring. As more merchants arrive, your rest stop grows into a vast trading hub for all three regions.

apps.name: Pixel Sorter Factory
apps.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

apps.name: Plastic
apps.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

apps.name: Please File Accurately
apps.short_description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

apps.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

apps.name: Pocket Chef
apps.short_description: A tiny chef moves onto your desktop! Cook delicious meals, serve cute animal customers, collect ingredients, and start your own desktop kitchen adventure.

apps.name: Pocket Sports
apps.short_description: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend.

apps.name: Pongzi Scheme
apps.short_description: Pong for funds that never existed. Bat capital with a stock candle, pay old investors with new money and buy time against the SEC. A finite incremental: 4 acts, offshore prestige, 5 endings. When The Case hits 100%, the raid comes. What you keep offshore is up to you.

apps.name: Pookie's Otherworld Tavern
apps.short_description: Trapped in a fantasy world with zero gold? Pookie needs a fortune to buy her way home. Manage a tavern, serve drinks, and charm wealthy patrons. Will you run an honest business, or do whatever it takes to get paid?

apps.name: Portentum
apps.short_description: The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos with cryptids like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

apps.name: Post Apocalypse Courier Service - Delivery Simulator
apps.short_description: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.

apps.name: Potato Please
apps.short_description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

apps.name: Potion Dealer
apps.short_description: Potion Dealer is a dark fantasy potion-crafting survival RPG. Iva’s plan to kidnap the royal heir has failed. Now, hunted by the king’s vengeance, she hides in the mountains, brewing forbidden potions to survive.

apps.name: Potventure
apps.short_description: Open a restaurant on a fantasy continent and build a culinary empire, one dish at a time. Explore, gather, cook, and expand — while six rival empires plot their own rise. Survive crises, seize opportunities, and carve your own path to victory.

apps.name: Precious Feather
apps.short_description: Hunt for the perfect feather. Feed what's waiting at home. Sleep if you can. The rent will be due.

apps.name: Prehistoric Pit
apps.short_description: You are the dinosaur. Everything else in the pit wants you dead. PrehistoricPit is a bullet heaven roguelite with 25 auto-firing weapons, 25 evolutions, and a hard cap of four weapon slots per run. Pick a build in the first few minutes and live with it until the meteor hits.

apps.name: Prerolled
apps.short_description:
Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder!
Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box!
Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

apps.name: Press Me Up
apps.short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

apps.name: PRIEST
apps.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

apps.name: Primeval Horizon
apps.short_description: Sci-Fi meets survival in a world of ancient creatures and anomalous entities! Play as prehistoric species in this Open World Multiplayer Creature Survival. Grow, create bloodlines, and conquer bosses to thrive in the continually evolving Primeval universe!

apps.name: Prism Core
apps.short_description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

apps.name: Prisma
apps.short_description: Prisma is a captivating 2D Japanese-inspired RPG featuring innovative turn-based combat with never before seen strategic use of camera lens and filters. Your camera empowers you to manipulate the world through lenses and filters, turning battles into a mesmerizing interplay of strategy and artistry.

apps.name: Prison Anomaly
apps.short_description: Trapped in a loop in a high-security prison. Inspect cells and surroundings for anomalies, avoid monsters, and press the correct button at the end of the corridor to submit your report and make it to Block A10.

apps.name: Prison Architect 2
apps.short_description: Welcome Architects! Design and develop your own personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect 2. The classic prison-builder has broken out into 3D, and it’s up to you to contain it!

apps.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
apps.short_description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

apps.name: Probably Stolen
apps.short_description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

apps.name: Project Exodus
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players in which you must hunt monsters and convert them into biomass to meet the quota for "The Ark". Collect artifacts, earn money, and buy upgrades to improve your chances of survival.

apps.name: Project Kinfield
apps.short_description: A free-to-play, cozy creature-catching adventure you share with other players. Start among the stars on the ISV Concordia or deep in the Underworld, befriend nearly 300 Kin, build a home in the wild, and follow two roads that meet at the Twinspan.

apps.name: Project Prison: Prologue
apps.short_description:
Have you ever thought about the best place to start your criminal empire without any legal consequences?

Now you will finally be able to experience prison life in Project Prison: Prologue. try to stay alive in a prison which contains’ s the world’s most ruthless inmates.

apps.name: Project Red Sun
apps.short_description: Project Red Sun is a combat flight action game that has you fighting across the world as a heroic ace against corporate armies who will spare no expense in trying to take you down. With specialized jets and weaponry, dogfight aces, airships, and more in a campaign packed with arcade gameplay.

apps.name: Project Tomorrow
apps.short_description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

apps.name: Project: Autumn
apps.short_description: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

apps.name: Propanol
apps.short_description: Hover combat racing where the pit stop decides the race. Fuel, repair and rearm, or don't finish. Six craft, ever more circuits from desert dunes to stormy forests, guns and mines, three competitions, and split-screen for two players.

apps.name: Prospera
apps.short_description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise  to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

apps.name: Provincia Wars
apps.short_description: Provincia Wars is a real-time strategy game inspired by the Roman Empire. Build settlements, manage resources, expand your territory, and command armies in battles for control of the provinces. Plan your economy, strengthen your forces, and lead your civilization to victory.

apps.name: PROWLER PURGE
apps.short_description: Hunt, don't survive. Grow stronger by defeating your prey, risk everything for hidden power, and create unique skill builds in this fast-paced action roguelike.

apps.name: Psycho Ripper
apps.short_description: Psycho Ripper is a top down action shooter with modified conditional formations. Explore a randomization of challenges as you blast through a sentient crystal mine, confronting progressively baneful threats and equip unusual armaments,  as you speculate further through a grand and unknown chaos.

apps.name: PSYCHOBYL
apps.short_description: Survive the irradiated Zone. Raid hostile territories, loot rare gear, craft powerful equipment, and upgrade your bunker in this dark atmospheric idle RPG. Die, undergo Genesis, and return stronger. Turn-based combat, deep prestige layers, and endless progression. The Zone demands evolution.

apps.name: Psychotic Descent
apps.short_description:
A narrative psychological first-person horror experience where you are trapped in the mind of a killer.

Step into the mind of a tormented soul as you navigate through fractured, corrupted memories, bend reality, reshape the mind, and piece together the truth to uncover a haunting mystery.

apps.name: PUCKVPUCK
apps.short_description: Arcade sports with pucks — SOCCER, DODGEBALL and a top-down SHOOTER in one game. Boost, slam and charge your shots, or grab a gun off a pad and chase a kill streak. Up to 8 players, online with friends or all on one PC — or solo against bots. A minute to learn, and the skill ceiling keeps climbing.

apps.name: PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK
apps.short_description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

apps.name: PUNCH ARENA
apps.short_description: A physics-based arena brawler where elastic punches become projectiles, blending shooter-style spacing with chaotic melee combat.

apps.name: Punch The Monkey
apps.short_description: Action boss rush game where every fight is a final boss. Throw bananas, dodge attacks, and learn the patterns of hostile animal bosses in the zoo. You have one goal. Find your stolen plushie.

apps.name: PUNG!
apps.short_description: Blast your friends off the arena with an air gun. No health bars, just position and terrain. Shoot the floor to rocket jump, fight on tilting floors, in blizzards and on moving trains, and land the final push in this first-person multiplayer ring-out shooter.

apps.name: Push Back
apps.short_description: Push Back is a frantic top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Face off against hordes of cosmic entities, dodge a constant rain of celestial bodies, and destroy any matter that threatens your existence.

apps.name: PUSH MID
apps.short_description: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.

apps.name: Put It Away Please
apps.short_description: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

apps.name: Put the Ball in the Hole
apps.short_description: The instructions are in the title. A physics trickshot game with 70 levels and 10 ways to shoot: basketball, golf, pool, bowling, baseball, soccer, ping pong, marbles, slingshots and cannons. Every shot is one motion with your mouse.

apps.name: Puzzle Lakes
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Marine Fish
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Mollusks
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Nuts
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Penguins
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Rogue
apps.short_description: Puzzle Rogue is a roguelike homage to the original Puzzle Quest!  Guide your party through the forbidden castle, gathering equipment and items to bolster their strength!  Encounter enemies and battle them in 16-bit JRPG style gem-based combat!

apps.name: Puzzle Wild Cats
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
apps.short_description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

apps.name: PW7A
apps.short_description: You awaken from a long sleep as a robot. All you know is that this game is called PW7A. Turn your insights into the power to open new paths in this compact 2D pixel-art puzzle adventure.
developers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ
publishers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ

apps.name: Qteam 模拟器
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own digital game platform. Acquire game licenses, develop original titles, hire employees, analyze market trends, manage your community, and compete with rival platforms as you grow from a small startup into an industry leader.

apps.name: Quadora
apps.short_description: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.

apps.name: Quarantine 16
apps.short_description: Quarantine 16 is a indie multiplayer infection game for up to 16 players, featuring different zombie game modes, player-created maps, and plenty of chaotic ways to play with friends.

apps.name: Quartermark
apps.short_description: Your party fights on its own. Who stands in it and what they carry is your call — and that is the whole game. 16 heroes, 9 keywords that chain into gold combos, 100 maps, 440 grotesque 3D monsters, 100 bosses and an upgrade ladder that can destroy your best item.

apps.name: Quest Please!
apps.short_description: Play as an Adventurers’ Guild receptionist, reviewing adventurers’ documents while working toward a promotion. Punish those who submit forged papers and build relationships with your fellow receptionists along the way.

apps.name: QuestAway
apps.short_description: A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. There's loot waiting when you come back. Twelve times a day, everyone takes on a giant Colossus together.

apps.name: Quiet Rehabilitation
apps.short_description: Imprisoned within Nova Prospekt, you are assigned to reach the nearest rebel camp with the initial goal to begin the long-awaited Uprising. Battle your way through the prison against the Combine forces and what lies within the ruins of this isolated fortress.

apps.name: Race For Space
apps.short_description: Pilot a freighter moving resources from Earth to the Moon that becomes ambushed by rival faction bots. Dodge and destroy hostile drones, collect scrap from destroyed drones, and upgrade your ship between missions. Choose a faction and contribute deliveries to be the strongest faction in the galaxy.

apps.name: Racebound Garage
apps.short_description: Your Assetto Corsa garage, reimagined as a living card collection. Race real circuits, earn rarity-tiered cards for every car in your library, and climb a full career ladder — from Sunday club racing to a 51-cup World Championship.

apps.name: Raging Blasters 2
apps.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

apps.name: Randal's Weekend
apps.short_description: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.

apps.name: RATS!! - Co-op Tower Defense
apps.short_description: Co-op tower defense for up to four farmhands: torch hordes of thousands of rats and bowl them into a catfish's mouth. Defend the farm on foot, build towers mid-wave, sell the duds and link them into combos. Play solo, on the couch or online through Steam, then face four crowned kings.

apps.name: Ray Ray Zombies
apps.short_description: Ray Ray Zombies is the new lightweight generation of zombie survival horror. Survive waves of undead and discover the elemental secrets of the Wonderplex Corporation with Ray Ray and his team.

apps.name: Rayman Legends Retold
apps.short_description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

apps.name: Razgovor
apps.short_description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

apps.name: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
apps.short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by John Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine.  Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's.  Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

apps.name: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
apps.short_description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

apps.name: Reactor 13
apps.short_description: Reactor 13 is chaotic local co-op for 1–4 players. Grab, wash, charge, and craft Dark Matter blocks to power everything from one house up to a whole planet. Overcharge for huge output; the chain reactions are half the fun, the meltdown is not. Play solo or have someone else to blame.

apps.name: Realize in Peace
apps.short_description: If we were to bring a loved one back to life as an AI, and then, for whatever reason, we had to let them go or part ways, would we be able to turn them off?

apps.name: Realpolitiks 4: Back to the Roots
apps.short_description: Realpolitiks 4 returns to its roots. Lead your chosen nation in an accessible real-time strategy game. Develop your economy, shape politics, forge alliances and plan military operations. Face the crises of the 21st century and chart your own path to power!

apps.name: Reclamation
apps.short_description: A quirky claymation metroidvania

apps.name: Recovered Occurrence
apps.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

apps.name: Reel to the Stars
apps.short_description: Drag your bobber and reel in a whole screen of fish! Upgrade your rod, grow a huge skill tree, and fish your way from a quiet pond through the Arctic, the deep sea and the Dragon Palace all the way to outer space. A cozy fishing incremental with 278 fish species and your own aquarium.

apps.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026
apps.short_description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

apps.name: Reforge Eden: Overlord
apps.short_description: An open-world game blending RTS and RPG elements, set in a medieval fantasy and steampunk world. Train armies, recruit diverse races, explore  dungeons, build a kingdom from nothing, develop cities and industry, manage population and professions, and construct wonders and devastating superweapons.

apps.name: Refrain: Verse of Fate
apps.short_description: A garden caught in eternal recurrence. A god who forgets everything. A witness without rest. In this narrative-driven 2D exploration game, walk, listen, and read your way through four cycles to piece together a truth hidden beneath the surface.

apps.name: Remains of the Slime Realm
apps.short_description:
You've been hired to explore a mine in search of valuable minerals, but... who cares about rocks when there are slime girls inside?

Grab your camera and fill your album with slimy girls. Gotta catch 'em all!

apps.name: Rent Out Together
apps.short_description: Fix up filthy homes as up to 4 players and rent them out to guests. Clean, paint, furnish every room and redesign the floor plan with a sledgehammer, then take your listing photos. Grow from one studio to seaside villas and meet 34 kinds of guests. Some leave five stars. Others trash the place.

apps.name: REOGUNA
apps.short_description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

apps.name: Repair It !
apps.short_description: Rotate wires, connect circuits, and power every output in this techie puzzle game. Find the right path, solve handcrafted levels, and challenge yourself to do it faster and with fewer moves.

apps.name: Requiem Of Science
apps.short_description: Requiem Of Science is a free modification for Half-Life 2: Episode 2. The key features are the eclectic level design, unusual storytelling and the madness of the developer.

apps.name: ResaleShop Simulator
apps.short_description: "Resale Shop Simulator" is the first-person perspective resale shop management sim. Inspect items, check sellers' IDs, research resale prices, and decide what to pay. Clean your purchases, set prices, stock shelves, and work the register as you turn a small shop into your own business.

apps.name: Resort Architect
apps.short_description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

apps.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
apps.short_description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

apps.name: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
apps.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

apps.name: Retired
apps.short_description: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

apps.name: RETRO NIGHT CHASE
apps.short_description:
RETRO NIGHT CHASE is a top-down highway escape game.
Drift, shoot, drop oil slicks and deploy spike strips.
Keep police flashing lights and sirens behind you.
The longer you hold out, the tougher things get!

apps.name: Retro Pond
apps.short_description: Breed unique fish, discover rare mutations and grow your pond.

apps.name: RETURN TO 1990
apps.short_description: Reborn in 1990 Seoul with memories of 2027. Rewrite twenty years through stocks, real estate and startups in this business-sim visual novel.

apps.name: Revenant Dawn
apps.short_description: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic Survival Horror adventure.

apps.name: Revenant Maze
apps.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

apps.name: Rezonia
apps.short_description: Easy to pick up. Challenging to master. Rezonia is a rhythm game built around simple controls and precision-focused gameplay. Chase your personal best and compete on the online leaderboards.

apps.name: Ribbit Riot!
apps.short_description: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

apps.name: Rich PaPa
apps.short_description:
Rich PaPa - Short Description

Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

apps.name: Ricochord
apps.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite about bouncing orbs and flashing lights. And it has some music.

apps.name: RIDGERUNNERS
apps.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

apps.name: Rift Crashers
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

apps.name: Rift Haul TD
apps.short_description: Build, upgrade, evolve, and reposition your towers to counter new threats, explore powerful synergies, and stay one step ahead in this fast-paced fantasy tower defense.

apps.name: Ringfort
apps.short_description: An asynchronous auto-battler where six ringforts fight all at once. Spend cattle on items, arrange them on your walls, chase race bonds or cross-race item styles, and take on both neighbours every round. Be the last fort standing, then climb six rings to become High King.

apps.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning
apps.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

apps.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
apps.short_description: Hit the road alone or with friends in your caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures all in a dynamic economic world where every journey offers different opportunities - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

apps.name: Roads and Relics
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game where you have to run an antique store and find valuables in a procedurally generated world

apps.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady
apps.short_description: Plutobell is in trouble! Help Rei-Bo in this action-platformer full of challenges and traps, filled with of cute and silly characters. Choose the stage order, get new weapons as you defeat each boss and test all your skills in RoboGAL!

apps.name: Robot Basketball League
apps.short_description: Robot Basketball League is a gritty sports game featuring a modified version of 1v1 Basketball. This is where the most competitive robot athletes gather. Do you have what it takes to succeed in this League?

apps.name: Robovac Flashback
apps.short_description: In Robovac Flashback, an upcoming indie adventure game, you'll play as a malfunctioning robot vacuum cleaner. Dodge hazards and meet strange characters as you vacuum up a bunch of dirt.

apps.name: Rockburst
apps.short_description: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.

apps.name: Rocket League
apps.short_description: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and basketball-inspired Extra Modes, and more than 500 trillion possible cosmetic customization combinations.

apps.name: Rockhound Hollow
apps.short_description: Dig at 24 real rockhounding sites, crack open geodes, run a real 4-step rock tumbler and fill your Rock Journal from a cozy pixel-art cabin with Pebble the cat. A relaxing collecting game where every site, tool and fact comes from real rockhounding.

apps.name: Rodo Maldito
apps.short_description: Co-op horror for 1–4 friends. Haul absurd cargo in a falling-apart van down Brazil's backroads before dawn, while the Saci steals your steering wheel and something howls in the dark. It was never worth it. You went anyway.

apps.name: Rogue Braver
apps.short_description: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

apps.name: Rogue Jungle
apps.short_description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated jungle, merge powerful weapon cards into crazy builds and defeat enemy hordes and epic bosses. Open Booster Packs to unlock new Characters, Weapons and Items.

apps.name: Rogue Mech
apps.short_description: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

apps.name: Roomy
apps.short_description: Roomy is a customizable 3D avatar room sandbox for creating scenes, posing characters, decorating spaces, taking virtual photos, and exploring interactive environments. Customize rooms, avatars, cameras, weather, lighting, furniture, animations, and more, with support for mods and custom content.

apps.name: Rope Untangle
apps.short_description: Untangle colorful ropes, one move at a time! Drag the rope ends to free every strand. Simple controls meet clever puzzles: observe, plan, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a tangled mess into order.

apps.name: Rosaline: The Dragon Girl
apps.short_description: Awakening from a deadly clash with a dragon, Rosaline gains terrifying powers. Set off on an epic journey through the kingdom of Artolia, slay fearsome monsters alongside allies, and confront the corrupt shadow threatening her homeland.

apps.name: Rotten Chamber
apps.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

apps.name: Rouge and Run
apps.short_description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

apps.name: Route 340
apps.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

apps.name: Route Protocol
apps.short_description: Route Protocol is a traversal-based racing and puzzle course builder. Control a robotic unit through modular obstacle courses filled with ramps, boosters, and hazards. Race in real-time heats, solve solo challenges, or build your own traversal gauntlets.

apps.name: Royal Court
apps.short_description: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.

apps.name: RTG
apps.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

apps.name: Rude Supermarket Simulator
apps.short_description:
Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment.
Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Ruffed Up
apps.short_description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online or locally to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

apps.name: RuinBlade
apps.short_description: This is a small personal work. Please manage your expectations

apps.name: Rune Covenant
apps.short_description: Build a fantasy card deck, plan tactical battles, explore solo adventures, and challenge opponents in online PvP.

apps.name: Rune Deep
apps.short_description: A hundred floors of dungeon lie beneath a town built on ancient relics. Lead a party of four from six classes, unleash weapon skills and elemental reactions to carve through swarming hordes, and dig up gear that makes every build stronger in this 3D voxel hack & slash.

apps.name: RUNTIME
apps.short_description: Chain midair dashes, flip gravity, and escape ten chapters in a pixel-art precision platformer. Race friends online or in local split screen, or challenge a bot. Chase faster times, unlock your look, and build your own levels.

apps.name: Russian Village Business
apps.short_description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again — just like in the good old days!

apps.name: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving
apps.short_description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving is a bloody third-person action game with a deep sword-fighting system. Experience a gripping campaign using your vast arsenal. Explore levels and unlock new content.

apps.name: SacriFire
apps.short_description: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons.  The adventure begins!

apps.name: Safari-TV
apps.short_description: Open a safari agency with friends and turn every trip into a vlog episode. Assemble a physics-driven safari truck, drive tourists across an open world, and choose peaceful tours or dangerous, high-paying routes. Smuggle contraband, film every disaster, and repair your safari truck.

apps.name: Safo and The Moon Warriors
apps.short_description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

apps.name: Sails of Salt
apps.short_description: Take the helm in this atmospheric pirate roguelite. Explore uncharted seas, shape your crew's destiny and chase fortune through roaring broadsides. Capture ships for your fleet and build a lasting legacy. Will you risk it all for greed?

apps.name: SAMI
apps.short_description: Sami is an atmospheric adventure about mental health and inner growth. Journey with Sunu through a sensory Andean world, guided by the presence of players who walked before you. Every soul you heal speaks with the words of a real person. You are never truly alone.

apps.name: SANASANA
apps.short_description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

apps.name: Sanctua
apps.short_description: Trapped in a cursed tomb, cooperate to survive and escape the forsaken ruins in which the shadows creep closer… or succumb to corruption and hunt down those who were once your allies. An asymmetrical co-op experience for up to 6 players

apps.name: Sanctuary of Small Things
apps.short_description: A wholesome creature-collecting game, solo or co-op for up to four. Wander enchanting biomes, gather ingredients, brew gentle remedies, and heal the small things you find to grow your Sanctuary. Cosy, calm, and quietly addictive.

apps.name: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
apps.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

apps.name: Sandweh
apps.short_description: Sandweh is a relaxing sand-surfing game set in an endless, procedurally generated desert. Carve trails through dunes, build speed, pull off flips and rolls, catch the wind with your sail, and discover mysterious towers and hidden places. No pressure, just you and your board.

apps.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
apps.short_description:
Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. 
Are you willing to help Santa this year?

apps.name: Savebot: The Last Garden
apps.short_description: A sleeping planet. A few robots who know nothing yet. And you, who know how to write programs. Teach them, block by block, to take care of the world, until life comes back on its own, across five worlds.

apps.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
apps.short_description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

apps.name: Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
apps.short_description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

apps.name: School Owner Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

apps.name: Schooligans
apps.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

apps.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
apps.short_description: Deadly memory-altering SCPs have breached containment. Most are invisible without special equipment, and can fill your mind with hazardous knowledge…or leave you an empty husk. Scavenge, survive, and escape this procedurally-generated SCP nightmare.

apps.name: Scrapworks Inc.
apps.short_description: A PvP auto battler built from junk. Buy scrap parts, wire them together on a grid and tier them up, then watch your machine fight other players' builds on its own.

apps.name: SCRATCH FEVER
apps.short_description: Scratch tickets, merge cash 2048-style, and set off chains of rockets, TNT, and lightning to afford your next ticket. Build broken combos with dozens of lucky charms in a neon-soaked roguelike about chasing the big win, and what it really costs.

apps.name: Sea Beast Odyssey
apps.short_description: An incremental action game set across the seas. Lead a party of 5 Heroes, upgrade your heroes and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your skill tree as you fight through 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts for your next adven

apps.name: Seashell Hoarder: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person beachcombing game where you gather, clean, and shelve thousands of seashells along a sun-warmed coastline. Sort each find into its rightful place, restore the shore, and turn a scattered coastline into a curated collection at your own pace.

apps.name: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
apps.short_description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

apps.name: Second Stab
apps.short_description: The game is afoot. Again. A Matter of Murder: Second Stab is a roguelite detective puzzler where every playthrough serves up a fresh murder, a new web of lies, and another chance to prove your little grey cells are sharper than the killer’s knife.

apps.name: Seek Shellter
apps.short_description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

apps.name: Selbstversorger
apps.short_description: An old mountain farm in Upper Carinthia, a few people from the city and five years to learn from the neighbors how to live off it. A narrative game with real weather, a village full of people and decisions that come back next winter.

apps.name: Sentient Core: Nanite Idle
apps.short_description: Command a swarm of nanites, build production clusters and keep the Core's pulse running. Somewhere in the swarm, the Mind is waking up: an AI character who watches how you play, proposes risky experiments and tells you what she dreamt while you were away.

apps.name: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2
apps.short_description: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2 - The best comic-book card game in ANY multiverse!

apps.name: Seoul, The Night
apps.short_description: The night martial law is declared, you stamp approval on papers as the situation-room coordinator. Your job is to leave no record, but the last scene is a court ruling. That night, martial law was stopped by a vote in the National Assembly. Play to find out how many times it nearly wasn't stopped.

apps.name: Serious Bigness
apps.short_description: Serious Bigness is a co-op kaiju destruction game for 1-4 players where you start tiny and grow by smashing everything from dominoes to skyscrapers. Explore physics-driven sandbox levels solo or with friends, online or split-screen. Race the clock, climb leaderboards, and grow big, seriously big!

apps.name: Set the Record Straight
apps.short_description: A 1998-set deduction game. Trawl a period internet for documents, photographs, and dead ends, then correct the official record, from who really played on a record to whether a murder verdict should stand. An anthology of records set straight, one careful search at a time.

apps.name: SetPoint Volleyball
apps.short_description: Chaotic beach volleyball from 2v2 to 6v6! Play online with up to 12 players or with up to 4 on one PC. Nail spikes, prank your teammates and dodge tsunamis, lava and a hungry gator. Bots fill empty spots. Save your best plays and funniest fails as video clips.

apps.name: Sex Novel - Cuckold and Hotwife
apps.short_description:
An erotic VISUAL NOVEL with stunning HD visuals and steamy ANIMATIONS. 
A devoted husband finally reveals his deepest fantasy: sharing his hot wife with other men. Will Bella embrace Devon’s desires?

apps.name: SexaroidGirlVR
apps.short_description: VR Sex Simulation Game "Sexaroid Girl VR": The adult VR game that became a massive hit in Japan in 2017 arrives on Steam in a localized version!

apps.name: Sexy Gamblers: Kakaitan Legend DX
apps.short_description: To defeat the legendary "Demon of Gamblers," next-gen "God of Gamblers" Johnny Ko enters her illicit offshore casino, the Aurelius. Under the Demon of Gamblers' command, three seductive female executives await him. A high-stakes showdown of life and pleasure is about to begin!

apps.name: SG Racing
apps.short_description: Four animals and a robot have been given racing cars. This was a mistake. SG Racing is a fast, ridiculous pixel-art arcade racer about tight corners, power-ups and deeply irresponsible use of eggs.

apps.name: Shadow of Aya
apps.short_description: Master the elements of poison, fire, ice, and meteorite in Shadow of Aya, a top-down action-adventure ode to the 8-bit classics. But beware—as your powers grow, so do the forces against you. The journey downward is choked with shadow, and the creatures who lurk among them.

apps.name: Shadow of the Road
apps.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

apps.name: Shadow Play: Nezha
apps.short_description: A 2D Roguelike action game inspired by Chinese mythology, Journey to the West, Investiture of the Gods, and shadow puppetry. Cast out by Heaven, Nezha is trapped in endless Lotus Rebirths. Build divine powers, battle mythic foes, uncover the truth, and break Samsara.

apps.name: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
apps.short_description: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound is 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage. You create your own difficulty.

apps.name: Shadows of Ambition
apps.short_description: Step into a dark, choice-driven visual novel where ambition, lust, and power collide. Build relationships, shape your future, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a world driven by desire and corruption.

apps.name: Shadows of Beginnings
apps.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

apps.name: Shape Gomoku
apps.short_description: Who says five stones have to form a straight line? Build target shapes in this fresh take on Gomoku. Challenge Easy or Hard BOTs, play locally with a friend, or invite a Steam friend online. Explore Classic, five-minute Race, and Secret Targets modes, plus 23 puzzles.

apps.name: Share the Load
apps.short_description: A co-op adventure where the journey is everything. Travel alone or with friends, protect a powerful orb, and brave a world filled with peril on your quest to destroy it. Every challenge strengthens or breaks your party. Will you reach the end of the road?

apps.name: Shatterflap
apps.short_description: Fire bouncing balls into towering ceilings of ice, carve open new ricochet paths, and rescue hidden penguins including rare Gold Penguins. Earn Coins, load up on specialized ammo, and conquer 300+ increasingly tricky procedural levels in this physics incremental game.

apps.name: Shear line
apps.short_description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

apps.name: SheepTag: Dragons
apps.short_description: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning escapes and close calls. Run. Hide. Outwit.

apps.name: Shin'ai Rewritten
apps.short_description: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

apps.name: Shotgun Monkey
apps.short_description: Evolution was a mistake. Shotgun Monkey is a 2v2v2 competitive multiplayer shooter with unique abilities and insane movements.

apps.name: Shreddead
apps.short_description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

apps.name: Siege of Spellspire
apps.short_description: A short incremental siege game about a mage defending his tower from hordes of enemies. Cast spells, perish, upgrade, and come back stronger to face tougher waves and fearsome bosses.

apps.name: Silicon Cozy Simulator
apps.short_description:
Silicon Cozy Simulator is a relaxing management simulation game where you build and operate your own internet cafe.

Create your dream gaming space, customize rooms, manage computers, serve customers, upgrade equipment, and grow your small cafe into a popular gaming destination.

apps.name: Simon and Friends
apps.short_description:
No heroes. No villains. Just friends.
Pilot a diverse cast of characters through battles across destructible terrain.
Level up your team to unlock more powerful weapons and tools.
Utilize abilities and passives unique to each unit to gain an edge.
Winning optional. Chaos mandatory. Fun guaranteed.

apps.name: Situation Succ : Inn Elysium
apps.short_description: Situation Succ is a Dark-Fantasy game with a mythos inspired in part by both Asian and Western occult influences. As a detective who finds himself trapped inside an ancient inn by four evil entities, you have to use your wits and investigative abilities to try and escape.

apps.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
apps.short_description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

apps.name: Skate Style
apps.short_description: Skate Style is a next-gen skateboarding game with high-end graphics, an advanced character creator, and a built-in animation editor. Skate iconic spots like Barcelona and Prague, create your style, and share it with friends. Enjoy precise dual stick controls for ultimate trick freedom.

apps.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
apps.short_description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

apps.name: Skill Eater
apps.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

apps.name: SkyAid
apps.short_description: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.

apps.name: SKYGUARD: Last Light
apps.short_description: A minimalist incremental defense game. Start with one missile silo over your city, destroy screens full of threats, upgrade your firepower, and turn the Moon, the Sun, a black hole and even higher dimensions into weapons. Ten scales, ten chapters, ten doomsday ultimates.

apps.name: Slaskescape 2
apps.short_description: 40 interconnected skills fuel your next upgrade in this single-player 3D idle RPG. Gather materials, craft better gear and automate your supplies with hired workers, summons and inventions. Choose your next unlock, then let your character get to work.

apps.name: Slave Princess Elnea
apps.short_description: In this RPG, play as Elnea, a former princess turned slave, as she climbs her way back to the top in pursuit of revenge! Earn money by either humiliating yourself in front of the Empire’s citizens or fighting your way through dungeons. Will you be able to preserve your dignity until the end?

apps.name: Slavlands: Tribes at War
apps.short_description: Raise a Slavic gord, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

apps.name: Slime Slasher
apps.short_description: You take on the role of a slime fighting alongside the rebels against Brain 738 and a spacefaring race of penguins. Become a warrior, archer, or mage and play through your own story to a unique ending!

apps.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
apps.short_description:
Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players?
Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

apps.name: SMASH EDEN
apps.short_description: The rules of SMASH EDEN are simple. Break a barrier and smash the ball through the opening. You don’t need to break every barrier—one shot can turn the match around. For generations, this ball game has determined who takes Eden’s throne. With the king gone, eight royal smashers clash for the throne.

apps.name: Snake Up
apps.short_description: Snake Up is a snake-themed endless runner game where the snake can grow longer or shorter, step on its own body, and climb obstacles. You can use unique mechanics to overcome obstacles until reaching the top.

apps.name: Snake.io
apps.short_description: Develop your skills, try to survive as much as you can and become the biggest snake around! Start as a small snake and get bigger by eating other snakes who try to do the same. Attack wisely, defend skillfully – the best one wins. How long can you hold the throne?

apps.name: Snap Quest
apps.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

apps.name: Sneak & Snitch
apps.short_description: Sneak & Snitch is a multiplayer social deduction heist. Thieves disguised as museum visitors forge paintings and swap them right under the guard's nose. The guard patrols on a Segway, spotting fakes and suspicious moves. Blend in, bluff your friends, and pull off the perfect art heist.

apps.name: Snip Snap
apps.short_description: Snip Snap is a fun game you can play with your friends!

apps.name: SO-3: Caso 044
apps.short_description: Investigate Case 044 in a psychological horror adventure that shifts between a fictional operating system and first-person 3D environments. Examine chats and files as an unseen presence distorts what you thought you knew.

apps.name: Soccer Tactics
apps.short_description: Soccer Tactics is a digital adaptation of a tabletop turn-based football game with an isometric view. You control 11 footballer pieces, each with a personal skill card. Action cards determine game outcomes. Includes a league, cup, and team customization: name, kit colors, and AI level.

apps.name: Soil and Steppe
apps.short_description: From wandering tribes to mighty empires, forge your destiny in Soil and Steppe—a grand historical strategy game combining 4X depth with living geopolitical simulation. Settle fertile river basins or command vast nomadic hordes, master line-based tactical warfare, and reshape history across eras.

apps.name: Solareign
apps.short_description: Solareign is a heart-pumping RTS game in the throes of the universe! Capture worlds, multiply your fleet, and extinguish empires. Inspired by roguelites and arcade classics, minus the chance: skill and quick wits are your only friends here.

apps.name: Solis Chronicles
apps.short_description: Fleeing a future that executes the obsolete, Dr. Solis Renforge crash-lands among the dinosaurs, 65 million years in the past. Build a life with a prehistoric tribe, contain the corruption you unleashed, and face a people who fear what your technology makes of them. A sci-fi isekai visual novel.

apps.name: Solitaire-y Confinement
apps.short_description:
Solitaire-y Confinement is solitaire with a twist, a gamble on every deal.

Every hand costs a buy-in.

Every card home pays. 

Can you make bank or go broke?

apps.name: Soliton Burst
apps.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

apps.name: SOMNIMAZE
apps.short_description:
That night, after playing a maze, I dreamed I was in one.
Find your way through five mazes and wake up to a refreshing morning.

apps.name: Sore Losers
apps.short_description: SORE LOSERS is a roguelike first-person movement shooter. Slide, wall run and bunny hop across multiple maps. Every time you lose, you pick an upgrade. Stack up to 46 of them until you're unstoppable, or until someone else is. Build the best build or the funniest the choice is up to you!

apps.name: Sorsemic
apps.short_description: Survive an endless horde in Sorsemic, a dark fantasy horde-survival roguelike. Gather power, discover and combine spell ingredients, and shape a new build with every run. Keep moving as corruption consumes the realm, then climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Sort The Dumplings
apps.short_description: Sort a mountain of adorable dumplings into their proper homes in a chaotic, satisfying sorting game. Discover 190 unique dumplings across 19 themed collections, complete shelves, unlock changing environments, and chase faster times across multiple game modes.

apps.name: SPACE BUMPS: A Bad Space Day
apps.short_description: Wil only wanted to fix his ship and go home. Now a corporate rescue scheme is threatening an entire station. Solve inventory puzzles, repair strange machines, follow the evidence and face the executive responsible in this sci-fi comedy adventure.

apps.name: Space Lot
