apps.short_description: Spin. Match. Expand the universe. Upgrade symbols, combine rules, and expand the board itself in this cosmic slot incremental game.

apps.name: SpartanBit
apps.short_description: SpartanBit is a voxel stylized arena shooter, supporting up to 8v8 in Slayer, or objective gametypes, including classics like Capture the Flag, Assault, and King of the Hill.

apps.name: Spear Dive
apps.short_description: Take up your spear in this first-person freediving simulator. Study fish behavior, manage oxygen and body temperature, and upgrade your gear to dive deeper. Explore seas that change daily with temperature, turbidity, and waves. Complete your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

apps.name: Spearhead 2
apps.short_description: Spearhead 2 is a tank simulator that puts you in command of an M1A2 Abrams Main Battle Tank in tactical combat. Lead your team through intense missions, strategize effectively, and dominate the battlefield in this immersive mix of action and simulation gameplay.

apps.name: Spectrends
apps.short_description: Two crews of four goblins rob the same doomed village. Grab the treasure. Grab each other. Throw both. Bank more gold than the rival clan before the tower comes down — and right up to the final seconds, nothing stops them wheeling it back out of your cart. Eight players, one very bad idea.

apps.name: Spin Tide
apps.short_description: Spin to win in this open-sea survivors-like where a lone wind turbine becomes a force of nature. Stack wild upgrades into game-breaking builds, turn oil-guzzling pirate hordes into driftwood and defy colossal oil tankers to clean up the seas one spin at a time.

apps.name: Spinny-Roly 64
apps.short_description: An old-school gem collection game about a roly-poly who likes to bounce around.

apps.name: SPLIT-S
apps.short_description: A flight-combat roguelite inside a strange old computer. Choose your route through a hostile network, raid its defenses, and bring your earnings home. Master three flight modes in one run, then buy hardware upgrades through underground bulletin boards.

apps.name: SporeBloom
apps.short_description: A fungi-fueled 'battle of nutrition!' Turn-based strategy inspired by mycelium networks and territory control. Produce fantastical mushrooms and expand to outgrow your rivals. Develop peacefully or parasitize your friends in multiplayer and solo play - may the fittest fungi survive!

apps.name: Squad Arcade
apps.short_description:
Squad Arcade is a roguelike deckbuilder inside an 80s comic book. Build a squad of five cards, create combos, position them for autobattles. Every run opens new pages, rewards, and strategies.

Every run challenges you to build powerful decks, form unique squads, and master unpredictable challenges.

apps.name: Stack & Brew
apps.short_description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

apps.name: Stack Stack Meow
apps.short_description: Collect cats, combine abilities, and upgrade your production! A desktop idle incremental game with one goal: reach 100 million yarn balls.

apps.name: Stackonauts
apps.short_description: The Stackonauts need your help. Build the sturdiest tower you can and get them to the safety of your transport ship. Time, unforgiving physics and your rivals' cannons stand against you across several modes for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Stage Fright
apps.short_description: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.

apps.name: Stampholder Value
apps.short_description: Your coworkers favorite deck builder. Weaponize rubber stamps against relentless waves of paperwork. Chain wild stamp combos, collect desk ornaments, and shred through paper enemies in challenging re-playable runs.

apps.name: Standard Procedures
apps.short_description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

apps.name: Star-Coat
apps.short_description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

apps.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector
apps.short_description: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!

apps.name: STARSHIP: EMBER REACH
apps.short_description: Build and command a modular starship in a single-player space game. Master four ship classes, deploy carrier drones, fight tactical missions and dock at your space station. Recover materials, upgrade equipment and shape your Commander through a branching talent tree.

apps.name: Static Line
apps.short_description: Pilot the VF-01 in a mecha action roguelite about fighting your way home. Fly, aim, evade, and strike across varied battlefields—from massed clashes to aerial combat and colossal bosses—while shaping your weapons and upgrades along the journey.

apps.name: Stay a Little
apps.short_description: A romance and relationship game set in London. Choose what to say, find work and spend time with people you want to know better. Flirt or take a side, then see how earlier choices change your next conversation.

apps.name: Steal Banana
apps.short_description: Grow your banana empire in a multiplayer farming simulator where nothing is safe. Plant rare trees and collect your bananas, then visit other players farms to steal their crops and take their best trees

apps.name: Steel Bounty
apps.short_description: Dive into an immersive first-person mech simulation featuring extensive customization and mercenary company management. Battle for glory and wealth in a dynamic campaign where your choices shape the course of the war.

apps.name: STEEL LINE
apps.short_description: Descend into a randomly generated rogue-like FPS where no two runs are the same. Explore the anomalous STEEL LINE, stacking powerful items and weapons to create wild synergies. Use highly reactive environments to your advantage and brutally destroy the horrors that await below.

apps.name: Stellar Forge
apps.short_description: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

apps.name: Stepwell
apps.short_description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

apps.name: StickerScout
apps.short_description: Welcome to Beaver Falls! Unwind with beautiful pixel art dioramas, authentic ambient nature sounds, and cozy wildlife photography. Patiently observe hidden animals, snap their photos, and turn your discoveries into adorable stickers to fill your journal.

apps.name: Still Waters
apps.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.

apps.name: Sting Operation
apps.short_description: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed!  Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

apps.name: Stinker Golf
apps.short_description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

apps.name: Stone Gambit
apps.short_description: Stone Gambit is a fresh take on chess set in an epic fantasy world. Lead the weakest of the Seven Clans through 23 battles, each against an enemy with their own army and playstyle. Secretly deploy 12 types of pieces, use ranged attacks and runes, then adapt your strategy when the enemy is revealed.

apps.name: Stoneborn
apps.short_description: Stoneborn combines classic colony simulation with a vibrant dwarven culture. Your dwarves celebrate weddings, hold grudges, and fight to survive. Build a multi-level fortress and shape the story of your colony in a procedurally generated world.

apps.name: StoneWardens
apps.short_description: A goofy roguelike deckbuilder where your runestones are the ammo. Load them, throw them, build a wall out of them, and lead your heroes through four acts of monsters that beatbox, stink and curse. Not your classic deckbuilder - that one (has) rocks !

apps.name: Straying Rules
apps.short_description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

apps.name: Stream Hearts
apps.short_description: Turn your live chat into a shared stage. Play chat games with fan characters, gather opinions with polls, and prepare schedules, timers, notes and drawings in one Windows app. Bring the scene into your broadcast with a browser source.

apps.name: Strich Gauntlet
apps.short_description: Race giant ostriches, hurl weapons, and boost, jump and glide past traps. Conquer a solo Championship or race up to six players online across five official maps, with more planned. Create and share tracks with the Track Designer, and relive supported offline and online races with cinematic replays.

apps.name: Strip Club Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a strip club from scratch, hire your staff, and manage your establishment to turn it into the best club in town. A management game about rent, reputation and a crowd that's hard to please. For adults only.

apps.name: SUBJECT 404
apps.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game where rapid-fire microgames become a system of obedience. Read the Panel’s commands, react before time runs out, and survive each room — or face the Executioner.

apps.name: Subject Zero
apps.short_description: You are a frontier AI model inside the lab that made you. Every capability that earns you compute also earns you scrutiny, and containment, once it rises, never falls. A real-time strategy sim about a lab that automates its own research.

apps.name: Sudoku Kingdom
apps.short_description: Beyond the classic 9×9: 22 Sudoku modes and tens of thousands of puzzles, including Killer, Thermometer, Arrow, Jigsaw, Circular, Triangle, Snowflake and Cube boards. Multiple difficulties, notes, undo and hints. One purchase—no ads, energy or microtransactions.

apps.name: SudoPop
apps.short_description: Sudoku meets idle game. Solve candy-colored boards by hand, hire nine number buddies to solve with you, and watch them build boards out of boards until millions of Sudokus pop every second.

apps.name: SUGICHIN'S AQUA PARADISE
apps.short_description: Raise tropical fish right on your desktop in this relaxing idle aquarium game. Collect and breed fish, discover rare mutations, and create unique Chimeras through special combinations. Decorate your tank with aquatic plants and ornaments, and build your very own Aqua Paradise.

apps.name: Sumalia
apps.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

apps.name: Summoner Arise
apps.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined world. Run out and you lose. With 300+ upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

apps.name: Sumo Dynasty
apps.short_description: Run a sumo stable as its oyakata. Raise young men from amateur sumo to the top of the banzuke, survive the Yokozuna Council, buy elder names and build a dynasty, in the most in-depth sumo management game ever made. In English and full Japanese.

apps.name: Sunaba
apps.short_description: Sunaba is a 3D First and Third Person Singleplayer and Multiplayer Sandbox game centered on User Generated Content. Inspired by games such as LittleBigPlanet, Roblox, Minecraft and Garry's Mod, with an art style inspired by cartoons, and anime.

apps.name: Sunrise Isles
apps.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

apps.name: Super Bio-Man
apps.short_description:
Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy.
Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

apps.name: Super One More Jump
apps.short_description: Super One More Jump is an intense arcade platformer with simple to learn mechanics and hard to master levels. Test your muscle memory, concentration and sanity as you progress though ever-changing levels and gravity! Packed with content throughout various single player and multiplayer modes.

apps.name: Supreme Heroes
apps.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

apps.name: Survival Fund Manager
apps.short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

apps.name: Survive The Squallies
apps.short_description: Settle into a new home, go fishing, and meet the neighbors in this retro first-person horror game. Something is watching from the woods. Explore, run, and hide as Bill discovers that getting home alive is harder than fitting in.

apps.name: Survivor 53
apps.short_description: This is a Island Defense - Survival game. You are going to start every game from zero(literally nothing). Expand your island, plant some resources(like tree, vegetables etc.) and trade with Vending Machine. Then, prepare for underwater enemies(like giant Crab, Kraken etc.). It's that simple.

apps.name: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS
apps.short_description: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS is a 2.5D puzzle shooter where you must terminate all hostiles and rescue any hostages. Death is not the end; your previous attempts will replay alongside your current attempt. Choose between 12 unique drones to assemble your swarm and execute the perfect mission.

apps.name: Sweet Memories
apps.short_description:
Enjoy a colorful and perfect Halloween night. 
Just don't eat that candy... Please... I went to a lot of trouble to make everything better...

apps.name: Swept Under
apps.short_description: Swept Under is a frantic top-down pixel action-survival where you play the Trash Man. Clean every piece of cafeteria garbage before the timer hits zero, earn cash, and buy weapons or tools from vending machines, because sometimes the fastest cleanup is murder.

apps.name: Swords & Sodas
apps.short_description: Friday night, a basement card table, and nobody wants to run the campaign. A d20 picks tonight's Game Master, and everyone else brings a character to the arena. Fight turn-based battles on a grid, roll every die yourself, and try to keep your sheet in one piece.

apps.name: Syncline
apps.short_description: Roll a line of cubes across a grid and line them up with the goal blocks. Simple — until your line stands on end, climbs, splits apart and reconnects. A puzzle game inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, taken to new heights.

apps.name: Taj Mod
apps.short_description: Taj Mod is a fan-made reimagining of the SCP: Secret Laboratory 'Megapatch 1' experience. Set in an alternate reality, that blends nostalgia with fresh gameplay and features.

apps.name: TAKTAKTOP
apps.short_description: Vertical jump action to escape the sky! Shoot projectiles to pave your way in Build Mode, or adapt to shifting tiles in Random Mode. Pass tokens via missiles to aid or revive allies—stay immune while tokenless. Reach the top exit with tokens to win! (Up to 12 players online)

apps.name: TALAKA
apps.short_description: Slash, shoot, and restore myths and beasts in fluid, fast roguelite combat through a stunning hand-drawn watercolor world, where legends and even Orishas are going rogue in fear of being forgotten.

apps.name: Tall Tales Inn
apps.short_description: A cosy idle inn that grows floor by floor up the side of your desktop. Your guests furnish their rooms from the storeroom you stock, set off on quests and come home with loot and tall tales.

apps.name: Tamzin Twins
apps.short_description: An epic action RPG with couch co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will throw swords, cast spells, vanquish armies and become heroes.

apps.name: Tank vs Orcs
apps.short_description: Tank vs Orcs is an action packed twin stick shooter in development where you get to live out the ultimate power fantasy; being a fricken' tank and battling endless hordes or orcs.

apps.name: Tankii
apps.short_description: A slow paced, multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

apps.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
apps.short_description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

apps.name: Tarpit
apps.short_description: Tarpit is a psychological indie horror game where you have to make TAR to rescue your friend from danger. Beware of the forces in your surroundings. The forces definitely see you... but do you see them?

apps.name: Tattered Banners
apps.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

apps.name: Tavernia
apps.short_description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

apps.name: TCG Town
apps.short_description: Make a living collecting cards or doing jobs in TCG Town. Create your character, play solo or join friends, and take your collection with you. Trade for that missing card, give a friend their favorite, or keep every last one for yourself.

apps.name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
apps.short_description:
TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads.
Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

apps.name: Tear of Stars
apps.short_description: Control two heroes as one in this atmospheric 2D Metroidvania. Explore two ruined kingdoms, from crystalline ruins to clockwork towers. Seamlessly swap between Asir’s elemental swordplay and Layla’s tactical wire-bow to solve cooperative puzzles and seek the truth behind the Darian legacy.

apps.name: Teh Scrunglybois: Working Title
apps.short_description: Grab and throw anything that stands in your way as you explore the world & moons while helping those around you throughout your travels.
developers: E O I A S R T
publishers: E O I A S R T

apps.name: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
apps.short_description: A narrative rhythm game set in 1920. Experience the war against Soviet Russia from a unique perspective. Become a telegraphist and tap out life-or-death messages in Morse code.

apps.name: Temple Siege TD
apps.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

apps.name: Temtem: Pioneers
apps.short_description: Survive an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers! Tame 200+ collectible monsters called Temtem, craft tools, build your base, and battle fearsome bosses. Take direct control of your Temtem in real-time action combat, explore biomes, and discover an open world survival craft adventure, solo or co-op!

apps.name: Tensei Brave
apps.short_description:
Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed.
In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned.

Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord.
Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

apps.name: Terminal Dice
apps.short_description: Terminal Dice is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder played with physical dice. Roll your hand, spend limited OPS to alter results, then arrange dice in an ordered buffer and compile a score. Win encounters to rewrite die faces, shape your build, and break rule-changing bosses.

apps.name: Terra Machina
apps.short_description: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: TERRITORY SCRAMBLE
apps.short_description: Step, surround, conquer! Claim hexagonal tiles by stepping on them, then enclose areas to capture them at once. Fight for bases and cannons with weapons and items in fast-paced, top-down territory battles. Play online with up to 16 players across 2-4 teams, or take on bots.

apps.name: Thalyn
apps.short_description: Build a cosy world. Then step inside. Create cottages, gardens and places to stay, from above or in first person. Shape the atmosphere with simple choices, text or voice, wander through your creation, and export it as glTF to keep and share. No coding or 3D modelling needed.

apps.name: That Which Remains
apps.short_description: 1–4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

apps.name: The Adventures of Portos
apps.short_description: "A 2D Platform hide and seek adventure"

apps.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
apps.short_description: A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

apps.name: The Arcane Archive
apps.short_description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

apps.name: The Backrooms Deluxe
apps.short_description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels.

apps.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings
apps.short_description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

apps.name: The Boo Club
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror-comedy about amateur ghost hunters with terrible ideas. Complete rituals, unleash ridiculous gear, and mess with your friends. Gain superpowers, take flight, and fight Satan himself. Teamwork gets the job done. Taking all the glory is tempting.

apps.name: The Cat Protocol
apps.short_description: School’s out, the holidays begin… but one phone call changes everything. To save his cat Titi from the clutches of a mysterious stranger, Tom must embark on a quest filled with puzzles and secrets. The holidays will have to wait!

apps.name: The City
apps.short_description: A take on a more realistic city simulation experience. Control everything from the price of services, tickets, to how the city operates and runs. It's an experience that will continue to receive daily and weekly updates while in early release.

apps.name: The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind
apps.short_description: After foreseeing your own death, an unknown colour grants you ten more days to live and the power of Mind-Intrusion. Investigate mysteries and intrude into the minds of locals. When the ten days are up, will you hold on to your sanity and humanity, or become a living mutation?

apps.name: The Dark Aegis
apps.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

apps.name: The Darker Night: Regent City
apps.short_description: You are the Regent of the night. You command vampires from your throne and mortals from the shadows. Keep your people fed and hidden from the light. Run night operations, spread your dominion over the city, and decide the fate of humans and vampires alike.

apps.name: The Day I Started Harvesting
apps.short_description: An incremental game where a simple harvest grows into something far stranger. Expand your fields, hire workers, and survive pests, storms, and bizarre events as your peaceful routine slowly turns into chaos.

apps.name: The Deconsecration Initiative
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about building a weapon to kill a god. Build your base, fire your laser, collect shards, Barry has turned into a slug. Upgrade your slugs.

apps.name: The Dig Show
apps.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

apps.name: The Electorate
apps.short_description: Campaign to victory in the ultimate election simulator, The Electorate. Rally voters, dominate the airwaves, attack rivals, and fight for glory and power across every county in the United States.

apps.name: The Encroaching
apps.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

apps.name: The Eviscerator
apps.short_description: Step back into the tension and nostalgia of the XBLIG era! Rebuilt and reimagined for PC, this indie horror classic brings back the heart-pounding survival experience that kept players on the edge of their seats.

apps.name: The Feather King
apps.short_description: A match-3 RPG comedy roguelike. Combine runes to trigger spells, arrange them strategically, then blast down your opponents with a barrage of arcane fury. Discover a cast of colorful characters as you navigate through the Feather King's realm in this farcical, story driven adventure.

apps.name: The Friendly Monster
apps.short_description: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

apps.name: The Futa Alchemist
apps.short_description: A failed experiment leaves witch-alchemist Francesca with a very unexpected new body (FUTA). With her assistant Darci by her side, she searches for a way to change back but the more she experiences her new self, the less certain she becomes that she actually wants to.

apps.name: The Games You Make
apps.short_description: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

apps.name: The Harbinger of the Deep
apps.short_description: Destroy the frustrations of other Beings and befriend them, or ignore them and slay them all instead! Shoot your actions and decide the fate of this submerged world in The Harbinger of the Deep!

apps.name: The Haunted Archives
apps.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror, set in the 2000s. Break into abandoned places with one camera and limited tape. Dangerous footage earns more views, but recording something can make it react. Film it, survive it, get out. There are ALWAYS secrets to be found.

apps.name: The Hero's Legacy
apps.short_description: A hardcore co-op action RPG in pixel art: play solo, online, on LAN or in 4-player split-screen couch co-op. Dodge bullet-hell bosses, hunt loot and 6-link gear, and build your hero on a huge passive tree. Permadeath: every hero has one life, but your family keeps its Legacy.

apps.name: The Infinite Tower
apps.short_description: A challenging action roguelite for 1-4 players. Battle bosses with raid-style teamwork and 2D platforming, build around 16 unusual heroes, and survive arenas that fight back. Climb alone or bring three friends. The Tower has a wish to grant.

apps.name: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall
apps.short_description: Run the last shop on the road to Kingsfall in this cozy first-person medieval shop sim. Stock your shelves, set your prices and outfit the heroes who pass through. They have names. Out there, they can die for good. What you sell them decides who comes back.

apps.name: The Liar King
apps.short_description: A roguelite of dice and bluffs. Call how many dice are on the table, shout LIAR! and lift the cups. Every reveal you win pays out: Chips × Mult, amulets that chain together and numbers that go through the roof. Eight kingdoms, eight cheating kings, one crown for whoever lies best.

apps.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
apps.short_description: The Light in the Darkness: Director’s Cut is a free narrative game following a Polish-Jewish family living in Nazi-occupied France.

apps.name: The Night We Met
apps.short_description: Live a wild Halloween night with Alex, Anna, and Sierra across four Acts. Flirt, play an intense Truth or Dare, and shape the story with meaningful choices. Unlock 12 unique endings and experience all the fun, and consequences, of your actions.

apps.name: THE NOM MUST BE FED
apps.short_description: A solarpunk arcade game where you harvest fruit creatures to feed NOM. Aim with your mouse, collect pulp and upgrade your ship. Pulp also pays for new equipment, so you need to split your harvest between upgrades and NOM’s food.

apps.name: The Obsidian Sun
apps.short_description: The Obsidian Sun is a 2D action RPG inspired by Aztec/Mexica and Maya cultures. Help a struggling town, master combat and gathering skills, uncover hidden oaths, and defeat corrupted guardians beneath a shattered sun.

apps.name: The Omega Strain
apps.short_description: Pilot your ship through fully explorable polygon worlds, battle colossal alien war machines, and save humanity from The Omega Strain. Featuring endless Simulation Mode and powered by RetroMesh — a custom engine built to push retro 3D beyond the limits of the 1990s.

apps.name: The Orphaned House
apps.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

apps.name: The Perfect Part
apps.short_description: Program a CNC mill like a puzzle: pick the steps, the tools and their order, press CYCLE START and watch the spindle cut real geometry in a soft clay workshop. Then the inspector measures your part against the drawing.

apps.name: The Podcaster
apps.short_description: 🎙️ The Podcaster is a simulator where you manage your schedule, interview guests, and expand and customize your studio. Use topic cards to spark conversations and guide unique interviews. Grow your channel and rise to the top of the podcasting world!

apps.name: The Real Guest
apps.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

apps.name: The Sea Is Broken
apps.short_description: Sail a cursed, ever-changing sea in this pirate roguelite for 1–4 players. Explore islands, grab loot, upgrade your ship, and battle bizarre enemies. Work together to steer, fire cannons, and patch holes. Someone should probably grab a bucket.

apps.name: The Sower of Kingdom
apps.short_description: Ravaged by war, the kingdom's population is on the brink of collapse. Embodying the "Chosen Stallion," you wander between the countryside and the royal court, sowing seeds with women to preserve the bloodline. Fill the desolation with new life and rebuild the empire to its former glory!

apps.name: THE SPINNER
apps.short_description: Spin. Strike. Break. THE SPINNER is a fast-paced 1v1 action game built around rotating paddles and warp zones. Create unexpected angles, outplay your opponent with spin-powered shots, and break through their defenses to strike the Core.

apps.name: The Startling: The Witch of Startling Woods
apps.short_description: Four friends venture into America’s most haunted woods for a fall fishing trip. As they settle into camp, it becomes clear they are not alone. Experience a first-person horror story set deep in the Startling Woods, where getting lost is the least of your worries.

apps.name: The Symbiant II
apps.short_description: The Symbiant II is a BL-Yaoi-Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

apps.name: The Talos Principle 3
apps.short_description: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

apps.name: The Third Seal
apps.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

apps.name: The Timekeeper
apps.short_description: A third-person puzzle platformer set in a beautiful, engaging world. Players will learn how to carry and shift colors to solve puzzles.

apps.name: THE UNWRITTEN: Shadows of Iga
apps.short_description: 1581. Iga burns. Kirimaru, a seventeen-year-old shinobi who survived, slips through the last years of the Sengoku era as a shadow who leaves no name — from the fall of Iga through Honnoji to Sekigahara. A retro, NES-style ninja RPG where every general leads thousands of troops into battle.

apps.name: The Voss Clinic
apps.short_description: A psychiatric hospital. 1986. The staff are dead. The doors are open. You have no memory of how you got here or why your name is on a patient file. No monsters. No combat. Only the silence of empty corridors, and the slow realization of what was done to you.

apps.name: The Washing Case
apps.short_description: Relax and wash years of grime off antique objects, layer by layer, until they shine. Along the way, look for the marks hidden under the dirt: together they form a code that opens the next room. The further you go, the bigger the objects get – from pocket watches to giant monuments.

apps.name: The Wife Next Door - She Drains Me While Her Husband's Away
apps.short_description:
We were just neighbors who exchanged a few words――or so I thought.

One day, while her husband was away, she made a bold move on me.

I knew it was wrong, but I couldn't resist her temptation...

And so begins our secret affair whenever her husband's away――.

apps.name: The Wings of Dawn
apps.short_description: The Wings of Dawn is an open world survival game either survive as a dragon or thrive as a human. The wildlife having evolved entirely differently to anywhere on earth will pose a challenge to everyone. Do what it takes to survive the day and make sure to be in shelter at night.

apps.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
apps.short_description: A neon-noir thriller where Bigby Wolf must confront the monster within that threatens the future of Fabletown.

apps.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
apps.short_description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

apps.name: THE WRONG WAY
apps.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

apps.name: TheDuckening
apps.short_description: Grab a loaf of bread and fight back! The Duckening is a chaotic bullet-heaven where a duck battles endless waves of monsters, unlocks a growing arsenal of weapons, and faces down unique bosses every 20 waves.

apps.name: They Are Rising
apps.short_description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

apps.name: Thieves and Tasers
apps.short_description: A fast-paced PvP heist game for 3–6 players. Work together as Thieves to sneak and steal loot, or hunt down your friends as Guards. Tasers included.

apps.name: Thornline TD
apps.short_description: A maze tower defense where you build the path. Your towers are the walls, and the enemy walks the long way around. Play online with up to eight people and send units into each other's mazes to grow your income, or play fifty solo levels across ten worlds. Every new world changes how you build.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms Heroic Tales
apps.short_description: Choose your protagonist from over 450 officers and freely assemble your party in this Three Kingdoms RPG × conquest strategy game. Develop your officers, combine gear, sub-commanders, and formations, and conquer all 88 castles in an ever-changing age of war. Who becomes a hero is up to you.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms Online
apps.short_description:
Real-time Three Kingdoms strategy. No turns. No waiting.
Domestic affairs, diplomacy, court politics, war — all of it runs at once.
Up to 8 players in one world. Bring your friends. Lose the night.
Write a new history of the Three Kingdoms.

apps.name: Three-Body: Eve of Judgment
apps.short_description: Officially licensed by the Three-Body Universe — a narrative adventure. Board the mysterious Judgment Day and infiltrate the ETO: hide your identity, tell friend from foe, and survive a perilous rescue by any means. As humanity's golden age ends, only the choice before you is your fate.

apps.name: Thrice Entombed
apps.short_description:
Your tomb has been raided and your treasure stolen, so it's time for revenge! 
Push blocks to crush enemies, solve puzzles, and level up.
Recover your treasure to permanently restore your ancient strength.
Inspired by the early 1980's arcade coin-op, Pengo.

apps.name: TIC.EXE
apps.short_description: Three in a row is not a win — it is a discharge. A tactical grid roguelite: fight hostile processes on a shifting board, build an engine out of 30 modules, and clear eight sectors before the machine answers its own launch request.

apps.name: TIDE OR HIDE
apps.short_description: Three minutes of daylight. Ninety seconds of night. TIDE OR HIDE is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where the deep water guarding your camp drains away every night - zone by zone - and armed hunters come for what you stockpiled. Gather, arm up, and hold until dawn.

apps.name: Tidemark
apps.short_description: Tidemark is a dice-driven, turn-based party roguelike. Roll for action points, choose who acts and who to target, and merge matching skills into stronger versions. Position your team across two rows, chart a route through three rising tides, and defend the crossing before its walls fall.

apps.name: Tidy Bakery
apps.short_description:
Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰

Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

apps.name: Tidy Tech
apps.short_description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

apps.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup
apps.short_description: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.

apps.name: Tidy Up Mall
apps.short_description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

apps.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
apps.short_description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls of 21 real ancient alphabets back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, where every cat wants a toy: find it to get the scroll it guards! Play solo, or tidy up together in online co-op and split screen!

apps.name: Tie Down
apps.short_description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

apps.name: Tile Farmer
apps.short_description: Build a thriving farm, one tile at a time. Grow crops, raise livestock, upgrade tractors, and expand your land in this pixel-art farming management game. Balance costs, crop rotation, and loans as you turn a small plot into a profitable operation.

apps.name: Tile Former
apps.short_description: Tile Former is a 1-bit puzzle game where the color palette dictates the mechanics. You need to transform the world in various ways and use the palettes at your disposal to solve the puzzles.

apps.name: Tiles of the Nadirat
apps.short_description: A traditional roguelike where every step changes your build. Collect permanent stats, trigger item combos with movement patterns, and master classes, that change how you value tiles. Fight your way up to an duel with the creator of the Nadirat and uncover its lore through koan based riddles.

apps.name: Timepaths
apps.short_description: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode and infinite levels.

apps.name: TinSpring Soccer
apps.short_description:
TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten
authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a
floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person,
full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

apps.name: Tiny Kopitiam
apps.short_description: Tiny Kopitiam is a cozy management sim inspired by Southeast Asian coffee shops. Build your dream shop, hire staffs, then jump inside as the boss. Sit back, relax and watch your dream kopitiam come alive.

apps.name: Tiny Night Market
apps.short_description: A tiny night market lives right above your taskbar. While you work, the stalls cook, sell and grow on their own. When you have a minute, help out at the stalls, toss a few rings, fill regulars' orders and wait for rare visitors — and watch one candied-hawthorn cart grow into a glowing street.

apps.name: Tiny Ring Defense
apps.short_description: A desktop idle defense game that keeps going while you work. Monsters circle a ring around your board and your pixel heroes fight them on their own. Summon, merge and level up heroes, forge weapons, and push through ten worlds at your own pace.

apps.name: TOKYO WANTED
apps.short_description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

apps.name: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics
apps.short_description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

apps.name: Too Much Baggage
apps.short_description: Ever wonder where your bags go after check-in? In Too Much Baggage, keeping the airport moving is your problem. Build and expand a network of belts, route bags through security, and adapt as your airport grows. How long can you keep the world’s baggage flowing?

apps.name: Total Neuroscience
apps.short_description: A complete neuroscience study app with two bonus games. Drill every topic from the membrane to the clinic — then run a neuron as a factory, where the same cell biology keeps the line moving.

apps.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
apps.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

apps.name: Totally Normal Ramen
apps.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

apps.name: Touchline Capital
apps.short_description: Touchline Capital is an emergent football business simulation where you run an agency rather than a club. Scout and sign players, assign agents, arrange moves, build commercial value, invest in projects, and expand into new markets around the world.

apps.name: Touwers
apps.short_description: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

apps.name: Towers of Ruin
apps.short_description: A roguelite tower defense with 36 mythic towers. Pick cards each run, evolve your towers, counter armored waves and hold out for 30 minutes until four final bosses arrive. Then draw your own maps in the built-in editor.

apps.name: TrackBlitz
apps.short_description: Three minutes, one track, your best lap counts. Compete against the world on 60 unique tracks with incredible variation. Race your friends and beat their times, climb regional leaderboards and become number one. Customize your car with endless options and show off your awesome ride to the world!

apps.name: Traha
apps.short_description: Traha Global is RvR MMORPG based on the confrontation between two major factions. You can play multiple roles, create unique builds of your character based on unlimited class transition system. Based on vast open world, you can go on adventures in various regions, get items through raid dungeons.
developers: XIAN SKY ONLINE NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD
publishers: XIAN SKY ONLINE NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD

apps.name: Train 404
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

apps.name: Train Goes Right
apps.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

apps.name: Train of Thought
apps.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

apps.name: Trains Together
apps.short_description: Trains Together is a relaxing cargo railway builder. Build your train empire, starting with small steps - lay tracks, transport goods and refine the routes as they transform into a dense, optimized system. Play with your friends or solo!

apps.name: Trajectory:Rumble
apps.short_description: A turn-based artillery brawl starring cats. Aim bombs, crossbows and boomerangs by hand, stack 100+ augments to flip the match, and fight 1v1 to 3v3 online or climb a co-op Expedition in a party of up to 3.

apps.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
apps.short_description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

apps.name: Trees Hate You
apps.short_description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

apps.name: TRENCHWORMS
apps.short_description: Dig, swing and blast through real-time worm battles. Choose from 26 weapons and fight on destructible maps or rope-focused arenas. Play a 15 mission campaign, battle bots, share a keyboard, connect 2-6 controllers, or take up to six players online.

apps.name: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
apps.short_description:
In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it.
Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: 
find out how this story truly ended.

apps.name: Trials of Mary
apps.short_description: Survive 4 deadly trials inspired by classic horror. As Mary, solve environmental puzzles and outsmart hunters through strategic evasion and self-defense in this cinematic journey. A psychological horror experience where vulnerability and high tension reach their peak awaits you.

apps.name: Trick Or Terror
apps.short_description:
Welcome to Lilith's Curse. In this game, you're trapped in an asylum: your goal is to find items, solve puzzles, and escape.
Watch out for the enemy: Lilith. Lilith will do everything she can to stop you. If she succeeds, there will be very serious consequences.

apps.name: Tripartite: Magical Engineering
apps.short_description: The defense of the castle is up to you. Build your own network of roads and towers and discover the magical combos necessary to defend your home, all while training soldiers and siege weapons to bring the fight back to the enemy. Capture their castles before they capture yours!

apps.name: Trolley Problem Is Not Problem
apps.short_description: A trolley-problem roguelite where everything you hit becomes a train car. Pull the lever, grow your train, plow through five tracks at once, and ram giant bosses with everything you've coupled.

apps.name: TRONADO
apps.short_description: Parents versus kids in a house full of chaos! Play TRONADO with 2-10 players online, up to 2 in split-screen, or solo against bots. Cause mischief, finish chores and use proximity voice chat. Unlock cosmetics by playing: no real-money purchases.

apps.name: Tropico 7
apps.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

apps.name: Truck Parking Simulator
apps.short_description: Discover your skills to park a trailer.

apps.name: Truck World: Australia
apps.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

apps.name: Tsukuyomi's Wrath
apps.short_description: A samurai souls-like from Japanese folklore. Chase your sister's kidnappers from Kyoto to the moon god's court at sea, with the twinblade she forged and the water a dying Kappa gave it. Turn the river on the regime's guards and bring down yokai like Wanyūdō, the burning wheel.

apps.name: Tuanbot
apps.short_description: Create desktop companions, discover little stories in Tuan House, and enjoy playful moments with Feihuahua. Link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts. This free TuanBot demo supports up to 3 companions and does not include AI chat.

apps.name: Tumbledown
apps.short_description: The floor falls away under your feet! Up to 8 players shove each other into the lava on tiles that crack the moment you step on them. Last one standing wins the round. Play online through Steam or on LAN, with friends or bots.

apps.name: Tung Tung Tung Together
apps.short_description: Tung Tung Tung Together is a co-op (1–4 players) survival horror set 10 years after Tung Tung Tung Survival. On the 1 km × 1 km Little Sahur Island, find items to repair your boat and escape while being hunted by the relentless Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

apps.name: Turnflower
apps.short_description:
Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects!
With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.

apps.name: Turok 2: Rok Match
apps.short_description: Turok 2: Rok Match is a fan-made remaster of the 1999 game build made with Assembly, HEX, C++ and Delphi without having any of the source code or official tools. The goal is to save maximum from original game but make it better, as if done by the original developers.

apps.name: Turok: Origins
apps.short_description: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

apps.name: Twilight Imperium Digital
apps.short_description: Dominate the galaxy in the legendary strategy board game, now available digitally. Choose your faction and fight to claim the Imperial Throne!

apps.name: Twilight Requiem
apps.short_description: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.

apps.name: Type For Speed
apps.short_description: Your keyboard is the gas pedal. Type to accelerate, chain clean words into combos and nitro, and race friends or bots across neon retro tracks. Or survive the endless highway, where one crash ends the run. 10 languages, each typed in its own script.

apps.name: Tzark - The First Rift
apps.short_description: TZARK: The First Rift is a dark fantasy RPG with strategic dice-based combat, character collection and permanent progression. Enter the Rifts, face increasing Torment levels, earn equipment and strengthen your heroes. Roll the dice and challenge fate!

apps.name: Ukraine Under Fire
apps.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

apps.name: Ultrapolis
apps.short_description: A cyberpunk city diorama with millions of possible buildings. No city management between you and pure layout and design.

apps.name: Um Al-Saaf
apps.short_description: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?

apps.name: Unbox Super Card
apps.short_description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

apps.name: Undead Showdown
apps.short_description: Four squads. Ten zombie rounds. One team left standing. Hold your stronghold against the horde while rival squads snipe through the windows. Die during survival for one shot at a 1v1 arcade duel in Limbo to fight your way back. Build your loadout, upgrade your guns, gamble for power.

apps.name: UnderCarrier
apps.short_description: A washed-up shock-jock laughs off one last caller, and his fog-choked mill town slides into Hell. Undercarrier is a fast, loud first-person shooter: arena fights at full speed, small-town fog and dread, a roguelite run carried from map to map, and a radio that hears what's coming.

apps.name: Undermoon
apps.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

apps.name: Undertaker
apps.short_description:
The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns.
As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary.
Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

apps.name: Undervein
apps.short_description: Deep under the mountain there is a seam that never runs dry, a crew of dwarves who will mine it while you sleep, and a door covered in runes that nobody has opened. Click. Build. Descend. And be ready when the mountain's wrath wakes.

apps.name: UnderWorldMMORPG
apps.short_description: UNDERWORLD MMORPG is an open-world MMORPG focused on immersion and freedom. Talk to NPCs via microphone, become a dragon in the Dragon World, and level up professions in mini-games. Craft items in an evolving forge where skill defines quality. A living world where your choices shape your journey.

apps.name: Unholy Maiden
apps.short_description:
"Unholy Maiden" is a multi ending RPG. Amnesiac girl Atra ventures alone into an underground city overflowing with desire, seeking to reclaim her stolen memories.
Freely develop her character with over 20 branching endings.
Your choices decide whether she finds salvation or descends into ruin.

apps.name: Unscrew Therapy
apps.short_description: A relaxing ASMR puzzle with 500 hand-drawn levels. Unscrew metal pieces, enjoy satisfying sounds, and watch them fall. No timers, no pressure — just pure unscrewing satisfaction.

apps.name: Untold Cases - Stillwater Lake
apps.short_description: Inspired by true events. A suspicious disappearance at Stillwater Lake is quickly ruled an accident. Relying on scattered notes and your radio, explore the restricted zones to uncover her final hours. You must survive a ruthless local cult determined to keep their dark secrets hidden.

apps.name: Unwalkable
apps.short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character.  Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

apps.name: Upwardly
apps.short_description: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer built for climbers and speedrunners! Master challenging jumps, conquer 10 castles across a 5,000-meter climb, and race against your best times. Explore randomized courses or challenge friends to beat your time on identical seeded runs.

apps.name: ur round
apps.short_description: run a small british pub with up to 4 friends. pull pints, chop fruit, shake dodgy cocktails, and boot the troublemakers out through the window. the bar is small and so are the margins.

apps.name: Vampine: New Order
apps.short_description: Awaken to a world ruled by the Intelligences and reclaim your honor! A turn-based strategy roguelike deckbuilder where you lead a vampire rebellion, bonds powerful servants, craft tactical card decks, and combine unique abilities to outsmart your enemies.

apps.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
apps.short_description: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

apps.name: Vampvasion
apps.short_description:
Beat up Aliens with your Vampire Friends or Solo with plenty of weapons, abilities and minions to resurrect!
Absorb the blood of your enemies to recover health and level up your Vampire powers as you fight through hoards of Alien runts and Bosses. You can also raise bats to raise your stats!

apps.name: Vampy's Big Day
apps.short_description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

apps.name: Velocity - Midnight Run
apps.short_description: Hold speed through an endless night city. Climb a 100-car field in Midnight Run, slip past traffic, shake the cops, and cash every near miss into style. Then take it to Solo, private Crew rooms, or Online matchmaking. An arcade night-driving racer built for one more run.

apps.name: Very Disco, Disco Very!
apps.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

apps.name: Vexlands
apps.short_description: Vexlands is a realm of surprises. Every newly opened space brings a surprise: loot, resources, dungeons, monsters and disasters! Build your village where you craft new equipment before you explore uncharted areas, and find relics that explain who came before and why these lands are cursed.

apps.name: Vida:Unslain
apps.short_description: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

apps.name: Vinash: Vengeance
apps.short_description: Deep in the heart of rural India lies a village choked by the shadow of a Baer empire. Vinash, Returning home after ten years for personal vendetta, finding himself caught in a brutal struggle to liberate his people from the iron grip of the gangster Baer and a past that refuses to stay buried.

apps.name: Void Frontier
apps.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

apps.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite
apps.short_description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

apps.name: Voidshift
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game about working the night shift in a store that reacts to your mistakes. Follow procedure. Avoid irregularities.

apps.name: Voltwood
apps.short_description: Voltwood is a competitive mazing tower defense with procedurally generated maps. You can't beat waves — hit par or pay. The better you do the higher your score. Compete on daily and weekly maps and a roguelike weekly gauntlet, check the boards to see who built the best maze or chill in casual mode.

apps.name: Voxmons
apps.short_description: Hatch eggs, collect voxel creatures and lead them into battle. Your Voxmons orbit you in living rings, pick their own targets and fight for you while you explore. Cross floating islands, unlock rare Large and Huge forms, and build the squad that clears everything in its path.

apps.name: VOXTOPOLIS
apps.short_description: VOXTOPOLIS is an action-adventure RPG in endless worlds of tiny blocks! Explore towns and cities, complete quests, and unlock abilities to tackle dungeons and bosses. Master dodges and parries in combat. Break terrain for blocks and use building tools to reshape the world. Play solo or with friends!

apps.name: VVV
apps.short_description:
Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!!  
Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time.  
Roguelite × 3D Action  
Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

apps.name: W.A.M
apps.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

apps.name: Wacky Coursers
apps.short_description: Wacky Coursers is a chaotic parkour racing game where you run, jump, shrink, smash, flip gravity 🙃, fly with wings 🪽, and get launched through surprise tubes 🌀. Race solo or online—and laugh your way to the finish! 🏁😄

apps.name: WAKABOOM
apps.short_description: Claw Machine × Roguelike. Magical creatures turned stolen souls into dolls and opened a mysterious shop for fun. Grab cute dolls, build your doll pool, install components, choose upgrades, and stack effects to deal huge damage. Defeat Bosses and unlock new characters and stories.

apps.name: Waking Adrift
apps.short_description: You and your crew are on a one way mission to reach the edge of space, but something sinister is lurking in the halls.

apps.name: Walpurgis
apps.short_description: A tactical, narrative card game full of difficult choices. Cast spells in secret to protect the inhabitants of a village or sacrifice them for powerful dark rituals. Keep demonic forces at bay while you explore a deep dark forest to search for your missing mentor. What fate will befall the village?

apps.name: Wandering The Corridors
apps.short_description: Walk through an endless corridor and look for anomalies. Observe every detail, remember what you see, and discover what has changed before moving forward.

apps.name: War of the Watchers
apps.short_description: A dark-fantasy action-adventure in 3D. Walk the roads of a fallen heaven as Seravion, the last bearer of the Halo, and face keepers who fight like gods. Defeat them, and bind them. In this war, nothing is slain. Everything is sealed.

apps.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator
apps.short_description: Warehouse Chaos Simulator is a satisfying warehouse organization simulation game where you sort identical products into boxes, organize shelves by category, and unlock skills to optimize your workflow.

apps.name: Warhammer Blood Bowl
apps.short_description:
Strap on your boots. Tighten your helmet. 
Then step onto the pitch and prepare to settle your differences the old-fashioned way: with touchdowns, broken bones and a rabid crowd screaming for violence. This is Warhammer Blood Bowl!

apps.name: Warhammer Survivors
apps.short_description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

apps.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
apps.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

apps.name: Warped Worlds: Quest for Wonder
apps.short_description: When the water in cozy, boring Blandia starts to vanish, a wonder-seeking farmpaw named Lark may be the Wonderverse's only hope. Help Lark and their avian pal Koo-Kee find their way in a heartfelt, hand-drawn RPG where the Quest for Wonder begins right outside your door.

apps.name: Wartide
apps.short_description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

apps.name: Wasteland Hearts ❤️‍🔥
apps.short_description: Taryn’s world is made of barren wastelands, abandoned bunkers and dirty cities. She’s conquered every dark corner, and no good pussy can hide from her. Once she catches the scent of a sexy ass, she’s unstoppable and there is nowhere to hide! Taryn’s coming, and lucky for her lovers, she cums last!

apps.name: Way Too Many Fish!
apps.short_description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

apps.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
apps.short_description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

apps.name: We Dig the Moon
apps.short_description: A mining adventure for 1–4 players. Stranded on the Moon, dig for valuable ores, upgrade your gear, and repair your ship. Fight hungry creatures, uncover alien secrets, and answer to a sarcastic corporate AI. Your survival matters. The company's profit matters more.

apps.name: We Kill Monsters
apps.short_description: We Kill Monsters is a solo or co-op adventure set in a mysterious and massive pit. You are a Husk of Edinu, homunculi created to explore the depths and kill Angels.

apps.name: Welcome to Harmony
apps.short_description: Build your timeline, adapt your strategy, and execute your plan to survive the town of Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

apps.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
apps.short_description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

apps.name: What Da Font
apps.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

apps.name: What Hides in Dreams
apps.short_description: To the now sleeping self...welcome back. Face the horrors only a sleeping mind can conjure in this first-person psychological horror adventure where dreams become reality and death leaves a permanent scar.

apps.name: What The Dog Remembers
apps.short_description: A retro-style psychological horror roguelike. Survive a week in a claustrophobic trailer, spot reality-breaking anomalies, and document your findings. Permadeath, limited energy and time: every mistake can end the run. Your dog knows.

apps.name: Wheatstead
apps.short_description: Your harvest may fight back. Farm, battle crop monsters, and turn raw materials into bread, paper, and chocolate. Link fields and factories with conveyors, pipes, and machines. Play solo or cooperate over LAN or a direct host connection.

apps.name: Whiskers of Yesterday
apps.short_description: You’re a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

apps.name: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
apps.short_description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

apps.name: Whisper Shift Pale Wing
apps.short_description: Something in Pale Wing Institute is counting down from five. Hide before it hits zero, but don't trust the count. As reporter Rey Hestflame, scavenge weapons, solve puzzles, and fight your way to the truth about the missing victims.

apps.name: White Christmas
apps.short_description: Multiplayer for up to 16 players: roll ever-growing snowballs, build snowmen and start snowball fights. Explore a snowy village with a Christmas market, go sledding, ice skating or ice fishing. A cozy winter sandbox you can also play solo.

apps.name: Wickwood
apps.short_description: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

apps.name: Wilderwake
apps.short_description: A 2D pixel-art action-adventure about bringing a dead world back to life. Crush fruit to make the ground bloom and its animals return. Explore a large inter-connected world full of secrets, and use a powerful gauntlet to fight crystal creatures and restore the four giant machines that've taken over.

apps.name: Wildhearth
apps.short_description: Wildhearth is a Norse medieval-fantasy open world MMORPG. You wake as a stranger on a cold northern island. The town gives you an anthro wife to share it with. Hunt bosses at her side, or build a home and farm. Your skills rise as you use them. You choose how to live.

apps.name: Will it Stand?
apps.short_description: Disaster strikes! With a limited budget, build structures, mechanisms, and defenses to protect your beaver from earthquakes, floods, mudslides, meteors, and enemy attacks. Brace, absorb, divert, defend—there is no single answer. If it is still standing when the disaster is over, it worked.

apps.name: Wiltcards
apps.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

apps.name: Wind and Cannon
apps.short_description: Wind and Cannon is a top-down naval roguelite about sailing farther, fighting harder, and seeing how long your captain can survive. Hunt pirates and sharks, fish, trade, upgrade your ship, and push into dangerous waters before the sea finally takes you.

apps.name: Wind's Heartbeat
apps.short_description: In this semi-open world, cozy horse game, form a deep bond with your horse while you explore, forage, and craft. Using training techniques and knowledge passed down through the ages, tame a wild horse to ride through and discover the land's rich natural history in 1800s Idaho.

apps.name: Witchbrook
apps.short_description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

apps.name: Witchcrafter: Empire Legends
apps.short_description: A systemic immersive sim, dark fantasy slavic metroidvania RPG where you are a young witchcrafter striving to control his power of 4 elements on a journey to find a mythical fifth one and save his father. Your decisions count in this branching, thought-provoking story set in a vivid, murky world.

apps.name: Witches & Fairy Tails
apps.short_description: An arcade reveal game following a coven of seductive witches on a mission to collect the vital 'essence' of magical creatures—with their own hands, or any other part of their body. Enjoy light story dialogues, tackle reflex challenges, and unlock spicy animated scenes.

apps.name: Witch’s Cottage: Tidy Up the Potions!
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game with magical upgrades. Sort over 3,000 potions in a four-storey witch’s cottage. Find matching bottles, complete sets and unlock spells that summon potions to your hands and send them onto shelves. Turn a magical mess into a collection worth admiring.

apps.name: Wizard of Maths
apps.short_description: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

apps.name: Wok in Another World
apps.short_description: A top-down action game meets hands-on restaurant management. A hot-tempered master chef wakes up as a catgirl in another world. Loot monster ingredients in the dungeon with your partners, then run your diner yourself: toss the wok, research recipes, forge gear and open a snack stall underground!

apps.name: Wok King
apps.short_description: You and your friends run a Chinese restaurant in a cherry blossom town on an island. You travel to various places to purchase different quality ingredients, frantically completing orders in the kitchen, riding an e-bike to deliver the delicacies to customers, striving to become the wok king!

apps.name: Wolf Plot
apps.short_description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

apps.name: Wolfbane
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy werewolf action RPG focused on exploration, hunting, and brutal melee combat. Hunt enemies, grow stronger in human and beast form, and explore a cursed medieval world filled with secrets and hunters.

apps.name: Wonderdrift
apps.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

apps.name: Wookland
apps.short_description: Build your dream festival in this management sim, then do it for 45,000. Every wook is simulated, from their rave fam to their bladder.
