Zone the campgrounds, book the stages, staff the gates and keep a crowd that moves like a fluid from crushing itself. Keep the wooks alive.

apps.name: World Estate
apps.short_description: Buy a worn flat, do it up, furnish it room by room and let it to a household that lives its own day in it. Then do it again, across seven cities, each with its own market, bank and mood. A relaxed property tycoon game in toy-like 3D cities.

apps.name: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
apps.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Worm In Space
apps.short_description: Worm adventure continues in space station. Avoid traps and collect stars in this third person walking adventure game and avoid traps

apps.name: Worst Class Ever
apps.short_description: This is a fun 1-6 player asymmetric party game! Five player are mischievous troublemakers，hide among dozens of NPC students to sneak snacks, pass secret notes, and use phones secretly in class. One player acts as a strict teacher, track down all hidden troublemakers in the crowd.

apps.name: Worth the Cost
apps.short_description:
A choice-driven sandbox visual novel where college, family, money, and ambition collide. Explore
the world, build relationships, complete quests, and decide how far you're willing to go to create the
life you want.

apps.name: Wrestle Bounce Online
apps.short_description: Hold. Release. BONK! A one-button ragdoll physics wrestling game where the first head to hit the mat loses. Duel a friend on one keyboard, beat the AI, win tournaments or take on real players online for coin prizes. Easy to learn, impossible to play without laughing.

apps.name: Wretched
apps.short_description: Wretched is a turn-based tactical game focused on strategic positioning, skill combinations and devastating attacks. Play as an ancient being of immense power. Move into range, kick enemies away and slip behind others. Chain your skills and make every turn count.

apps.name: Writificer: Typing the Classics
apps.short_description: Improve your typing while reading masterpieces. Follow in the footsteps of the greats: Shakespeare, Dickens, Poe, and much more.

apps.name: Wuilsafe
apps.short_description: Wuilsafe is a simple yet engaging world-exploration game that offers a unique gameplay experience.

apps.name: Wyrm Warrior
apps.short_description: WYRM WARRIOR is a brand new JRPG in retro style. Step into the shoes of a hero fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, NPCs, and loot! Grow stronger through fighting and exploration! Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

apps.name: X-Force Genesis 2
apps.short_description: Chaos returns to space! Pilot different ships through 12 intense stages, dodge hundreds of projectiles, battle gigantic bosses and strengthen your firepower with upgrades and power-ups in this shmup inspired by the classics of the 80s and 90s.

apps.name: XENO DEAD
apps.short_description:
XENO DEAD is a fast-paced FPS tinged with a melancholic atmosphere.
After aliens have come to the planet Earth to siphon its resources, the humans decide it best to call in their strongest weapon... you, the Assassin.

apps.name: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
apps.short_description:
“XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution.
Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

apps.name: Yaku Slap
apps.short_description: 🎴 Yaku Slap – A rogue-like card battler where you duel monsters, master Hanafuda combos, and slap down the perfect hand! Unlock new perks, and classes as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a Yaku Master! 🌸

apps.name: Yathsel
apps.short_description: Yathsel is a Wild West dice roguelite: play crooked Yahtzee-style hands, sneak loaded artifact dice from the smuggler under the table, and cheat your way past gunslinging rivals in a solo campaign, quick duels, and online saloons with ranked 1v1 for up to 8 players.

apps.name: YOGRAK — the long way down
apps.short_description: The world was ending, until Yograk's nap did. Play YOGRAK, LICH SUPREME. Battle endless hordes of demons, trolls, and piranha-mancers. Unlock 9 characters, armaments, doctrines, relics, and demonic candies. Freeze time. Unfold the FRACTAL DOMAIN. Your disciples are waiting.

apps.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
apps.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

apps.name: Zero G Nova Adventure
apps.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

apps.name: Zero League
apps.short_description: Zero League - a cosmic football sim with vast real world tactics, trading and business environments. Sign players with celestial lore, dictate your formation in the midst of temporal disarray, and watch every match on an interactive 2D pitch impacted by galactic weather events.

apps.name: ZERO VISIBILITY
apps.short_description: Survive one day at a time in a fog-drowned American town overrun by the dead. Scavenge for supplies, get back to base before dark, take in survivors and hold off night raids. Every sound draws them closer. Find five fragments of research data to learn what happened here.

apps.name: Zeverland
apps.short_description: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!

apps.name: Zippy the Circle
apps.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, 3D polygonal rendered action adventure video game in the Zippy the Circle franchise!

apps.name: Zodiac Legion
apps.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

apps.name: ZodiacLottery
apps.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

apps.name: ZombieBusters: Reborn
apps.short_description: Five heroes. One relentless zombie king. Outsmart the hunt in a 5-vs-1 survival MOBA: survive, hunt zombies, break towers or pass the curse. Play either side with AI, or invite Steam friends to a private match for up to six players. Four maps. Fast decisions.

apps.name: Zomking
apps.short_description: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.

apps.name: いただきバーガー
apps.short_description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: かなり里予王求 Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
apps.short_description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

apps.name: きらめきクイズ 星見ヶ丘ダイアリー
apps.short_description: A Japanese-language quiz game with a dating-sim twist.  Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines with 5,000+ questions. NOTE: This game is in Japanese only. No English text or voice-over.

apps.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
apps.short_description: Your doodle is your fighter! Draw a character and watch it brawl in a knockout-style party fighter. Its size, shape and colours decide its stats and one of 30 elemental skills. Play up to 4 on one screen, battle the CPU, or climb the online ranked Colosseum against doodles from around the world.

apps.name: カラーリコレクション
apps.short_description: A near-future drama ADV where you decide the fate of faulty automatons. As a doll artisan, gather keywords from dialogue and solve color-mixing puzzles. Your reports tip the balance between respecting emotion and correcting it, branching to multiple endings. Holographic UI, chill vibes.

apps.name: クレアラ・セレクト
apps.short_description: Creara is a spider woman with eight distinct personalities, held captive in a military facility. Investigate her biology over seven days and choose her fate in this biological-investigation romance adventure.

apps.name: ナニワアンダーグラウンド
apps.short_description: Earn a living while interacting with a cast of eccentric citizens, enjoy leisurely activities like fishing and gathering, or even dabble in crime—the choice is yours. This is a life simulation set in a modern-day Osaka where law and order have collapsed.

apps.name: フォーチュリア：交易路の開拓者
apps.short_description: Set sail in *Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers*, a dice-driven board game × trading strategy adventure. Roll the dice, trade goods, build your fortune, and compete with rival captains for global dominance in a world that changes every time you play.

apps.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
apps.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

apps.name: マニ車
apps.short_description:
A mani wheel is a Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheel said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture when spun.

Arrange letters, spin the wheel, accumulate Virtue and Mercy, and reincarnate again and again. Discover powerful interactions and find your own path to enlightenment.

apps.name: 传传回收公司
apps.short_description: ZZ SALVAGE CO. is a top-down light horror scavenging and extraction game for 1–4 players. Explore abandoned off-world research facilities, recover supplies and objects from old Earth, and face supernatural threats with limited visibility. Search one more room, or escape with your haul?

apps.name: 你的老婆和你妈
apps.short_description: Your wife and your mom have moved onto your desktop. They get hungry, they get tired, they bicker and sulk, and they eat peppers on their own. Plant peppers, fend off worms, launch fireworks — and watch the two of them go about their little lives in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: 修仙刷怪传
apps.short_description: This is an incremental cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

apps.name: 全世界等我开饭！
apps.short_description: The world is waiting for breakfast! Cook local favorites, serve customers, and find your rhythm in the morning rush. Upgrade your equipment, unlock recipes, and discover your regulars’ stories as you bring a little warmth to every stop on your breakfast journey.

apps.name: 勇桜　～Escape from the Empire～
apps.short_description:
A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter.

Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.

apps.name: 四驱车：冠军之路
apps.short_description: A mini 4WD career racer where setup is everything — no driving once the race starts. 75 parts mapped to real physics (no fake buffs), 9 AI rivals playing by exactly your rules, an F1-style 8-round season with sponsors, paddock drama and post-race brawls. Tune, watch, learn, win.

apps.name: 城市派对
apps.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

apps.name: 天坑追匪
apps.short_description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
developers: 浙江华智数媒传媒股份有限公司
publishers: 杭州天阙采样文化传媒有限公司

apps.name: 天書
apps.short_description:
The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path
A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven.
Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny.

Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow.
An epic journey awaits.

The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.

apps.name: 天空，草地，我的小鱼
apps.short_description: A relaxing aquarium sim. Collect fish, build underwater gardens with plants, rocks and driftwood, and enjoy eight changing seasons. Set your aquarium as a live desktop background and let your little fish keep you company.

apps.name: 妖怪温泉旅馆
apps.short_description: Run a small Japanese hot spring inn in the mountains. Arrange rooms, baths, staff and meals, then welcome familiar travelers and nighttime yokai. Listen to their stories, keep memories of the changing seasons and grow humble Yama-no-Yu into a village of your own.

apps.name: 学園バドる！
apps.short_description: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game where girls from different school clubs battle with unique abilities and special moves. Master six types of shots, unleash SP Shots and SP Skills, and play through Story Mode or face the CPU or a friend in Versus Mode.

apps.name: 宗门不养闲人
apps.short_description: Ever wanted to face the beast tides of a cultivation novel? Build a sect, raise disciples, brew elixirs and forge their gear. When hordes besiege your walls, lead the disciples you've nurtured into vast battles to defend the home you've built together.

apps.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
apps.short_description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

apps.name: 寻丹
apps.short_description: The Inner Way is a Five-Element roguelike deckbuilder. Arrange ingredients, harness elemental harmony and conflict, refine your deck, discover powerful builds, and overcome tribulations on your path to ascension.

apps.name: 巫师猫：无尽突围
apps.short_description: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign, Abyss, and Endless modes.

apps.name: 异界碎片
apps.short_description: Otherworld Shards is a xianxia action RPG with floating-island building. Saved by the Core of Shards, you explore void isles, fight in real time, recruit unique Nayin disciples, build your sect and rebuild the broken immortal realm.

apps.name: 文字探し-JP-Not Every Letter Is a Letter
apps.short_description:
A box full of paper scraps — and only 46 are the "correct" hiragana. The rest are katakana, kanji, fakes, and even variant forms.

Match them against the guide and fill the hiragana table. Papers you don't need? Feed them to the goat.

……If it really is a goat.

apps.name: 方寸小家 RoomFolk
apps.short_description: Build your own home in this sandbox game, mix and match a huge selection of furniture and decorations, and design your garden too! Export your creative process as a video and your design as architectural drawings with one click!

apps.name: 无字书
apps.short_description: An AI-driven narrative game . No option buttons, no dialogue trees — say anything, and the characters answer like people, remembering every word. They gossip about you, and the story rewrites itself when you stray. Three complete worlds, no two runs alike. Requires your own AI service API key.

apps.name: 无限循环
apps.short_description: Infinite Loop is an unconventional roguelike bullet-hell idle incremental game. Fight monsters, loot, and level up in an ever-running world of code—your levels, skills, talents, and chips stay forever. No run resets: the longer you play, the stronger you get.

apps.name: 旧存档里的勇者
apps.short_description: A nostalgic pixel action RPG about fighting monsters, chasing loot, and building an adventuring party. Choose a Warrior, Mage, or Archer, explore five regions, follow treasure maps, and grow alongside NPC companions and your guild.

apps.name: 星海余烬：联合舰队
apps.short_description: Take the helm of a ten-thousand-ton flagship and feel it answer to momentum. A 2D real-time space combat game of flagship piloting, fleet command and roguelike growth. Fly the ship yourself, order escorts, refit warships, recruit captains - alone or with three friends over LAN.

apps.name: 星际探索 Star Exploration
apps.short_description: Star Exploration is a sci-fi adventure game that blends survival, tower defense, and farming elements.

apps.name: 暗黑符文：禁忌之源
apps.short_description: Dark Runes: Forbidden Origin - A hardcore ARPG featuring versatile skill runes and classic Rune Words. The time has come to begin your looting legend! Every battle may drop loot that changes your fate, every rune combination can create new legends. Are you ready for the challenge?

apps.name: 月と踊ろう
apps.short_description:
A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. 
As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. 
A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

apps.name: 末日序列：诡域求生
apps.short_description: ELDRITCH SEQUENCE is a Lovecraftian survival RPG that fuses rule-based horror with dungeon crawling. Uncover deadly rules, explore nightmarish dungeons, and fight to survive. Customize your attributes, develop unique builds, and combine powerful skills to forge your own path to survival.

apps.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
apps.short_description: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

apps.name: 树人：中国班主任
apps.short_description:
“十年树木，百年树人”
《树人》是一部班主任视角的视觉小说。三年时光，12 名学生，8 条交错的故事线，和一门真实可学的高中数学课——12 小时以上的流程里，你不只是看完这个故事，你还要带着他们走完高考。
有些事会在开学第一周就摆在你面前，有些要到最后一页才明白：他们的人生，从来不是一道有标准答案的题。

apps.name: 死亡汇报
apps.short_description: Trapped within this cursed enclosed area, you will encounter wandering dead and unexplained supernatural anomalies. Struggle to survive amid successive horrors, and gradually uncover the terrifying secrets long buried beneath this land.

apps.name: 浮块防线
apps.short_description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

apps.name: 海上有座极极岛
apps.short_description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

apps.name: 溪桥志
apps.short_description: Build a village in Song-era China with knowledge from the modern world. Plan homes and workshops, assign villagers, research and trade. Muster a roster of up to 24 soldiers for two three-battle campaigns, then return home to tend your growing settlement.

apps.name: 漢字でポン! ネコ太郎の合体漢字シミュレータ
apps.short_description: A puzzle game where kanji panels fuse with their neighbours to form new characters. Put 木 next to 木 and you get 林; add one more for 森. Work out where to place each piece to build the kanji or the word each stage asks for.

apps.name: 潜梦者
apps.short_description: Dream Divers is a multiplayer co-op adventure game where you dive into dreams. Team up with your friends to explore surreal dream worlds, overcome challenges, evade lurking dangers, uncover deeply buried memories, and make it out in one piece.

apps.name: 火の言伝
apps.short_description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

apps.name: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
apps.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

apps.name: 炼妖录：无相之人
apps.short_description: A first-person deckbuilding roguelite inspired by Chinese folklore. Defeat monsters and refine their souls to claim their abilities as your own. Build powerful combinations, shape your supernatural form, and forge a different playstyle with every expedition.

apps.name: 熊猫喵 Panda vs Meow
apps.short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

apps.name: 猫咪之家 CatHome
apps.short_description: Run your stray cat shelter using a classic slot machine game format.

apps.name: 猫法洗衣房
apps.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

apps.name: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
apps.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

apps.name: 疯狂世界超变
apps.short_description: Mad World Ultra Evolution is a cartoon-style tower defense shooter game. Defend your rear base, face waves of incoming enemies, pick up weapons and keep shooting to fend off assaults.

apps.name: 神祇Pantheon
apps.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

apps.name: 等等！我先升個級！
apps.short_description: Black spores fell with the acid rain, and within three months the city drowned in the dead. You're one of the few still holding a gun: dodge through the horde, grab loot, level up, merge nine items into one back at base, and fight your way to the Cinder Revenant behind it all.

apps.name: 紫灯
apps.short_description: A romance-included story visual novel set amid a late‑19th‑century plague. After contracting the Black Pus Sickness, protagonist Chen Qianyu is sheltered by the mysterious Dr. Xu, and strange events destroy his old life.

apps.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
apps.short_description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

apps.name: 美少女不想让你死
apps.short_description: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a strategic tower defense game with a strategy board game style. In the game, you continuously recruit pretty girl warriors, establish defensive positions by leveraging advantageous terrain, and defeat waves of enemies.

apps.name: 英雄塔防
apps.short_description: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

apps.name: 落叶归根 Climbing Back to the Mothership
apps.short_description: I've spent a lot of time making new friends. Now it's time for them to pay the price.

apps.name: 装甲奇兵
apps.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. 3 crews, 4 stages, 5 difficulties, 765 achievements and permanent vehicle upgrades.

apps.name: 赛博拼豆
apps.short_description: A free, offline bead-crafting game with 40 studio-original patterns, including 10 for Halloween, plus 6 starters. Turn photos into bead guides with background removal, then place beads and iron your work. No ads or in-app purchases. Simplified Chinese interface.

apps.name: 迷你电网
apps.short_description: Build and operate a minimalist power grid across Wuhan. Match voltages, connect riverbanks, manage limited supplies and keep growing demand powered. Plan in Normal mode, handle faults in Hardcore, or experiment with custom settings and hand-drawn maps in Sandbox.

apps.name: 追命战士DreamingFighter
apps.short_description:
DreamingFighter: real-time combat. You can't pick your origin — effort and wit change everything!
Random Characters: even nobodies can rise!
Single-Player Combat: dodge, combo, all out!
Ability Steal × Fortune Wheel: beat foes, take powers!
WorldMap: collect pieces — see full picture!
Chase destiny!

apps.name: 過去でバズってVTuber -2018からならバズれるんじゃ！？
apps.short_description: Time-leap back to 2018 and restart your VTuber career from zero. Fifty-three weeks to go viral. Pull in your own avatar through the OBS / VTube Studio virtual camera and watch yourself stream inside the game. Miss a goal and time rewinds — your skills stay in your muscle memory, run after run.

apps.name: 锁定战机
apps.short_description:
Aiming Fighter is a space-themed shooter that puts you right in the cockpit. Alone against endless enemies, your only lifeline is your lock-on system.
Survival depends on your strategy: choose the right targets to lock-on, build up combos to unleash skills to stay alive!

apps.name: 问题偶像的养成计划
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the private performing arts college full of love and dreams - Xingmengdian~!

The sweat of youth and dreams is sprinkled in every corner of the college. Come and experience a happy and colorful campus life with the idols you meet!

apps.name: 阿飛 AFEI
apps.short_description: A fruit fly in a glass box on a windowsill. Place fruit, tap the glass and watch it walk, eat and fly, across 20 tasks. Its brain is a simplified model built from the published wiring map of a fly's central nervous system. Program assists are labelled. See the model fire on the brain map.

apps.name: 限界ライバー しめきり1週前
apps.short_description:
“Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow!”
VTubers who live by that creed have their backs against the wall, and today they plunge into scheduling hell once again.
Allocate your resources wisely and survive the one week until the deadline. A last-minute, task-crunching roguelite!

apps.name: 驱邪练习生
apps.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

apps.name: 龟龟生存手册
apps.short_description: You’re an ordinary guy who meets nine beautiful women, each with a different background and personality, at a friend’s wedding. You think your happily-ever-after is about to begin—only to discover you’ll be lucky to make it out alive.

apps.name: 똥겜이라 부르지 말아줘 스트리머씨: 해피 나나루
apps.short_description: [Please Do Not Call It a Trash Game Streamer] is a reverse-progression 2D platformer. Guide the cute bakery girl Nanaru through devil Yako's trials. As you advance, you lose abilities and controls deteriorate—a trap set by someone wishing the adventure never ends.

apps.name: 새벽별 고양이
apps.short_description: Explore a new neighborhood with Hana, photograph stray cats, and fill your collection. Cats appear at different times and in different weather. Plan each day, meet the people around you, and follow a summer story in this single-player exploration and collection adventure.

apps.name: 수용수 : to pluto
apps.short_description: Two job seekers, two separate spaces, one set of controls. Guide a pair of characters who move in sync, solve puzzles, and get them safely to Café Pluto in this 2D puzzle platformer.

apps.name: 오늘도 모험가 길드는 평화롭습니다.
apps.short_description:
All Peaceful at the Adventurer's Guild Today is the ultimate tiny idle RPG, designed to fit neatly at the bottom of your desktop.

Just leave it running on the side of your screen, and watch your very own guild grow.

Become the Guild Master and build a guild that's truly yours!

apps.name: 청월시 괴이사진록 (Cheongwol: Paranormal Archives)
apps.short_description: In Cheongwol, where spirits live among humans, a struggling photographer strikes a dangerous bargain with an eight-tailed fox seeking her ninth tail. Capture the uncanny and grow closer to Jang Sehee in this modern fantasy romance visual novel.
